AMS.name: Amsterdam Airport Schiphol

officialArrivalAdvice.international: Schiphol recommends arriving 3 hours before departure for non-Schengen flights, which includes all flights to the US (2 hours for Schengen flights). Delta also recommends at least 3 hours before an international flight.

AMS.passportControl: At Schiphol you go through security first, then Royal Netherlands Marechaussee passport control before the non-Schengen gates. The EU Entry/Exit System (EES, fully operational since April 10, 2026) records your exit: US passport holders aged 14 and over with a chip passport can use the departure eGates, which handle the EES check automatically, while children under 14 go to a staffed desk. A Financial Times and Qsensor study reported by Euronews on Aug 12, 2026 found maximum border waits at Amsterdam rose to 120 minutes in July 2026 from 80 a year earlier, though Schiphol said in August that departing travelers saw fewer delays than arriving ones. On flights to the US, gate agents may ask extra security questions and check documents before you reach the gate seating area. In September 2026, reports said the Netherlands is among nine countries that may still pause fingerprint and face capture when queues build; the European Commission declined to comment.

terminals.name: Departures 2 (to Piers D and E)

checkpoints.notes: Security comes first, then passport control for non-Schengen flights. You can book a free security timeslot from 3 days before departure in the Schiphol app or on schiphol.nl. Schiphol's April 2026 guidance says liquids must be in containers of 100 ml or less.
checkpoints.name: Security, then passport control

notes: Delta and KLM's intercontinental flights check in here
Pier E is non-Schengen. Pier D has both: non-Schengen gates D3-D57 and Schengen gates D59-D87
You can walk between piers and halls, but going from the Schengen side to the non-Schengen side means passing passport control

terminals.name: Departures 3 (to Piers F, G, H and M)

checkpoints.notes: Security comes first, then passport control for non-Schengen flights. You can book a free security timeslot from 3 days before departure in the Schiphol app or on schiphol.nl.
checkpoints.name: Security, then passport control

notes: United checks in here
Piers F and G handle intercontinental (non-Schengen) flights; H is non-Schengen low-cost and M is Schengen low-cost
Pier M is separate: once airside, you cannot reach the other piers from it

terminals.name: Departures 1 (to Piers B and C)
notes: Mainly Schengen flights (Piers B and C and gates D59-D87), so US-bound passengers normally check in at Departures 2 or 3

AMS.betweenTerminals: Schiphol is one terminal with three departure halls. You can walk between the halls and piers on both sides of security; moving from the Schengen side to the non-Schengen side means passing passport control.

securityWaits.summary: Schiphol does not publish a fixed security wait figure. Wikivoyage says separate security and passport checks can take 20-30 minutes or more at busy times around 6-9am. Border control waits rose in summer 2026: a maximum of 120 minutes in July 2026, up from 80 a year earlier.

gettingThere.rideshare: Taxis serve the airport. Wikivoyage suggests booking ahead for a fixed price and avoiding unlicensed drivers who call out to travelers at the bus station.
gettingThere.transit: Schiphol station sits right under the main entrance. Trains to Amsterdam Centraal take about 15 minutes, with about 10 trains an hour; after about 1am an hourly night train runs to Amsterdam, Rotterdam, The Hague and Utrecht. Bus 397 (Amsterdam Airport Express) runs to Museumplein and Leidseplein about every 15 minutes.

construction2026: The Multimodal Hub project is rebuilding the airport train and bus interchange; a replacement bus station is expected in autumn 2027
The new Pier A is not open yet; Schiphol expects to start using it in April 2027
AMS.bagDrop: Delta: be checked in at least 60 minutes before an international departure and at the gate 45 minutes before (AMS has no Delta exception). United: check in at least 60 minutes before an international flight. KLM's current AMS cutoffs were not confirmed here, so check your boarding pass.
tips: Arrive 3 hours before a US flight, as Schiphol advises for all non-Schengen flights
Book a free security timeslot from 3 days before departure in the Schiphol app or on schiphol.nl
Check in at the right hall: Delta and KLM intercontinental flights use Departures 2, United uses Departures 3
At the eGates, take your passport out of its cover and remove glasses, hats or face masks; US passport holders 14 and over can use them
Get to the gate early: US flights can have extra security questions and document checks before boarding

faq.q: How early should I get to Amsterdam Schiphol for a flight to the US?
faq.a: 3 hours before departure. Schiphol recommends 3 hours for all non-Schengen flights, and Delta recommends at least 3 hours for international flights. Border control waits reached 120 minutes at peak in July 2026.

faq.q: Is security or passport control first at Schiphol?
faq.a: Security comes first. Passport control comes after it, before the non-Schengen gates used by US flights.

faq.q: Can US citizens use the eGates when leaving Schiphol?
faq.a: Yes. US travelers aged 14 and over with a chip passport can use the departure eGates, which record the Entry/Exit System exit automatically. Children under 14 go to a staffed Marechaussee desk.

faq.q: How do I get from Amsterdam to Schiphol by train?
faq.a: Take a train from Amsterdam Centraal. The trip takes about 15 minutes, with about 10 trains an hour, and the station is right under the airport's main entrance.

ATL.name: Hartsfield-Jackson Atlanta International Airport

officialArrivalAdvice.domestic: Delta (ATL's hub carrier) recommends arriving at least 2 hours before domestic departures; ATL is not on Delta's list of airports with longer times

terminals.name: Domestic Terminal (North and South)

checkpoints.notes: Open 24 hours for standard screening; the only checkpoint reported as open around the clock
checkpoints.name: Main Checkpoint

checkpoints.notes: Hours reported as 3:30am-10pm (Chase) or 4am-9pm (Upgraded Points); standard and priority screening
checkpoints.name: North Checkpoint

checkpoints.notes: Reported 3:30am-10pm for standard and CLEAR standard screening
checkpoints.name: Lower North Checkpoint

checkpoints.notes: TSA PreCheck lanes only (incl. CLEAR with PreCheck); reported 4am-10pm (Chase) or 4am-9pm (Upgraded Points)
checkpoints.name: South Checkpoint

notes: Delta occupies the South side of the Domestic Terminal; other airlines, including Southwest, check in on the North side
The MARTA rail station is inside the Domestic Terminal
Concourses T, A, B, C, D, E and F are reached by the Plane Train (every 2 minutes) or the underground Transportation Mall walkway

terminals.name: Maynard H. Jackson Jr. International Terminal

checkpoints.notes: Standard screening reported 4:30am-midnight; PreCheck only during limited windows (Chase lists 7-10am and 2-7pm); CLEAR+ standard lanes reported 5am-8pm
checkpoints.name: International Terminal Departures checkpoint

notes: Separate building with its own highway exit (exit 239, vs. exit 238 for the Domestic Terminal)
Upper level has ticketing and security; lower level is customs and baggage claim
During the March 2026 TSA staffing crisis the airport told domestic travelers to stay away from the International Terminal checkpoint

ATL.betweenTerminals: Plane Train runs every 2 minutes beneath all concourses; you can also walk between all concourses through the underground Transportation Mall (domestic-to-international end to end is about 1.3 miles, roughly 30 minutes)

securityWaits.summary: No official typical-wait figures were accessible. Peak security times are 5-9am plus the days before and after holidays and long weekends. During the Feb-Apr 2026 DHS shutdown waits reached several hours and the airport advised arriving 4 hours early; that shutdown ended April 30, 2026.
busiestTimes: Days before and after holidays and long weekends

ATL.precheckNotes: The South Checkpoint (Delta side) is PreCheck-only. International Terminal PreCheck runs only during limited daytime windows. Checkpoint hours differ between guides and are subject to change.
ATL.touchlessId: TSA PreCheck Touchless ID is listed at ATL for Alaska, American, Delta, Southwest and United (opt in through your airline profile)

gettingThere.rideshare: Rideshare pickup is on the Domestic Terminal North lower level, next to the North Economy parking deck (follow orange signs)
gettingThere.transit: MARTA Red and Gold lines leave from inside the Domestic Terminal every 10-20 minutes; about 15 minutes to the city center
gettingThere.driving: Use exit 238 for the Domestic Terminal and exit 239 for the International Terminal. Redevelopment work limits space in the North and South parking decks until 2027; hourly domestic parking is $10/hour, daily garages $30/day, economy $20/day.

construction2026: North and South parking deck redevelopment limits parking in those decks until 2027
Concourse D widening continues section by section through summer 2029, with minimal gate closures
ATL.bagDrop: Delta: check bags at least 45 minutes before domestic departure (30 minutes if not checking bags); be at the gate 15 minutes before departure; bags are not accepted more than 6 hours early. Southwest: checked bags at the counter 45 minutes before domestic departure.
tips: Delta flyers check in on the South side; most other airlines, including Southwest, are on the North side
The South Checkpoint is PreCheck-only, so travelers without PreCheck should use Main or North
The Main Checkpoint is the one reported open 24 hours; other checkpoints close in the evening
Gates on far concourses are a Plane Train ride away (trains every 2 minutes); walking the Transportation Mall from the domestic end to the international end takes about 30 minutes
If one domestic checkpoint looks crowded, local news suggests walking to the other side, but only if that line is moving

faq.q: How early should I get to the Atlanta airport?
faq.a: Delta, ATL's main airline, recommends arriving at least 2 hours before a domestic flight. Peak security times are 5-9am and around holidays, so allow more time then. Check ATL's live wait times before you leave.

faq.q: Is ATL still telling travelers to arrive 4 hours early?
faq.a: That advice was issued in March 2026 during the DHS shutdown, when TSA staffing was short. The shutdown ended April 30, 2026, and Congress later extended federal funding through December 11, 2026.

faq.q: Which ATL security checkpoint has TSA PreCheck?
faq.a: The Domestic Terminal South Checkpoint on Delta's side is PreCheck-only, including CLEAR with PreCheck. The International Terminal also has PreCheck, but only during limited daytime hours.

AUS.name: Austin-Bergstrom International Airport

officialArrivalAdvice.domestic: AUS says passengers should arrive at least 2.5 hours before departure for all domestic flights
officialArrivalAdvice.international: AUS says to arrive 3 hours before international flights

terminals.name: Barbara Jordan Terminal

checkpoints.notes: From October 20, 2026: TSA PreCheck, PreCheck Touchless ID, CLEAR with PreCheck, Known Crew Member, ADA and Priority/Premium screening.
checkpoints.name: Checkpoint 1

checkpoints.notes: From October 20, 2026: TSA PreCheck only.
checkpoints.name: Checkpoint 2

checkpoints.notes: From October 20, 2026: general screening, CLEAR for general screening, ADA and Priority/Premium screening.
checkpoints.name: Checkpoint 3

checkpoints.notes: General screening only. Opened February 23, 2026, in the West Infill on the far west side of the terminal, with easier access to Gates 22 and above. AUS says a future central checkpoint will eventually replace it.
checkpoints.name: Checkpoint 4

notes: All airlines now fly from the Barbara Jordan Terminal. The South Terminal closed March 31, 2026, and Allegiant and Frontier moved over on April 1.
All four checkpoints lead to all gates
The first checkpoints typically open at 3am daily
AUS says travelers with a REAL ID can use dedicated lanes at all checkpoints
Curbside check-in is offered by select airlines on the upper level

AUS.betweenTerminals: Single terminal. All four checkpoints lead to all gates, so you can reach any gate after screening.

securityWaits.summary: AUS officials said in March 2026 that TSA checkpoints are busiest from about 3 to 7am, with departures peaking 6-7am. AUS calls a day with more than 35,000 departing passengers high-volume. In spring 2026, Sundays and Mondays were its busiest days. Lines stretched outside the terminal on the peak Friday of spring break 2026.
busiestTimes: Sundays and Mondays during busy seasons

AUS.precheckNotes: As of October 20, 2026, PreCheck lanes are at Checkpoints 1 and 2 only. Checkpoints 3 and 4 are general screening. AUS did not publish PreCheck lane hours.
AUS.touchlessId: AUS lists TSA PreCheck Touchless ID at Checkpoint 1. A March 2026 airport list shows it at AUS for American. You opt in through your airline profile.

gettingThere.rideshare: Drop-off is at the upper level (departures) curb. Rideshare and taxi pickup is on the ground level under the Consolidated Rental Car Facility, just north of (behind) the Red Garage. Mobility trams run from the garages and terminal to the rideshare area.
gettingThere.transit: CapMetro Route 20 stops on the lower level just outside baggage claim. It runs every 15-30 minutes, seven days a week, and takes about 35 minutes to downtown. A single ride is $1.25.
gettingThere.driving: Both the upper and lower roadways are open for drop-off; AUS says to use whichever is less crowded. On-site parking can sell out, so book ahead at ABIAParking.com. Economy Lot shuttles run every 15-20 minutes. The free cell phone lot at 2901 Spirit of Texas Drive is open 24/7.

construction2026: Atrium Infill between Checkpoints 2 and 3 in the Departures Hall: construction walls, adjusted queue lines and a different flow when busy. It adds screening, bag check and processing space and is planned to finish in 2026.
West Gate Expansion (August 2023 to late 2026) is past security on the west side, with temporary walls and barriers. It replaces 12 boarding bridges and adds 3 gates.

Yellow Garage construction next to the Blue Garage (finish expected early 2027): shifting traffic around the Blue Garage exits, flaggers and lower speeds. The Blue Garage exit ramp closes at times from 1am to 8am, and drivers exit through the Red Garage toll booth.
AUS says Journey With AUS construction continues across the campus; check flyaustin.com/construction-updates before you go
AUS.bagDrop: American: check-in and bag deadline is 45 minutes before domestic departure. Southwest: bags checked less than 45 minutes before a domestic departure may not be accepted (60 minutes for international); bags are accepted no earlier than 4 hours ahead. Delta: check bags at least 45 minutes before domestic departure, no more than 6 hours ahead.
tips: AUS asks for 2.5 hours before domestic flights, more than most US airports. Plan for that, especially before 7am.
Pick your checkpoint by your lane type. PreCheck is only at Checkpoints 1 and 2, and CLEAR is at 1 (with PreCheck) and 3 (general).
Checkpoint 4 on the far west side is general screening only and is closest to Gates 22 and up
Allegiant and Frontier no longer use the South Terminal. Go to the Barbara Jordan Terminal for every airline.
Garages can sell out on busy days. Book parking ahead and allow for Economy Lot shuttle time.

faq.q: How early should I get to Austin airport?
faq.a: AUS recommends at least 2.5 hours before domestic flights and 3 hours before international flights. Allow more if you are checking bags or returning a rental car.

faq.q: Which checkpoint has TSA PreCheck at AUS?
faq.a: As of October 20, 2026, Checkpoints 1 and 2 have PreCheck. Checkpoint 1 also has CLEAR with PreCheck and Touchless ID. Checkpoints 3 and 4 are general screening.

faq.q: Is the South Terminal at Austin airport still open?
faq.a: No. The South Terminal closed March 31, 2026. Allegiant and Frontier now fly from the Barbara Jordan Terminal with all other airlines.

faq.q: Where do I get an Uber or Lyft at AUS?
faq.a: Drop-off is at the upper level curb. Pickup is on the ground level under the Consolidated Rental Car Facility, behind the Red Garage. Trams run there from the terminal and garages.

BDL.name: Bradley International Airport

officialArrivalAdvice.domestic: Airport officials advised arriving at least 90 minutes before your scheduled departure to allow time for airline check-in and TSA screening (April 2026)

terminals.name: Terminal A (East and West concourses)

checkpoints.notes: Upgraded Points' BDL guide (updated Sep 2026) says Checkpoint 1 is at the south end of the terminal and implies it serves airlines other than American, Breeze and United. Official hours could not be confirmed. TSA's counts list two screening points at BDL, A1 and A2, with screening starting in the 3am hour; this research could not confirm which is which. CLEAR's site lists CLEAR+ on the Departures level by Door 3, across from the checkpoint entrance, 4am-6:30pm Sunday-Friday and 4am-6pm Saturday, without naming a checkpoint.
checkpoints.name: Checkpoint 1 (south end)

checkpoints.notes: Upgraded Points says Checkpoint 2 is at the north end of the terminal and is for passengers flying American, Breeze or United, or with TSA PreCheck. Official hours could not be confirmed.
checkpoints.name: Checkpoint 2 (north end)

notes: Terminal A handles most flights. Terminal B (the International Arrivals Building) is used for international arrivals that need customs processing. This research could not confirm which terminal Aer Lingus departures use.
Terminal A gates are in three areas: 1-12, 18-20 and 21-30
Southwest lists its BDL gates as A2, A4 and A6. Its counter opens 90 minutes before the first departing flight.
A new concourse with three gates, an extension of Terminal A behind the Sheraton hotel, was finished in January 2026. Wikipedia says Breeze uses it exclusively.
Checked bags now go by conveyor from the ticket counters to a new screening facility, so you no longer carry them to screening machines in the lobby

BDL.betweenTerminals: Terminal A handles most flights. Upgraded Points says both checkpoints lead to a central area with shops and restaurants, with gates 1-12 to one side and gates 21-30 to the other. This research could not confirm walking times between the two gate areas.

securityWaits.summary: In April 2026, airport officials said the busiest times are early morning, 4am to 7am, and again in the mid-to-late afternoon. In TSA's hourly screening counts for Sep 13-19, 2026, BDL was busiest from 4am to 7am, peaking 5-6am, with screening already under way in the 3am hour. There was a smaller rise from 10am to 1pm, and traffic was light after 5pm. Sunday, Thursday, Monday and Friday were the busiest days that week; Tuesday and Saturday were the quietest.
busiestTimes: Sundays, Thursdays, Mondays and Fridays (TSA counts, week of Sep 13, 2026)

BDL.precheckNotes: Upgraded Points says TSA PreCheck travelers use Checkpoint 2 at the north end of the terminal. The checkpoint was expanded with more screening lanes and queue space after the old center exit lane closed in 2025. CLEAR pods are on the Departures level by Door 3, across from the checkpoint entrance.
BDL.touchlessId: The Points Guy's table of TSA PreCheck Touchless ID airports (May 2026, based on TSA.gov) lists BDL for four of the five airlines it tracks (American, Delta, United, Southwest and Alaska). This research could not confirm which one is missing or where the lane is. To use it, add your Known Traveler Number and passport details to your airline profile and opt in; a Touchless ID indicator then shows on your boarding pass. Carry your physical ID.

gettingThere.rideshare: Rideshare pickup is in a marked area near Door 2 on the Arrivals level. A free cell phone waiting lot with EV charging is a few minutes from the terminal.
gettingThere.transit: CTtransit Route 30 (Bradley Flyer) runs between downtown Hartford, including Hartford Union Station, and the airport. Chase's guide says it typically runs every 40 minutes most days; check CTtransit for current times. CTtransit Route 24 links the airport with the Windsor Locks train station on the Hartford Line.
gettingThere.driving: BDL's on-airport parking (BDL sPARK) includes a garage and surface lots. Surface Lot 3 on Schoephoester Road is being expanded and is due to finish this winter, adding more than 1,500 spaces. Airport officials say lots may fill quickly during peak periods. This research could not confirm current parking rates because the airport's website blocked access.

construction2026: The terminal projects are done. The new three-gate concourse was finished in January 2026. The expanded TSA checkpoint, two new exit corridors on the east and west sides, and the new in-line baggage screening facility opened in 2025.

Surface Lot 3 on Schoephoester Road is being expanded (about midway in August 2026) and is due to be finished in the winter. The work includes moving the lot's entrance and exit plaza. This research could not confirm whether any parking is closed during the work.
BDL.bagDrop: Southwest: check bags at least 45 minutes before a domestic flight (60 minutes for international), check in at least 30 minutes before a domestic flight, and be at the gate 10 minutes before departure. Delta: bags 45 minutes before domestic departure, 30 minutes without bags; Delta lists no BDL exception. American and United: check in and check bags 45 minutes before domestic departure (AP, May 2025).
tips: Early morning is the busiest time. Airport officials name 4-7am, and in TSA's September 2026 counts the peak was 5-6am.
Flying American, Breeze or United, or have TSA PreCheck? Upgraded Points says to use Checkpoint 2 at the north end of the terminal.
After check-in, leave your checked bags with the airline. They now go to screening by conveyor, so there is no extra stop at screening machines in the lobby.
Parking lots can fill at peak times, and Lot 3 is under construction until this winter. Allow extra time to park.
The Bradley Flyer bus (CTtransit Route 30) links the airport with downtown Hartford

faq.q: How early should I get to Bradley airport (BDL)?
faq.a: Airport officials advise arriving at least 90 minutes before a domestic flight. Early mornings, 4-7am, are the busiest time at security, so allow more time then.

faq.q: Which security checkpoint should I use at BDL?
faq.a: Upgraded Points says Checkpoint 2 at the north end is for American, Breeze and United passengers and TSA PreCheck members. Others use Checkpoint 1 at the south end. Both lead to the same central area.

faq.q: Which terminal do I fly from at BDL?
faq.a: Most flights use Terminal A, including Southwest, American, Delta, United, JetBlue and Breeze. Terminal B, the International Arrivals Building, is used for international arrivals that need customs processing.

faq.q: Does BDL have TSA PreCheck and CLEAR?
faq.a: Yes. Upgraded Points says PreCheck travelers use Checkpoint 2. CLEAR is on the Departures level by Door 3, across from the checkpoint, 4am-6:30pm Sunday-Friday and 4am-6pm Saturday.

BNA.name: Nashville International Airport

officialArrivalAdvice.domestic: BNA's fall break tips say to arrive 2 hours before domestic flights and to leave time for parking (WSMV, Sept 30, 2026). Southwest also suggests 120 minutes at BNA.
officialArrivalAdvice.international: BNA's fall break tips say to arrive 3 hours before international flights (WSMV, Sept 30, 2026)

terminals.name: Main Terminal (Grand Lobby)

checkpoints.notes: On Level 3 (departures) in the Grand Lobby and serves all concourses. It opened with 24 lanes in January 2023. Upgraded Points (Sept 2026) says it opens daily at 3:30am; closing time not confirmed. Has dedicated PreCheck lanes; TSA sets PreCheck hours.
checkpoints.name: Central Security Checkpoint, Level 3

notes: Concourse B (gates B1, B3-B11): Delta and United, per Upgraded Points (Sept 2026)

Concourse C (C1-C3, C13-C27): American and Southwest. Gates C4-C11 are a satellite reached by shuttle bus from near gate C2; Upgraded Points lists Air Canada, Allegiant, Avelo, Contour, JetBlue, Porter and Sun Country there
Concourse D (D1-D11): Southwest. Southwest lists its BNA gates as C4, C7, C9, C16, C18-C22, C25 and D1-D6
T Gates, just past security: Alaska, Frontier and international carriers including Aer Lingus, British Airways, Icelandair, WestJet and Viva Aerobus. All international arrivals use Concourse T
Concourse A is closed and being rebuilt; the new 16-gate Concourse A is due in July 2028
If you park in a terminal garage, you enter the terminal on Level 1. The Level 5 pedestrian bridge is closed during construction

BNA.betweenTerminals: Single terminal. After security you can walk between Concourses B, C, D and T. Gates C4-C11 are a satellite reached by shuttle bus from near gate C2.

securityWaits.summary: BNA does not publish an hourly wait pattern that this research could find. Fall break is its busiest period: it set a one-day record of 116,047 passengers on Oct 5, 2025. For fall break 2025, BNA named Sundays, Mondays, Thursdays and Fridays as high-volume days, and TSA added staff Thursday through Monday. BNA also warned of longer parking, check-in and security waits on Monday, Sept 21, 2026.
busiestTimes: Sundays, Mondays, Thursdays and Fridays at busy times (BNA fall break 2025 plan)

BNA.precheckNotes: The central checkpoint has dedicated PreCheck lanes. Upgraded Points says to check TSA for PreCheck hours because they vary. This research could not confirm PreCheck closing times.
BNA.touchlessId: Southwest's BNA page lists a TSA PreCheck Touchless ID checkpoint (opt in through your airline profile). A March 2026 list showed BNA as being added by late spring.

gettingThere.rideshare: Drop-off is at the Level 3 departures curb in front of the terminal. Uber and Lyft pickup is at the Ground Transportation Center on Level 1 of Terminal Garage 2. A local guide (Oct 2026) says Lyft uses Zone A and Uber Zones B and C.
gettingThere.transit: WeGo Route 18 Airport runs to WeGo Central downtown from the Ground Transportation Center (Level 1, Terminal Garage 2). Express trips take about 20 minutes and local trips 35-45 minutes. Since July 5, 2026, it runs every 30 minutes from 6am to 6pm, seven days a week, and every 40 minutes in the evening. Fare is $2.
gettingThere.driving: Construction is underway, so BNA suggests learning the alternate route from Murfreesboro Pike and I-40 Exit 216B. Terminal Lot A closed July 1, 2026. Terminal Garages 1 and 2, Economy Lots B and C, and valet remain; economy shuttles leave from Level 2 arrivals about every 10 minutes. Since Sept 23, 2026, Garage 1 has no exit: drive through to Garage 2, take the helix down to Level P2 and pay there. The free cell lot is at 1415 Murfreesboro Pike.

construction2026: Central Core Enhancement: the main escalator and elevator hub closed June 1, 2026, for an 18-month, $40 million rebuild expected to run through December 2027
The Level 5 pedestrian bridge from the garages is closed, so garage parkers enter the terminal on Level 1
Concourse A is closed for demolition and rebuilding; the new 16-gate concourse is expected in July 2028
Terminal Lot A closed July 1, 2026, for a new rental car facility and parking garage
The Terminal Garage 1 exit closed Sept 23, 2026; drivers exit through Terminal Garage 2. BNA says more roadway changes are expected this fall
BNA.bagDrop: Southwest: check bags at least 45 minutes before domestic departure (60 minutes for international) and check in at least 30 minutes before domestic departure. Be at the gate 10 minutes before departure. Its BNA ticket counter opens 90 minutes before the first departing flight. American, United and Delta: check bags at least 45 minutes before domestic departure. Alaska: check in at least 50 minutes before domestic departure.
tips: There is one central checkpoint, on Level 3 in the Grand Lobby, and it serves all concourses
Parking in a garage? Allow extra walking time. You enter the terminal on Level 1 because the Level 5 bridge is closed until the Central Core work ends (expected December 2027)
Lot A is closed. Use the terminal garages, Economy Lots B and C, or valet. Leaving Garage 1, follow signs to Garage 2 to exit
If traffic backs up on the usual route, BNA suggests the Murfreesboro Pike and I-40 Exit 216B approach
Southwest's BNA ticket counter opens 90 minutes before the first flight of the day, so very early flyers should check in online
Gates C4-C11 are on a satellite reached by shuttle bus from near gate C2, so leave extra time if your flight leaves from one of them

faq.q: How early should I get to Nashville airport?
faq.a: BNA says to arrive 2 hours before a domestic flight and 3 hours before an international flight. Leave extra time for parking and construction detours.

faq.q: How many security checkpoints does BNA have?
faq.a: One. The central checkpoint on Level 3 in the Grand Lobby has 24 lanes and serves all concourses. It opens at 3:30am, and it has PreCheck lanes.

faq.q: Where do Uber and Lyft pick up at Nashville airport?
faq.a: At the Ground Transportation Center on Level 1 of Terminal Garage 2. Drop-off is at the Level 3 departures curb.

faq.q: Is Lot A still open at BNA?
faq.a: No. Terminal Lot A closed July 1, 2026, to make room for a new garage and rental car facility. The terminal garages, Economy Lots B and C, and valet are still open.

faq.q: Can I take a bus from BNA to downtown Nashville?
faq.a: Yes. WeGo Route 18 Airport leaves from Level 1 of Terminal Garage 2 and costs $2. Express trips take about 20 minutes. Buses run every 30 minutes from 6am to 6pm.

Terminal A is not connected to the other terminals after security

checkpoints.name: Terminal B security

Pre-security escalators on the Southwest/United side may be out of service through November. Use the elevators.
Ride-app pickup and drop-off is on Level 2 (Departures) of the Terminal B parking garage

terminals.name: Terminal C

checkpoints.notes: CLEAR+ hours are 4:00am-8:00pm. JetBlue lists the checkpoint hours as 3:00am-11:30pm.
checkpoints.name: Terminal C security

The bus stop for Logan Express, hotel shuttles, the Uber/Lyft Shuttle and shared vans has moved to Door C102, near the Logan Chapel
Ride-app pickup and drop-off for Terminal C is in the Central Parking Garage

terminals.name: Terminal E

checkpoints.name: Terminal E security

notes: Terminal E is Logan's primary international terminal, though international flights can depart from any terminal
Vestibules E101 and E102 and the Terminal E-C Arrivals Level sidewalk are closed. The Terminal E taxi stand is now outside Door E107.
Ride-app pickup and drop-off for Terminal E is in the Central Parking Garage

BOS.betweenTerminals: Terminals B, C and E are connected after security. Terminal A is not, so you reach it by pre-security walkways or the free On-Airport Shuttle. Shuttle Route 11 links Terminals A, B, C and E (9am-10pm), and shuttles generally run every 5-6 minutes.
BOS.precheckNotes: TSA PreCheck lanes are available in all terminals. Checkpoints normally open 2 hours before the first departure of the day. On CLEAR, sources differ: Massport's security page names Terminals A and B, while CLEAR's own location page lists lanes in A, B, C and E.
BOS.touchlessId: Delta lists BOS for TSA PreCheck Touchless ID, with dedicated Touchless ID bag drop. Southwest also lists BOS.

gettingThere.rideshare: Ride-app drop-off and pickup for Terminals A, C and E is in the Central Parking Garage. For Terminal B it is on Level 2 (Departures) of the Terminal B parking garage. Accessible ride-app drop-offs use the upper Departures curb.
gettingThere.transit: The Silver Line SL1 runs from all terminals to South Station and is free from the airport. For the Blue Line, take free Massport shuttle Route 22, 33, 55 or 66 to Airport Station. Logan Express buses run from Back Bay ($3 to the airport, free back) and from Braintree, Danvers, Framingham and Woburn ($9 each way online, $7/day parking). The Braintree stop is moving to the MBTA Quincy Adams Garage on Tuesday, 11/3. An MBTA ferry connects to Long Wharf via shuttle Route 66.
gettingThere.driving: Pre-booking parking online guarantees a space. Garages fill earliest on Tuesday and Wednesday mornings and during the February and April school vacation weeks. Economy Parking is capped at $37 per day and the Terminal B Garage at $46 per day.

construction2026: Runway 9-27 is closed for the second and final phase of FAA-required runway safety work. The closure began Aug 31, 2026 for about 75 days, ongoing through November. Expect flight delays, especially in the afternoons and evenings.
Since 9/1, the pedestrian bridge from Terminal A to the Air Canada/American/Alaska side of Terminal B is closed. Use the detour or the on-airport shuttle.
Terminal B pre-security escalators on the Southwest/United side may be out of service through November
Terminal C bus stop (Logan Express, hotel shuttles, Uber/Lyft Shuttle, shared vans) has moved to Door C102
Terminal E: vestibules E101 and E102 and the E-C Arrivals sidewalk are closed, and the taxi stand has moved to Door E107
The Braintree Logan Express stop is moving to the MBTA Quincy Adams Garage on Tuesday, 11/3
BOS.bagDrop: Delta (no BOS-specific exception): bags must be checked at least 45 minutes before domestic departures, international check-in closes 1 hour before, and you must be at the gate 15 minutes before departure. JetBlue at BOS: check-in and bags 45 minutes before domestic departures and 60 minutes before international.
tips: Terminal A is not connected to the other terminals after security. If you are in the wrong terminal, you will have to clear security again.
Uber and Lyft drop you at the Central Parking Garage for Terminals A, C and E, not at the curb. Allow a few extra minutes to walk in.
The Silver Line SL1 runs directly to every terminal from South Station. Massport says it is free from the airport to downtown.
Runway 9-27 work through November can cause afternoon and evening delays. Check your flight status before you leave.
Logan garages fill earliest on Tuesday and Wednesday mornings, so pre-book parking if you are driving

faq.q: How early should I get to Boston Logan?
faq.a: Massport recommends arriving 2 hours before domestic departures and 3 hours before international departures. Check with your airline during peak travel periods.

faq.q: Can I walk between terminals at Logan after security?
faq.a: Terminals B, C and E are connected after security, but Terminal A is not. For Terminal A, use the pre-security walkways or the free On-Airport Shuttle.

faq.q: Where do Uber and Lyft drop off at Logan?
faq.a: For Terminals A, C and E, ride apps use the Central Parking Garage. For Terminal B, they use Level 2 (Departures) of the Terminal B parking garage.

officialArrivalAdvice.international: BWI's security page says TSA recommends arriving 3 hours before international flights

terminals.name: Concourses A, B and C (Main Terminal)

checkpoints.notes: BWI lists screening 4am-8pm. Upgraded Points (May 2026) says PreCheck runs here only when operationally needed, and CLEAR 4am-7:30pm. Leads to Concourses A, B and C.
checkpoints.name: Checkpoint A

checkpoints.notes: BWI's security page lists screening as open 24 hours. Upgraded Points (May 2026) lists 4am-9:45pm, with PreCheck and CLEAR 4am-9pm. Leads to Concourses A, B and C.
checkpoints.name: Checkpoint B

checkpoints.notes: BWI lists screening 4am-8pm. Upgraded Points (May 2026) says PreCheck runs here only when operationally needed, and CLEAR 4am-9pm. Leads to Concourses A, B and C.
checkpoints.name: Checkpoint C

notes: Southwest flies from Concourses A, B and C (and E for some flights); American and Contour use Concourse C
Concourses A, B and C share one secure area, so any of Checkpoints A, B or C reaches all three
A new A/B Connector opened January 9, 2026, adding a direct link between Concourses A and B
Upgraded Points says Checkpoints A, B or C may be closed when passenger volumes are low

terminals.name: Concourses D and E (Main Terminal)

checkpoints.notes: BWI's security page lists screening as open 24 hours. Upgraded Points (May 2026) lists 4am-9:15pm, with PreCheck 4am-8pm and CLEAR 4am-9pm.
checkpoints.name: Checkpoint D/E

notes: BWI lists Alaska, Avelo, BermudAir, Delta, Frontier, JetBlue, Sun Country and United at Concourse D
Breeze, British Airways, Copa, Icelandair and some Southwest flights use Concourse E (the international concourse)
D/E has its own checkpoint, separate from A/B/C

BWI.betweenTerminals: All concourses are in one terminal building. Concourses A, B and C connect airside, and D and E connect to each other. But D/E is not linked airside to A/B/C, so moving between the two groups means walking through the terminal and clearing security again.

securityWaits.summary: BWI publishes daily peak periods. Mornings peak at 5-8am on Monday, Thursday and Friday, and 6-8am on other days. Afternoon peaks vary by day, with the longest on Thursday (3-7pm) and Sunday (4-7pm). In March 2026, local news reported that A/B/C (Southwest and American) had the longest lines, while D/E saw normal to no waits. Real-time waits are on BWI's homepage.

BWI.precheckNotes: Upgraded Points (May 2026) lists regular PreCheck lanes at Checkpoint B (4am-9pm) and Checkpoint D/E (4am-8pm). It says Checkpoints A and C open PreCheck only when operationally needed. BWI does not publish PreCheck hours by checkpoint, so confirm before a late flight.
BWI.touchlessId: A March 2026 list of TSA PreCheck Touchless ID airports shows BWI for American only. You opt in through your airline profile.

gettingThere.rideshare: Rideshare pickup and drop-off is on the outer curb of the Departures/Upper Level, between Doors 5 and 12.
gettingThere.transit: MTA Light Rail stops just outside the lower level next to Concourse E. It runs to downtown Baltimore, Timonium and Hunt Valley for $2.00 each way. First trains arrive at 4:45am on weekdays and 5:05am on Saturdays, but not until 10:35am on Sundays and holidays. MARC and Amtrak use the BWI rail station; a free 24-hour shuttle drops you near your airline's check-in counter.
gettingThere.driving: BWI listed these rates: Hourly Garage (closest) $6/hour or $30/day; Daily Garage $16/day; Express Parking $14/day; Long Term A and B $11/day. Lots can fill and close, and drivers are then sent to other lots. A free cell phone lot is available for pickups.

construction2026: The Concourse A/B Connector and new Southwest baggage system opened January 9, 2026, with a direct A-B link and relocated gate areas
BWI's construction page lists ongoing passenger boarding bridge replacement and restroom renovations, without dates or passenger impacts
BWI.bagDrop: Southwest: bags checked less than 45 minutes before a domestic departure may not be accepted; international bags must be checked at the counter at least 60 minutes ahead. Southwest accepts bags no earlier than 4 hours before departure. Delta: check bags at least 45 minutes before domestic departure, and no more than 6 hours ahead. American: check-in and bag deadline is 45 minutes before domestic departure.
tips: Check your concourse before you go. D/E (Delta, United, JetBlue, Frontier, most international flights) has its own checkpoint and is not connected airside to A/B/C.
Southwest carries most of BWI's traffic and uses A, B and C. Those checkpoints have had the longest lines at busy times.
If you have PreCheck and fly from A/B/C, head to Checkpoint B. Checkpoints A and C may not have PreCheck lanes open.
The Light Rail does not start until about 10:35am on Sundays and holidays. Plan another way for early Sunday flights.
Rideshare drop-off is on the upper level outer curb between Doors 5 and 12.

faq.q: How early should I get to BWI airport?
faq.a: BWI passes on TSA's advice: 2 hours before a domestic flight and 3 hours before an international flight. Allow more time if you fly Southwest or American from Concourses A-C at morning peaks (5-8am).

faq.q: Can I walk from Concourse D to Concourse A after security at BWI?
faq.a: No. Concourses A, B and C share one secure area, and D and E share another. To switch between them you must walk through the terminal and clear security again.

faq.q: Which concourse is Southwest at BWI?
faq.a: BWI lists Southwest at Concourses A, B, C and E. Most domestic Southwest flights leave from A, B or C, and E handles international flights.

faq.q: Is BWI security open 24 hours?
faq.a: BWI lists Checkpoints B and D/E as open 24 hours, with A and C open 4am to 8pm. A May 2026 third-party guide lists shorter hours for B and D/E, and BWI says hours can change. Late-night flyers should check bwiairport.com.

CDG.name: Paris Charles de Gaulle Airport
CDG.passportControl: French border police run exit passport control at CDG, after check-in and before your gate; in some terminals it comes after the security check. The EU Entry/Exit System (EES), fully operational since April 10, 2026, covers US citizens: your passport data, a face photo and fingerprints are recorded, and digital records have replaced passport stamps. Long passport queues have been reported since April; one family leaving CDG that month cleared check-in and security, then waited about three hours for passport control and missed their flight despite arriving three hours early. Paris Aéroport (ADP) has said it switches to manual checks when queues get too long, and no official wait-time figures for CDG departures were found. At Terminal 2E, Delta sends Sky Priority passengers to dedicated border and security lanes before the main security checkpoint.

officialArrivalAdvice.international: Delta suggests arriving 3 hours before international departures at airports without their own listed times, which includes CDG; check-in must be completed at least 1 hour before departure

terminals.name: Terminal 1
notes: Mainly Star Alliance airlines; United moved back to T1 in January 2023 after its renovation
United check-in is on level 3, hall 3; the Star Alliance lounge is on level 4, before passport control
From the RER B station Aéroport CDG 1, take the free CDGVAL shuttle to Terminal 1

notes: oneworld airlines, including American
A shared boarding area between 2A and 2C handles security and passport control in one place

terminals.name: Terminal 2B

terminals.name: Terminal 2D
notes: Air Tahiti Nui uses 2D for its Los Angeles flights

terminals.name: Terminal 2E

checkpoints.notes: Delta Sky Priority passengers follow signs to dedicated border and security lanes in the hallway between check-in Row 7 and the main checkpoint entrance.
checkpoints.name: Terminal 2E main security checkpoint

notes: Delta says its flights to and from the US use 2E; Air France uses 2E and 2F, so check your boarding pass
Delta check-in is at Rows 2 and 3
The LISA shuttle train links 2E to the L gates and M gates, so allow time to reach your gate

terminals.name: Terminal 3
notes: Used by charter and low-cost airlines; this research found no US airline here
Next to Roissypôle and the RER B station Aéroport CDG 1

CDG.betweenTerminals: Terminals 2A to 2F are linked by walkways; 2G is reached by shuttle bus. The free CDGVAL train links Terminal 1, the RER station Aéroport CDG 1 (by Terminal 3) and the Aéroport CDG 2 TGV station between 2C, 2D, 2E and 2F.

securityWaits.summary: No official CDG wait-time data was found. Since EES became fully operational on April 10, 2026, news outlets have reported long passport queues at CDG, including a family who missed their departing flight after about three hours in the passport line in April. ADP has said it reverts to manual border procedures when waits become excessive.

gettingThere.rideshare: Paris taxis charge a flat fare between the city and CDG in either direction: €56 from the Right Bank and €65 from the Left Bank (2026 rates).
gettingThere.transit: The RER B takes about 34 minutes from Gare du Nord. It stops at Aéroport CDG 1 (for Terminals 1 and 3; take CDGVAL to Terminal 1) and Aéroport CDG 2 TGV (between 2C, 2D, 2E and 2F). The RER B is regularly disrupted, so check before you go. RoissyBus stopped on March 1, 2026; its replacement, the 9517 bus from Saint-Denis Pleyel (metro line 14), takes about 50 to 70 minutes from central Paris.
gettingThere.driving: Recurring traffic jams on the A1 motorway make road travel times to CDG unreliable, so leave a buffer.

construction2026: The CDG Express rail link from Gare de l'Est is still being built. It is due to open on March 28, 2027, with a 20-minute trip every 15 minutes. Until then, use the RER B.
CDG.bagDrop: Delta: check in at least 1 hour before departure (CDG follows Delta's general international rule). United: check-in closes 75 minutes before departure at Paris airports. American: 60 minutes for check-in and checked bags on flights from outside the US.
tips: Budget extra time for the EES passport line on the way out. Queues of up to about three hours were reported at CDG after April 10, 2026.
Check your terminal: Delta US flights use 2E (shared with Air France), American uses 2A, United uses Terminal 1 and JetBlue uses 2B.

Terminals get new names on March 16, 2027: Terminal 3 becomes 2, 2A and 2C become 3, 2B and 2D become 4, 2E becomes 5, 2F becomes 6 and 2G becomes 7. Tickets for later flights may already show the new names.
Unlike Heathrow, CDG still applies the 100ml liquids limit in carry-on bags, even where new CT scanners are installed.
If you are flying from 2E, allow time for the LISA train to the L and M gates after the checkpoints.

faq.q: How early should I get to CDG for a flight to the US?
faq.a: Plan on at least 3 hours, and more at busy times. Delta suggests 3 hours for international departures, check-in closes 60 to 75 minutes before departure depending on the airline, and the EES passport line has taken up to about three hours at peak times in 2026.

faq.q: What happens at passport control when I leave France?
faq.a: Under the EU Entry/Exit System, your passport, a face photo and fingerprints are recorded as you exit, and your passport is no longer stamped. The check comes after check-in; in some terminals it comes after security, so do not linger before it.

faq.q: Which CDG terminal is my flight to the US from?
faq.a: Delta flies to the US from Terminal 2E, which it shares with Air France. American uses 2A, United uses Terminal 1 and JetBlue uses 2B. Check your boarding pass, because terminals get new names on March 16, 2027.

faq.q: How do I get from Paris to CDG by train?
faq.a: Take the RER B, about 34 minutes from Gare du Nord. Get off at Aéroport CDG 2 TGV for Terminal 2, or at Aéroport CDG 1 and take the free CDGVAL to Terminal 1.

CLE.name: Cleveland Hopkins International Airport

officialArrivalAdvice.domestic: CLE recommends arriving no later than 2 hours before a domestic flight
officialArrivalAdvice.international: CLE recommends arriving no later than 3 hours before an international flight

terminals.name: Main Terminal (Concourses A, B and C)

checkpoints.notes: CLE lists hours of 3:45am-7:00pm. CLE's May 2026 travel guide says PreCheck lanes are at all three checkpoints. CLE's security page and CLEAR's site list CLEAR only at Central and South. North handled about a quarter of screenings in TSA's counts for Sep 13-19, 2026.
checkpoints.name: North Checkpoint

checkpoints.notes: CLE lists hours of 3:45am-10:00pm, the latest of the three. Expanded from two to four lanes, with over 300 feet of queue space (finished May 2026). CLE says CLEAR here is for travelers with TSA PreCheck. CLEAR's site lists CLEAR+ 4am-8pm, on the Departures level between Doors 3 and 4. TSA PreCheck Touchless ID has a dedicated lane here. It was the busiest checkpoint in TSA's counts, with about 45% of screenings.
checkpoints.name: Central Checkpoint

checkpoints.notes: CLE lists hours of 3:15am-7:45pm, the earliest opening of the three. CLE says CLEAR here is for travelers without TSA PreCheck. CLEAR's site lists CLEAR+ 4am-7pm.
checkpoints.name: South Checkpoint

notes: Concourse A: Frontier and Avelo. Concourse B: Southwest and Delta. Concourse C: United, American, Alaska, JetBlue, Air Canada and Aer Lingus.
Southwest lists its CLE gates as Concourse B, Gates 7-11
Concourse D is closed
Departing airlines are marked on overhead signs on the upper (Departures) level
Air Canada does not offer online check-in for departures from CLE; check in at the counter

CLE.betweenTerminals: Single terminal. All three checkpoints (North, Central and South) connect to all departure gates, and you can walk between Concourses A, B and C after security.

securityWaits.summary: CLE shows live TSA wait times for the North, Central and South checkpoints on its homepage. It does not publish typical peak times. In TSA's hourly screening counts for Sep 13-19, 2026, CLE was busiest from 4am to 7am, peaking 5-6am. Traffic stayed fairly steady from 7am to about 6pm, with small rises around 9-10am and 2-4pm, and was light after 7pm. Friday, Thursday, Monday and Sunday were the busiest days that week; Tuesday and Saturday were the quietest.
busiestTimes: Fridays, Thursdays, Mondays and Sundays (TSA counts, week of Sep 13, 2026)

CLE.precheckNotes: CLE says TSA PreCheck lanes are at the Central, North and South checkpoints (May 2026). The Central Checkpoint was expanded from two to four lanes in May 2026 and has the PreCheck Touchless ID lane. CLEAR at Central is for PreCheck members; CLEAR for travelers without PreCheck is at South.
CLE.touchlessId: TSA PreCheck Touchless ID has been available at the Central Security Checkpoint since May 19, 2026, in a dedicated lane, for PreCheck members flying Alaska, American, Delta, Southwest and United. Opt in through your airline's app or profile with your Known Traveler Number and passport details; a Touchless ID indicator then shows on your mobile boarding pass. Carry your physical ID in case an officer asks for it.

gettingThere.rideshare: Uber and Lyft pick up and drop off on either the upper (Departures) or lower (Arrivals) roadway. Taxi pickup is at the south end of Baggage Claim by carousel 11. Drivers should not wait on the lower level; use the free cell phone lot off State Route 237 South, or the Smart Garage, which is free for up to 30 minutes.
gettingThere.transit: The RTA Red Line station is on the lower level of the main terminal. Use the elevators or escalators in the center of the ticketing and baggage claim levels. Trains run every 15 minutes for most of the day and reach Tower City downtown in under 30 minutes. RTA's fare is $2.50 per ride or $5 for an all-day pass. Station machines take credit and debit cards, and mobile tickets must be scanned at the validator.
gettingThere.driving: Smart Garage: $26/day or $7/hour, joined to the terminal by a skywalk on level 3 and a walkway on level 1; reservations open 24 hours ahead. Orange Lot: $21/day, connected to the garage by skywalk. Blue Lot (covered, north of the terminal): $24/day. Premium Reserved Red Lot: $29/day, reservation only. Brown Lot (4960 Rocky River Drive): $15/day or $13 online, with a shuttle every 15 minutes. Curbside Valet: $37/day, on the upper roadway by Door 1. All lots take credit cards only.

construction2026: CLEvolution, CLE's modernization program, began construction in July 2026 with the Gold Lot, about 1,600 new parking spaces, due to open in spring 2027. CLE says to follow its social media for construction changes to parking, roadways or airport access.

Planned next: an eight-level garage with about 6,000 spaces, a ground transportation center and a relocated RTA Red Line station. NEOtrans reports the ground transportation center is due by 2029, and a new terminal and access roads could follow as early as 2032. This research found no current curb, checkpoint or Red Line closures from this work.
CLE.bagDrop: Southwest: check bags at least 45 minutes before a domestic flight (60 minutes for international); check in at least 30 minutes before a domestic flight; be at the gate 10 minutes before departure. Delta: bags 45 minutes before domestic departure, 30 minutes without bags; Delta lists no CLE exception. American and United: check in and check bags 45 minutes before domestic departure. Alaska: 50 minutes for domestic flights, with or without bags (AP, May 2025).
tips: Any checkpoint gets you to every gate. North closes at 7pm and South at 7:45pm; after that, use Central, open until 10pm.
Early morning is the busiest time. In TSA's September 2026 counts, 4-7am was the peak, especially 5-6am. South opens first, at 3:15am.
PreCheck members on Alaska, American, Delta, Southwest or United can use the Touchless ID lane at the Central Checkpoint after opting in with their airline
The RTA Red Line stops under the terminal and reaches downtown in under 30 minutes for $2.50
The Blue and Red lots can fill up. Check parking status on clevelandairport.com, or reserve the Smart Garage or Brown Lot online.
Flying Air Canada? CLE says it has no online check-in for CLE departures, so allow time at the counter

faq.q: How early should I get to Cleveland Hopkins airport (CLE)?
faq.a: CLE recommends arriving no later than 2 hours before a domestic flight and 3 hours before an international flight. Early mornings, especially 5-6am, are the busiest time at security.

faq.q: Which security checkpoint should I use at CLE?
faq.a: Any of them. All three checkpoints connect to all gates. Hours: South 3:15am-7:45pm, North 3:45am-7:00pm, Central 3:45am-10:00pm.

faq.q: Can I take the RTA Red Line to CLE?
faq.a: Yes. The Red Line station is on the lower level of the main terminal. Trains run every 15 minutes most of the day, take under 30 minutes to Tower City, and cost $2.50.

faq.q: Does CLE have TSA PreCheck, CLEAR and Touchless ID?
faq.a: Yes. CLE lists PreCheck at all three checkpoints. CLEAR is at Central (for PreCheck members) and South. Touchless ID is at the Central Checkpoint for Alaska, American, Delta, Southwest and United.

faq.q: Which concourse is Southwest at CLE?
faq.a: Concourse B, Gates 7-11. Delta also uses Concourse B. United and American use Concourse C, and Frontier and Avelo use Concourse A.

Connecting passengers, the majority at CLT, don't go through security.

Monday, Tuesday and Saturday mornings; Thursday, Friday and Sunday evenings (airport parking guidance)

CLT.precheckNotes: Checkpoint 2 is CLT's designated Main TSA PreCheck checkpoint (3:45am-11:00pm), and Checkpoints 1 and 3 are not listed with PreCheck lanes. One older line on the airport's security page still says PreCheck is at 'checkpoint A', which conflicts with the current hours table.
CLT.touchlessId: TSA PreCheck Touchless ID launched at CLT on Dec 23, 2025, with a dedicated lane at Checkpoint 2. At launch only American Airlines offered it at CLT. AAdvantage members opt in through their profile with a passport on file and must renew annually. American and TSA confirmed in April 2026 that it is available at all American hubs, including CLT.

gettingThere.rideshare: Drop off at the upper-level (Departures/Ticketing) curb. App-based ride pickups are on the Departures/Ticketing level, inner lanes, Zones 1-3. The airport suggests going against the grain to avoid congestion: drop off at Arrivals and pick up at Departures.
gettingThere.transit: CLT lists CATS Sprinter bus service among its ground-transportation options; route frequency and travel time to Uptown were not verified
gettingThere.driving: Address: 5501 Josh Birmingham Parkway. From I-85 take Exit 32 or 33; from Uptown take I-77 S to Exit 6B (Billy Graham Pkwy, about 5 miles) or US-74 W (Wilkinson Blvd). Little Rock Road between I-85 and Wilkinson Blvd has been renamed North Josh Birmingham Parkway. Of about 25,000 parking spaces, 15,000 can be booked online, and lots can show 'Reservation Only' when drive-up spaces are full. Free shuttles from the lots run 24/7 every 10-15 minutes.

construction2026: Terminal renovations (new seating with power, flooring, lighting) are complete on Concourses A, B, C and the Atrium, and the airport says work will move to Concourses D and E
A fourth parallel runway is under construction and is reported to open in fall 2027. This is airfield work, not a terminal or roadway change.
tips: After 8pm, Checkpoints 1 and 3 close and only Checkpoint 2 stays open, until 11pm. Once all checkpoints close, no one is allowed past security.
Every checkpoint reaches every gate, so pick the shortest line. The CLT website and app show live checkpoint wait times.
Plan to reach your parking space 30 minutes before you want to be in the terminal. Book parking online on busy days: drive-up spaces can sell out, but online bookings are still honored.
TSA PreCheck members flying American can use the Touchless ID lane at Checkpoint 2 if they've opted in through their AAdvantage profile
With a big group or lots of bags, drop people and luggage at the upper-level Departures curb before parking

faq.q: How early should I get to Charlotte airport (CLT)?
faq.a: CLT advises being inside the terminal at least 2 hours before a domestic flight and 3 hours before an international flight. If you're parking, it also suggests reaching your parking space 30 minutes before that.

faq.q: Which security checkpoint should I use at CLT?
faq.a: Any one: all concourses and gates are reachable from every checkpoint. TSA PreCheck is at Checkpoint 2 (3:45am-11pm), and after 8pm Checkpoint 2 is the only checkpoint open.

faq.q: Does CLT have TSA PreCheck Touchless ID?
faq.a: Yes. It launched Dec 23, 2025, with a dedicated lane at Checkpoint 2, and at launch only American Airlines offered it at CLT. AAdvantage members with TSA PreCheck must opt in and add a valid passport to their profile.

officialArrivalAdvice.international: CMH says to arrive 2 hours before an international flight

checkpoints.notes: CMH lists hours of 4:00am-8:30pm. CLEAR's site lists CLEAR+ at Checkpoint B, 4am-7pm daily. It was the busiest of the three checkpoints in TSA's counts for Sep 13-19, 2026, with about 42% of screenings.

CMH.betweenTerminals: CMH has one terminal with three concourses (A, B and C). Each concourse has its own security checkpoint, and the concourses are not connected after security. You can only use the shops and restaurants in your own concourse. To change concourses you must leave and go through security again.

securityWaits.summary: CMH shows live average wait times on its security page. It does not publish typical peak times. In TSA's hourly screening counts for Sep 13-19, 2026, CMH was busiest from 4am to 7am, peaking 5-6am. There were smaller rises around noon-1pm and 2-4pm, and traffic was light after 7pm. Thursday, Friday, Sunday and Monday were the busiest days that week; Tuesday and Saturday were the quietest.
busiestTimes: Thursdays, Fridays, Sundays and Mondays (TSA counts, week of Sep 13, 2026)

CMH.precheckNotes: Upgraded Points' CMH guide (updated Sep 2026) says TSA PreCheck is at all three checkpoints and CLEAR is near all three. CMH's security page does not list PreCheck lanes by checkpoint. Since Sep 8, 2026, CMH has taken part in GateSide by TSA PreCheck, which lets approved visitors with PreCheck or a Known Traveler Number go through the PreCheck lane to accompany a traveler. Apply online with TSA 1 to 3 days ahead.
CMH.touchlessId: The Points Guy's table of TSA PreCheck Touchless ID airports (May 2026, based on TSA.gov) lists CMH for American, Delta, United, Southwest and Alaska. CMH's own site does not say which checkpoints have the lane. To use it, add your Known Traveler Number and passport details to your airline profile and opt in; a Touchless ID indicator then shows on your boarding pass. Carry your physical ID.

gettingThere.rideshare: Drop-off is at the curb on the Departures level. Curbside parking is not allowed, and drivers must stay with their cars; unattended cars are ticketed or towed. Uber and Lyft pick up in the ground transportation area: cross the Arrivals drive from Baggage Claim. Taxis are on the ground transportation level. Drivers can wait in the free cell phone waiting lot between the control tower and the terminal, or use the Green Lot, which has a one-hour grace period.
gettingThere.transit: COTA Line 7 (Mt. Vernon) serves the airport from downtown Columbus; on the timetable effective May 4, 2026, every other trip runs to the airport and the rest go to Easton. The fare is $2, capped at $4.50 a day with digital payment.
gettingThere.driving: The garage at 4600 International Gateway connects to the terminal. Short-term parking (Level 4): $7 first hour, $30 per 24 hours. Long-term parking (Levels 1-6): $7 first hour, $24 per 24 hours. Red Lot: $11 per 24 hours. Green Lot: $9 per 24 hours, first hour free. Shuttles from the Red and Green lots run 24 hours a day, every 15-18 minutes. Valet at the curbside ticketing area: $18 first hour, $30 per 24 hours. The Walking Lot closed on May 4, 2026.

construction2026: CMH Next, a new terminal, is under construction and due to open in early 2029. The current terminal stays open until then.
The Walking Lot closed to new parkers on May 4, 2026, to make room for a public safety building. CMH points former Walking Lot users to valet, the garage, or the Red and Green shuttle lots.

Roadways are shifting as work goes on. A new permanent eastbound International Gateway roadway opened in September 2026. CMH says to check current roadway advisories and to allow extra time to arrive and park.
The new terminal's arrivals and departures roadways are built but not yet in use (Sep 2026). The lower arrivals roadway will open first.
CMH.bagDrop: Southwest: check bags at least 45 minutes before a domestic flight (60 minutes for international), check in at least 30 minutes before a domestic flight, and be at the gate 10 minutes before departure. Delta: bags 45 minutes before domestic departure, 30 minutes without bags; Delta lists no CMH exception. American and United: check in and check bags 45 minutes before domestic departure. Alaska: 50 minutes for domestic flights, with or without bags (AP, May 2025).
tips: Go to the right concourse. Southwest uses A; American and United use B; Delta, Air Canada, Alaska, Breeze, Frontier, JetBlue, Lufthansa and Sun Country use C. The concourses are not connected after security.
All three checkpoints are listed as open 4:00am-8:30pm. CMH says the latest TSA stays open for a delayed flight is 10pm, so clear security before your checkpoint closes.
Early morning is the busiest time. In TSA's September 2026 counts, 4-7am was the peak, especially 5-6am.
Allow extra time to park. The Walking Lot is closed and roads around the terminal are shifting for CMH Next. The cheapest lots (Green and Red) use shuttles that run every 15-18 minutes.
Flying Allegiant? Go to Rickenbacker Airport (LCK), not CMH.

faq.q: How early should I get to Columbus airport (CMH)?
faq.a: CMH says to arrive at least 90 minutes before a domestic flight and 2 hours before an international flight, and to allow extra time to park because of construction. Early mornings, especially 5-6am, are the busiest time at security.

faq.q: Which concourse is my airline at CMH?
faq.a: Southwest is in Concourse A. American and United are in Concourse B. Delta, Air Canada, Alaska, Breeze, Frontier, JetBlue, Lufthansa and Sun Country are in Concourse C.

faq.q: Are CMH's concourses connected after security?
faq.a: No. Each concourse has its own checkpoint, and you cannot walk between concourses after security. Use the checkpoint for your airline's concourse.

faq.q: What time does security open at CMH?
faq.a: CMH lists all three checkpoints as open from 4:00am to 8:30pm. If a flight is delayed, TSA stays open no later than 10pm.

faq.q: Is the new CMH terminal open yet?
faq.a: No. The new terminal is due to open in early 2029. Until then all flights use the current terminal, but construction affects roads and parking, so allow extra time.

CUN.name: Cancún International Airport
CUN.passportControl: Mexico has no separate exit immigration check for departing tourists; your airline checks your passport at check-in. Air arrivals no longer fill in a paper FMM tourist card: you get a passport stamp or an e-gate ticket, and the digital record (FMMd) can be downloaded from Mexico's immigration institute (INM). Keep your passport with its entry stamp and any printed e-gate ticket; UK government advice tells visitors they must show these when leaving. Quintana Roo's Visitax tourist tax applies to all foreign tourists, and spot checks just before security were reported in December 2025, so keep your Visitax QR code handy. Cancún has no US preclearance, so you clear US immigration and customs after you land.

officialArrivalAdvice.international: When you're traveling outside of the United States, we suggest arriving at least 3 hours prior to your departure. (Delta; JetBlue and Southwest also advise 3 hours at Cancún.)

CUN.betweenTerminals: A free inter-terminal shuttle runs between the terminals about every 10 minutes. Terminals are spread out, so tell your driver which terminal you need.

securityWaits.summary: This research found no published security wait times for Cancún. In December 2025, reporters described Visitax spot checks just before the security area; passengers without a QR code were sent to pay on the spot.

gettingThere.rideshare: The Hotel Zone is about 16 km from the airport, roughly a 20-30 minute drive. Uber serves the airport and says the average trip from Cancún takes about 24 minutes. Most travelers pre-book a private transfer or shuttle; give the driver your terminal.
gettingThere.transit: ADO buses serve Terminals 2, 3 and 4 and link the airport with the downtown Cancún bus station, Playa del Carmen and Tulum; ADO says some routes leave every 15 minutes. ADO's Hotel Zone service uses a fixed stop at Punta Cancún, not individual hotels; it lists about 45 minutes and up to 9 departures a day from the airport. The Tren Maya Cancún Airport station is across Highway 180, and a shuttle bus links it to all four terminals.
gettingThere.driving: All terminals have short- and long-term parking. The Terminal 3 lot is directly in front of the building, open 24/7, and takes pesos or major cards at pay machines.

construction2026: Terminal 1 is being rebuilt. ASUR expects the new terminal to open in the fourth quarter of 2026 (El CEO, July 2026). It has not said which airlines will use it, so check your terminal before you leave.
Terminal 4 is being expanded.
CUN.bagDrop: American: 60 minutes for check-in and bags on flights from outside the US. Delta: check in at least 1 hour before departure; Cancún is not on its list of airports with earlier cutoffs. United: at least 1 hour before international departures. Southwest: have your passport verified at the ticket counter at least 60 minutes before departure. JetBlue lists ticket counter hours of 7:00am-3:00pm at Terminal 4; this research found no published cutoff.
tips: Check your terminal before you leave the hotel: American, Delta and United use T3; JetBlue, Southwest, Frontier and Sun Country use T4; Alaska is listed at T2.
Keep your passport with its entry stamp and any printed e-gate ticket until you have left Mexico.
Pay Visitax only on the official site, visitax.gob.mx, and keep the QR code on your phone for spot checks.
Bring a card if you fly JetBlue; its Terminal 4 lobby does not accept cash.
From the Hotel Zone, allow 20-30 minutes by car, or about 45 minutes on ADO's Punta Cancún service.

faq.q: How early should I get to Cancún Airport for a flight to the US?
faq.a: Three hours. Delta, JetBlue and Southwest all advise arriving 3 hours before departure. American, Delta and United close check-in and bag drop 60 minutes before departure.

faq.q: Which Cancún terminal is my flight to the US from?
faq.a: American, Delta and United use Terminal 3. JetBlue, Southwest, Frontier and Sun Country use Terminal 4. Alaska is listed at Terminal 2. Check your booking, since assignments can change.

faq.q: Do I go through immigration when leaving Mexico?
faq.a: No separate exit check. Your airline checks your passport. Keep your passport with its entry stamp and any e-gate ticket in case you are asked.

faq.q: Do I need an FMM tourist card to fly home from Cancún?
faq.a: Not a paper one. Air arrivals get a passport stamp or e-gate ticket, and the digital FMM can be downloaded from INM. If you lose your entry proof, you may have to pay a replacement fee at the airport immigration office.

faq.q: Do I have to pay Visitax before leaving Cancún?
faq.a: Visitax is required of all foreign tourists in Quintana Roo. Pay it online at visitax.gob.mx. Spot checks before security have been reported, so keep your QR code ready.

checkpoints.notes: CVG's single checkpoint serves both concourses. CVG says it is normally open daily 3:30am-9:20pm and that hours can change without notice; Southwest's CVG page lists 3:30am-8:50pm. CLEAR's site lists CLEAR+ on the Departures level near the checkpoint, 4am-7:30pm Sunday, Monday, Thursday and Friday and 4am-7pm Tuesday, Wednesday and Saturday.
checkpoints.name: Main security checkpoint

notes: Check in on the Ticketing level. Delta and Frontier counters are left of the main entrance. American, United, Air Canada, Sun Country, Viva Aerobus, Southwest, Alaska, Breeze and Allegiant are to the right.
Delta has most of the gates in Concourse B (Local 12, 2023). All international arrivals without preclearance use Concourse B.
Southwest lists its CVG gates as A3 and A5. Its counter opens 120 minutes before the first departing flight.
This research could not find a current official list of airlines by concourse. Check your boarding pass or the airport screens for your gate.
Concourse A has gates A1-A23 and Concourse B has gates B1-B28

CVG.betweenTerminals: Single terminal with one checkpoint. After security, take the escalators down to the Transportation Tunnel, then ride the train, use the moving walkways or walk to Concourse A or B. CVG says Concourse B is under 1,500 feet from the terminal, about 4 minutes by train or 6 minutes on foot; Concourse A takes about half that time. You can move between the concourses without going through security again.

securityWaits.summary: CVG shows live security wait times on a monitor at the checkpoint entrance and on its website. It does not publish typical peak times. In TSA's hourly screening counts for Sep 13-19, 2026, CVG was busiest from 4am to 7am, peaking 6-7am. Traffic stayed fairly steady from 9am to about 5pm, with small rises around 10-11am and 1-2pm, and was light after 7pm. Thursday, Friday, Monday and Sunday were the busiest days that week; Tuesday, Saturday and Wednesday were the quietest.
busiestTimes: Thursdays, Fridays, Mondays and Sundays (TSA counts, week of Sep 13, 2026)

CVG.precheckNotes: CVG's checkpoint has a TSA PreCheck entry next to the general and assistance lanes. CLEAR is on the Departures level near the checkpoint. CVG's security page also lists TSA PreCheck Touchless ID, with dedicated lanes for enrolled travelers on participating airlines.
CVG.touchlessId: CVG says TSA PreCheck Touchless ID is available, with dedicated lanes for enrolled travelers on participating airlines. The Points Guy's table (May 2026, based on TSA.gov) lists CVG for American, Delta, United, Southwest and Alaska. Add your Known Traveler Number and passport details to your airline profile and opt in; a Touchless ID indicator then shows on your boarding pass. Carry your physical ID.

gettingThere.rideshare: Uber, Lyft and taxis (zTrip) pick up at Ground Transport East on the Baggage Claim level, not at the terminal curb. Regular passenger pickup is on the outer curb. Drivers meeting arriving flights can wait in the free Cell Phone Lot.
gettingThere.transit: TANK Route 2X runs between downtown Cincinnati and the airport every 30 minutes. It leaves from the Baggage Claim level; follow signs for Ground Transport East to Public Transit. TANK's local cash fare is $2, exact fare only.
gettingThere.driving: Terminal Garage (next to the terminal): $23/day, credit card only. Premium Reserved (garage level C, rows 28-30): $27/day, prepaid reservation only. Valet: $35/day, open 24/7; follow signs for Arrivals, then Valet. ValuPark: $12/day, with 24/7 pickup and drop-off and luggage help. Economy Lot: $10/day, shuttles every 15 minutes. You can reserve the garage, ValuPark and Economy Lot online.

construction2026: Elevate CVG, a $575 million program, is under way. It replaces the baggage system, expands the ticketing area and the security checkpoint, and renovates the tunnel, both concourses and restrooms. Completion is expected in 2029. CVG says the work is phased to limit the impact on travelers. This research found no current checkpoint, curb or garage closures from this work.
CVG.bagDrop: Delta at CVG: check in 45 minutes before a domestic flight whether or not you check bags, and 1 hour before an international flight; be at the gate 15 minutes before departure. Southwest: check bags at least 45 minutes before a domestic flight (60 minutes for international), check in at least 30 minutes before a domestic flight, and be at the gate 10 minutes before departure. American and United: check in and check bags 45 minutes before domestic departure. Alaska: 50 minutes for domestic flights, with or without bags (AP, May 2025).
tips: There is one checkpoint for all gates. After security, take the train or walk through the tunnel: about 4 minutes by train or 6 minutes on foot to Concourse B.
Flying Delta? CVG has a stricter Delta cutoff than most airports: be checked in 45 minutes before a domestic flight even without bags.
Early morning is the busiest time. In TSA's September 2026 counts, 4-7am was the peak, especially 6-7am.
The checkpoint is normally open 3:30am-9:20pm. CVG says hours can change without notice.
Uber, Lyft and taxis pick up at Ground Transport East on the Baggage Claim level, not at the curb

faq.q: How early should I get to Cincinnati airport (CVG)?
faq.a: CVG recommends arriving at least 2 hours before your flight and allowing at least 30 minutes for screening. Early mornings, especially 6-7am, are the busiest time at security.

faq.q: How many security checkpoints does CVG have?
faq.a: One. The main checkpoint serves both Concourse A and Concourse B. It is normally open 3:30am-9:20pm.

faq.q: How do I get from security to my gate at CVG?
faq.a: Go down to the Transportation Tunnel and take the train, the moving walkways or walk. Concourse B is about 4 minutes by train or 6 minutes on foot; Concourse A is about half that.

faq.q: Can I take a bus to CVG?
faq.a: Yes. TANK Route 2X runs between downtown Cincinnati and the airport every 30 minutes. At the airport it stops at Ground Transport East on the Baggage Claim level.

faq.q: Does CVG have TSA PreCheck, CLEAR and Touchless ID?
faq.a: Yes. The checkpoint has a PreCheck entry, CLEAR is on the Departures level near the checkpoint, and CVG lists dedicated Touchless ID lanes for participating airlines.
