DCA.name: Ronald Reagan Washington National Airport

officialArrivalAdvice.domestic: Arrive 2 hours before domestic flights (the airport's security FAQ suggests 90-120 minutes); check with your airline too

terminals.name: Terminal 1 (Gates A1-A9)

checkpoints.notes: Serves only Air Canada, Frontier and Southwest. Security page lists 4:00am-9:00pm; the airport FAQ says Terminal 1 generally opens at 4:30am.
checkpoints.name: Terminal 1 checkpoint (Gates A1-A9)

notes: Formerly Terminal A; 9 gates.
Not connected airside to Terminal 2: moving between Terminal 1 and Terminal 2 requires going through security again.
Parking Garage 1 serves Air Canada, Frontier and Southwest.
Rideshare pickup is on the third (outer) curb.

terminals.name: Terminal 2 (Gates B10-E59)

checkpoints.notes: Closest to American Airlines. Open 4:00am-11:00pm.
checkpoints.name: Terminal 2 North checkpoint

checkpoints.notes: Closest to Alaska, Delta, JetBlue and United; also serves American. Open 4:00am-9:00pm.
checkpoints.name: Terminal 2 South checkpoint

notes: Formerly Terminal B/C; 49 gates, plus the 14-gate American regional concourse opened in April 2021.
Since the Project Journey checkpoints opened in November 2021, passengers can move between Terminal 2 gate areas without re-screening.
The Metrorail station connects directly to the Terminal 2 concourse level by two enclosed pedestrian bridges.
Parking Garage 2 serves American, Alaska, Delta, JetBlue and United.

DCA.betweenTerminals: Terminal 2 gates B10-E59 are connected after security, but going between Terminal 1 and Terminal 2 requires re-clearing security. Free airport shuttles run 24/7 between the terminals and parking facilities.
DCA.precheckNotes: Each checkpoint at Reagan National has a designated PreCheck lane. Checkpoint hours: Terminal 2 North 4:00am-11:00pm, Terminal 2 South 4:00am-9:00pm, Terminal 1 4:00am-9:00pm (FAQ says Terminal 1 generally opens 4:30am).
DCA.touchlessId: TSA lists Touchless ID at 65 airports and tells travelers to check with their airline. Delta lists DCA as a participating airport with dedicated Touchless ID bag drop. A March 2026 third-party list shows Alaska, American, Delta and United participating at DCA.

gettingThere.rideshare: Terminal 2: meet your ride on the Baggage Claim (Arrivals) Level, 1st floor, outer curb (select Zone 1-4; green flags mark zones). Terminal 1: third (outer) curb. The airport does not publish separate rideshare drop-off instructions.
gettingThere.transit: Metrorail Blue and Yellow lines stop at the Reagan National Airport station, linked to the Terminal 2 concourse level by two enclosed bridges; Terminal 1 is reached via the airport shuttle (exit to the street-side curb) or a walk inside the terminal. Daytime fares $2.25-$6.75.
gettingThere.driving: Parking Garage 1 (Terminal 1 airlines), Parking Garage 2 (Terminal 2 airlines) and the Economy Lot, all with 24/7 shuttle service. Reserving is the only way to guarantee a space and price. Economy Lot capacity is reduced by about 40 percent while a new parking structure is built (construction extends into 2026). The cell phone lot is listed as closed; garages 1 and 2 are free for up to 60 minutes.

construction2026: Economy Lot: a new parking structure is under construction, cutting Economy capacity by about 40 percent; the airport says construction extends into 2026 and strongly encourages advance reservations.

Metrorail: 2026 weekend closures of the Reagan National Airport and Potomac Yard stations (March 7-8, May 9-10, May 16-17) and additional Crystal City weekends for a new Crystal City entrance (expected to open spring 2027); Metro said closures could add about 15 minutes, with shuttle buses.

Terminal 1 replacement (new facility replacing gates A1-A9, no added gates) is in planning; as of August 2026 construction was expected to start in 2027 and finish in December 2032, subject to change. The road outside Terminal 1 would be reconfigured.
DCA.bagDrop: Delta at DCA: bags must be checked and check-in completed at least 45 minutes before domestic departure (with or without bags), 1 hour for international; bags not accepted more than 6 hours before departure.
tips: Southwest, Frontier and Air Canada use Terminal 1 (gates A1-A9), which has its own checkpoint and is not connected airside to Terminal 2.
In Terminal 2, the North checkpoint is closest to American and stays open until 11pm; the South checkpoint (closest to Alaska, Delta, JetBlue, United) closes at 9pm.
Delta at DCA requires check-in 45 minutes before departure even without bags, longer than Delta's usual 30-minute no-bag cutoff.
The Metro station connects straight into Terminal 2's concourse level, which makes it the simplest way to avoid airport traffic and parking shortages.
The Economy Lot has lost about 40 percent of its capacity to garage construction, so reserve parking ahead.

faq.q: How early should I get to Reagan National (DCA)?
faq.a: The airport recommends arriving 2 hours before domestic flights, and its security FAQ suggests at least 90-120 minutes. Delta requires check-in at least 45 minutes before departure at DCA.

faq.q: Which terminal is Southwest at DCA?
faq.a: Southwest, Frontier and Air Canada use Terminal 1 (gates A1-A9). American, Delta, United, Alaska and JetBlue use Terminal 2.

faq.q: Can I walk between Terminal 1 and Terminal 2 at DCA after security?
faq.a: No. The airport says you need to go through security again to move between Terminal 1 and Terminal 2, though all Terminal 2 gates are connected after security.

DEN.name: Denver International Airport

officialArrivalAdvice.domestic: Arrive at the airport at least 2 hours before your flight (DEN fall-break guidance, Oct 2026)

terminals.name: Jeppesen Terminal (Great Hall)

checkpoints.notes: Wikipedia lists standard screening 3:30am-1am and PreCheck 4am-8:45pm daily; Upgraded Points lists 3am-1am. 17 lanes.
checkpoints.name: West Security Checkpoint, Level 6

checkpoints.notes: Opened Aug 2025, 17 lanes, north of the Southwest ticket counters. Entrance 1 standard, Entrance 2 priority and CLEAR without PreCheck, Entrance 3 PreCheck. Wikipedia lists standard 3am-8pm and PreCheck 4am-8pm; Upgraded Points lists 3am-1am.
checkpoints.name: East Security Checkpoint, Level 6

notes: Check in on Level 5, then take escalators or elevators up to Level 6 for security
The old North, South and A-Bridge checkpoints are permanently closed; all screening is on Level 6
Concourse A is a walk across the pedestrian bridge after security; Concourses B and C (and A) are also served by the underground train inside security
Great Hall renovation has closed some terminal areas; DEN advises going to the east or west side for your airline

DEN.betweenTerminals: Single terminal. The train inside security runs from Jeppesen Terminal to Concourses A, B and C (about 6 minutes to the farthest stop), and the bridge to Concourse A can be walked.

securityWaits.summary: DEN expected about 965,000 travelers over fall break 2026 (Oct 8-19). It forecast security peaks of 7-11am and 2-6pm, with Thursdays, Fridays and Mondays the busiest days.

DEN.precheckNotes: PreCheck lanes are at both Level 6 checkpoints, reportedly 4am to about 8:45pm (West) and to 8pm (East), so late-evening flyers may have only standard lanes. At the East checkpoint, PreCheck uses Entrance 3.
DEN.touchlessId: TSA PreCheck Touchless ID is listed at DEN for Alaska, American, Delta, Southwest and United (opt in through your airline profile)

gettingThere.rideshare: Drop-off is on Level 5 outside your airline's check-in. Uber and Lyft pickup is on Level 5 outside doors 504-510 (west) and 505-513 (east).
gettingThere.transit: RTD A Line train to Denver Union Station takes about 37 minutes; trains run about every 15 minutes at peak and every 30 minutes off-peak
gettingThere.driving: Peña Boulevard into the airport can get very busy, so leave extra time. Parking garages fill quickly at busy times; economy parking is $20/day and the Pikes Peak shuttle lot $10/day. Curbside waiting is not allowed; use the free cell phone lot.

construction2026: Great Hall renovation continues in Jeppesen Terminal, closing some areas, including parts of the food court
Eight more standard security lanes on the north end of Level 5 were scheduled for late summer 2026; this research could not confirm they have opened
Peña Boulevard widening and managed lanes are still being planned (preferred option due end of 2026); construction would follow the final decision expected in early 2028
DEN.bagDrop: United: check in at least 45 minutes before domestic departure (60 minutes for international). Southwest: checked bags at the counter 45 minutes before domestic departure. Delta: bags 45 minutes before domestic departure.
tips: Security is on Level 6, one floor above check-in on Level 5; the old Level 5 checkpoints and the A-Bridge checkpoint are closed
Go to the east or west side of the terminal that matches your airline; the East checkpoint is just north of Southwest's ticket counters
Flying from Concourse A? You can walk across the bridge after security instead of taking the train
Peña Boulevard traffic can get very busy and garages fill quickly at peak times, so build in a driving buffer
Reported evening closing times differ between sources (East may close around 8pm), so late-night flyers should check flydenver.com for current checkpoint hours

faq.q: How early should I get to Denver airport?
faq.a: DEN recommends arriving at least 2 hours before your flight. During busy periods its peaks run 7-11am and 2-6pm, so allow extra time for Peña Boulevard traffic and parking.

faq.q: Where is security at Denver airport now?
faq.a: All screening is at the East and West checkpoints on Level 6 of the Great Hall. The South, North and A-Bridge checkpoints closed when the East checkpoint opened in August 2025.

faq.q: How do I get from Denver airport to downtown by train?
faq.a: Take the RTD A Line to Denver Union Station, about 37 minutes. Trains run roughly every 15 minutes at peak times.

DFW.betweenTerminals: Skylink train inside security links all five terminals, 24 hours a day, every 2 minutes; average ride about 5 minutes, up to 9 minutes end to end. Terminal Link shuttle runs outside security every 8-10 minutes after 5am.

securityWaits.summary: Live waits are shown per checkpoint on DFW's website and app (buckets: 0-10, 11-20, 20+ min). DFW's construction page forecast summer peaks in Terminal D at 6-9am and 4-8pm daily.

DFW.precheckNotes: TSA PreCheck is available in Terminals A, C, D and E (not listed for B). In Terminal C, C10 is PreCheck-only and C20 has general plus PreCheck.
DFW.touchlessId: Dedicated TSA PreCheck Touchless ID lanes for American, Delta and United travelers at checkpoints A21, C21, D30 and E16

gettingThere.rideshare: Drop-off is at the upper-level curb of every terminal (active loading only). In Terminal C, ground transportation stops have moved to the lower-level curb during construction.
gettingThere.transit: DART Orange Line from Terminal A goes direct to downtown Dallas (DART has listed about 50 minutes to West End station); DART Silver Line and TEXRail (to downtown Fort Worth) leave from Terminal B; TRE trains stop at CentrePort/DFW Airport station with a TRE Link shuttle to the terminals
gettingThere.driving: Enter from SH 183 on the south or SH 114 / I-635 on the north; International Parkway runs north-south past every terminal. Terminals A, B and C now use new right-hand exits from International Parkway. Express South lot is closed for Terminal F construction; Terminal C south garage is closed.

construction2026: Terminal C rebuild (curb to gate) continues through 2029; the C30 check-in area and checkpoint are closed
Terminal C south garage (C26-C39) closed for reconstruction
Express South parking lot closed for construction of Terminal F, which is set to open in 2027
Terminal C ground transportation and shuttle stops relocated to the lower-level curb
New right-hand exits into Terminals A, B and C from International Parkway were completed in 2026, replacing the old left-hand exits
DFW.bagDrop: American: check in and drop bags at least 45 minutes before domestic flights and 60 minutes before international flights. Delta: bags 45 minutes before domestic departure (30 minutes to check in without bags). United: 45 minutes for domestic check-in.
tips: Check which terminal and checkpoint your flight uses: DFW has multiple checkpoints per terminal, and once through security, Skylink connects every terminal
Terminal C's C30 checkpoint is closed for construction; use C10 (PreCheck only), C11 or C20
CLEAR lanes exist only at checkpoint E18; Touchless ID lanes are at A21, C21, D30 and E16
Allow extra time for the Terminal C construction zone: the south garage is closed and ground transportation stops are on the lower level
Terminal Link stops are on the upper level of every terminal except Terminal D
DFW's travel tips page promotes a free Fast Pass that lets you book a security screening time; check dfwairport.com for current availability

faq.q: How early should I get to DFW Airport?
faq.a: DFW advises arriving at least 2 hours before domestic flights and 3 hours before international flights, and leaving extra time for construction-related traffic.

faq.q: Can I go between terminals after security at DFW?
faq.a: Yes. The Skylink train runs inside security, 24 hours a day, with trains every 2 minutes, and links all five terminals. Rides average about 5 minutes.

faq.q: Where is CLEAR at DFW?
faq.a: DFW's security page lists CLEAR only at checkpoint E18 in Terminal E, with CLEAR enrollment at checkpoints E8, E16 and E18.

DJT.name: President Donald J. Trump International Airport, formerly Palm Beach International

officialArrivalAdvice.domestic: The airport's website gives no set arrival time. Delta recommends arriving at least 2 hours before a domestic flight at U.S. airports, and this airport is not on its list of exceptions. JetBlue's page for this airport suggests about 90 minutes, and Southwest's suggests 60 minutes.
officialArrivalAdvice.international: Southwest's page for this airport suggests 90 minutes before an international flight. The airport itself gives no set time.

terminals.name: Concourses A and B

checkpoints.notes: One of two checkpoints on Level 2, at opposite ends of the terminal. Hours are not published by the airport. CLEAR lists CLEAR+ and TSA PreCheck lanes here from 4:30am to 6:30pm. TSA's screening counts call it DJT A/B. In mid-September 2026 it was in use from about 4am, was busiest 5-7am and 10am-noon, and was very light after 7pm.
checkpoints.name: Concourse A/B checkpoint

notes: Concourse A is the ground-level concourse (gates A1-A4) used for smaller aircraft. Allegiant, Avelo and Bahamasair are listed there.
Concourse B has gates B1-B12 and B14. American, Southwest, United, Sun Country and Avelo are listed there.
Southwest lists its gates as B3 and B5. Its ticket counter opens 90 minutes before the first departing flight.
Customs and immigration are on the lower level, west side, reached from Concourses A and B.

terminals.name: Concourse C

checkpoints.notes: The other Level 2 checkpoint. JetBlue's page lists the checkpoint as open 4:00am to 10:30pm. CLEAR lists CLEAR+ and TSA PreCheck lanes here from 4:30am to 8pm Sunday to Tuesday and 4:30am to 7:30pm Wednesday to Saturday. TSA's screening counts call it DJT C. In mid-September 2026 it was busiest 9-11am and had a second rise from 5pm to 7pm.
checkpoints.name: Concourse C checkpoint

notes: Gates C1-C12, C14 and C16
JetBlue lists Level 3, Concourse C. Its ticket counter is open 4:10am to 7:30pm and its lobby is cashless.
Delta, JetBlue and American carried the most passengers in September 2025 (airport traffic report)

DJT.betweenTerminals: One terminal with three concourses and two checkpoints. One checkpoint serves Concourses A and B; the other serves Concourse C. Concourses A and B are connected after security, but A/B and C are not. The airport is only in early design for a post-security connector, so use the checkpoint for your airline's concourse.

securityWaits.summary: This research found no typical peak times published by the airport. In TSA's hourly screening counts for Sep 13-19, 2026 (mid-September, the airport's quiet season), the airport was busiest from 9am to noon, peaking 10-11am. There was a second early peak from 5am to 7am, peaking 6-7am. Traffic eased after noon, held fairly steady until about 7pm and was very light after that. The Concourse C checkpoint had a late-afternoon rise from 5pm to 7pm. Friday, Thursday, Sunday and Monday were the busiest days that week; Tuesday and Saturday were the quietest. Winter is much busier. The airport's traffic reports show 992,435 passengers in March 2026, about twice the 498,729 of September 2025. January and February 2026 each had more than 800,000.
busiestTimes: Fridays, Thursdays, Sundays and Mondays (TSA counts, week of Sep 13, 2026)
January to March, with March the busiest month in the airport's 2026 reports

DJT.precheckNotes: TSA PreCheck lanes are at both checkpoints. CLEAR lists combined CLEAR+ and TSA PreCheck lanes at the A/B checkpoint (4:30am-6:30pm) and the C checkpoint (4:30am-8pm Sunday to Tuesday, 4:30am-7:30pm Wednesday to Saturday). The airport says PreCheck enrollment is available through CLEAR at every checkpoint with no appointment.
DJT.touchlessId: A March 2026 list of TSA PreCheck Touchless ID airports shows this airport (as PBI) for American, Delta and Southwest. Southwest's airport page also lists a Touchless ID checkpoint here. You opt in through your airline profile and need a valid passport.

gettingThere.rideshare: Uber drops off curbside at the terminal; Departures is Level 3. Rideshare pickup is on the outer curb of Level 3, across the street from the terminal exit. Taxis use the Ground Transportation desk on the west end of Level 1.
gettingThere.transit: Palm Tran routes 2 and 44 serve the airport; the bus stop is on the outer curb of Level 1. From Tri-Rail's West Palm Beach station (203 South Tamarind Avenue), Palm Tran Route 2 to the airport is free if you show a valid Tri-Rail fare. Rides from the airport to the station need no fare.
gettingThere.driving: The airport has direct access from I-95, Southern Boulevard and Congress Avenue. Parking daily maximums: Premium $34 (outside Baggage Claim, card or SunPass only), Short-Term $21, Long-Term $14 (direct access to the terminal on Level 2), Economy $8 (free shuttle). The Economy shuttle runs 24 hours Sunday to Thursday, but not 1-3am Friday or 1-4am Saturday. The free cell phone waiting lot is at the Travel Plaza, 2050 Belvedere Road. The airport says lots closest to the terminal often fill around the holidays.

construction2026: Concourse B is being remodeled and expanded. Phases 1 and 2 are done. Phase 3 is underway with temporary walls in place, and completion is targeted for summer 2028.

The IATA code changed from PBI to DJT on August 18, 2026, and the airport was renamed President Donald J. Trump International Airport on July 9, 2026. The airport says flights and services are unaffected; search and check bags using DJT.
DJT.bagDrop: Delta: check bags at least 45 minutes before a domestic departure, check in at least 30 minutes ahead without bags, and bags are not accepted more than 6 hours ahead. JetBlue: bags 45 minutes before departure; check-in 30 minutes ahead without bags. Southwest: bags 45 minutes before a domestic flight (60 minutes international); check-in closes 30 minutes before a domestic flight. American and United: check in and check bags 45 minutes before domestic departure (AP, May 2025).
tips: Know your concourse. Delta, JetBlue, Frontier, Breeze, Air Canada and Porter use Concourse C. American, Southwest, United and Sun Country use Concourse B. Allegiant, Avelo and Bahamasair are listed at Concourse A.
Concourse C is not connected to A and B after security, so use the checkpoint for your airline's concourse
Plan more time from January to March. In 2026 the airport handled about twice as many passengers in March as in September.
The airport code is now DJT, not PBI. Use DJT when searching for flights; airline reservations and bag tags now show DJT.
Early flight? The checkpoints were in use from about 4am in mid-September 2026, and the 6-7am hour was one of the busiest.
Parking in Economy for a very early flight? The shuttle does not run 1-3am Friday or 1-4am Saturday. The lot is about a 5-minute walk from the terminal.

faq.q: How early should I get to Palm Beach airport (DJT, formerly PBI)?
faq.a: The airport does not publish a set time. Delta recommends at least 2 hours before a domestic flight; JetBlue suggests about 90 minutes and Southwest 60 minutes at this airport. Allow more time from January to March, when the airport is busiest.

faq.q: Is PBI the same airport as DJT?
faq.a: Yes. Palm Beach International was renamed President Donald J. Trump International Airport on July 9, 2026, and its code changed from PBI to DJT on August 18, 2026. Flights and services did not change.

faq.q: Are the concourses connected after security?
faq.a: Concourses A and B are. Concourse C is not; it has its own checkpoint. Go through the checkpoint for your airline's concourse.

faq.q: Does the airport have CLEAR?
faq.a: Yes. CLEAR has lanes at both the A/B and C checkpoints. TSA PreCheck lanes are also at both.

faq.q: When is the airport busiest?
faq.a: Winter. March 2026 had 992,435 passengers, about twice September 2025. In mid-September 2026 TSA counts, the busiest hours were 9am-noon, peaking 10-11am, with a second peak at 6-7am.

DTW.name: Detroit Metropolitan Wayne County Airport

officialArrivalAdvice.domestic: Arrive 2 hours before a domestic flight
officialArrivalAdvice.international: Arrive 3 hours before an international flight

terminals.name: McNamara Terminal

checkpoints.name: Bridge from the Parking Garage, Level 2

notes: Concourse A is about a mile long; the ExpressTram stops at South Station (gates A1-A28), Terminal Station (A29-A55) and North Station (A56-A78).
Concourses B and C are reached through the tunnel from Concourse A's Terminal Station.
A new real-time parking guidance system (space-level green/red lights, Park Assist app) went live in the McNamara garage in July 2026.
Public buses stop on the Departures Level near Door #1.

terminals.name: Evans Terminal
notes: Serves most non-Delta airlines.
Biometric (facial recognition) boarding is in use at eight international gates.
Parking guidance in the Big Blue Deck (serving Evans) was being installed and expected to go live later in 2026.

DTW.betweenTerminals: Free Terminal-to-Terminal/Westin shuttle departs about every 10 minutes from each terminal's Ground Transportation Center and the Westin entrance; you must clear security again at the other terminal.
DTW.precheckNotes: DTW participates in TSA PreCheck; the airport does not list which checkpoints have PreCheck lanes. The TSA PreCheck enrollment office is in the McNamara Terminal domestic baggage claim area.
DTW.touchlessId: TSA lists Touchless ID at 65 airports and tells travelers to check with their airline. Delta lists DTW as a participating airport with dedicated Touchless ID bag drop. A March 2026 third-party list shows Alaska, American, Delta and Southwest participating at DTW.

gettingThere.rideshare: Rideshare pickup is at the Big Blue Deck, Level 1 (Evans Terminal: cross the skybridge, then down to Level 1) or the McNamara Parking Garage, Level 4 (cross the skybridge to the Ground Transportation Center Level 6 elevators, then down to Level 4).
gettingThere.transit: SMART FAST Michigan Route 261 and SMART Route 125 serve both terminals; Route 280 serves Evans only; AirRide runs to Ann Arbor. Buses stop at the Evans Ground Transportation Center and the McNamara Departures Level near Door #1.
gettingThere.driving: Access is via I-94 and I-275. During MDOT's Restore I-94 project (through 2029), the airport advises using I-275 to Eureka Road and allowing extra time. More than 16,000 parking spaces across the garages.

construction2026: Restore I-94 (Wayne Road to Schaefer Road, about 13 miles, through 2029): since Aug. 1, 2026 eastbound I-94 east of I-275 runs in shared westbound lanes with two lanes each way; the SB Wayne Rd and SB Merriman Rd ramps to EB I-94 and the EB I-94 exit to Ecorse Rd are closed through mid-2027. The airport recommends I-275 to Eureka Road.
I-94/M-39 interchange ramp closures in effect from June 8, 2026 until May 2027.

Dingell Drive tunnels and roadway rehabilitation (the road to the McNamara Terminal) was launched in January 2024 as a year-round, multi-year program expected to finish in 2027; the airport said parking access is not affected.
DTW.bagDrop: Delta (McNamara): domestic bags must be checked at least 45 minutes before departure (30 minutes if no checked bags); bags not accepted more than 6 hours before departure; be at the gate 15 minutes before departure.
tips: Delta and its partners fly from McNamara; nearly every other airline uses Evans. The terminals are not connected after security, so go to the right one.
Through mid-2027, Restore I-94 closes several eastbound I-94 ramps near the airport; the airport recommends I-275 to Eureka Road.
CLEAR is available at both McNamara checkpoints, including the Level 2 checkpoint on the bridge from the parking garage.
McNamara Concourse A is about a mile long; the ExpressTram's South Station serves A1-A28 and North Station serves A56-A78.
The airport's homepage shows live security wait times for both terminals.

faq.q: How early should I get to DTW?
faq.a: The Wayne County Airport Authority recommends arriving 2 hours before a domestic flight and 3 hours before an international flight. Delta requires domestic bags to be checked at least 45 minutes before departure.

faq.q: Which terminal is Delta at Detroit Metro?
faq.a: Delta and partners such as Air France, Aeromexico and WestJet use the McNamara Terminal. American, United, Southwest and most other airlines use the Evans Terminal.

faq.q: How do I get between McNamara and Evans terminals?
faq.a: Take the free Terminal-to-Terminal shuttle, which leaves about every 10 minutes from each terminal's Ground Transportation Center. You must go through security again at the other terminal.

DUB.name: Dublin Airport
DUB.passportControl: Ireland has no routine exit passport control, so no Irish officer checks you on the way out. US preclearance is on the ground floor of Terminal 2, beyond Dublin security: you clear US immigration, customs and agriculture checks in Dublin, so you land in the US as a domestic arrival and skip CBP and TSA lines. CBP lists the facility's hours as 07:00 to 16:30 GMT, and Dublin Airport says most, but not all, direct US flights from Terminal 2 are precleared, so check with your airline. Global Entry members can use kiosks at preclearance, and Mobile Passport Control works for US and Canadian citizens, green card holders and ESTA travellers. Because of preclearance, Delta recommends arriving 4 hours before departure at Dublin; Dublin Airport suggests 3 hours.

officialArrivalAdvice.international: We suggest you arrive at your terminal 3 hours before your long-haul flight. Allow extra time if you are checking bags or travelling in a group.

terminals.name: Terminal 1

checkpoints.notes: Fast Track is on Departures Level 3 (Mezzanine), open 04:00-21:00, €7.99-€13.99 depending on date and time. Book online up to 5 minutes ahead, at a kiosk, or tap a card at the entrance.
checkpoints.name: Departures security

notes: Dublin Airport lists no US airline at T1; Ryanair, Air Canada, WestJet and Air Transat check in here
US flights leave from Terminal 2, a five-minute walk from T1

terminals.name: Terminal 2

checkpoints.notes: Busiest 05:00-12:00. Fast Track is on Departures Level 2, before security, open 04:00-18:00, €7.99-€13.99. Liquids in containers up to 2 litres and electronics can stay in your bag.
checkpoints.name: Departures security

checkpoints.notes: Ground floor, after Dublin security. Wait until the flight screens show your allocated time, then go. Global Entry kiosks and Mobile Passport Control are available. A December 2025 traveller report says some passengers are sent to a bag-screening belt here while others go straight to the immigration desks.
checkpoints.name: U.S. Preclearance

notes: All US airlines at Dublin use T2
Aer Lingus offers an evening-before bag drop
There are only a few shops after US preclearance
Dublin Express route 782 stops at T2 before T1

DUB.betweenTerminals: Terminals 1 and 2 are a five-minute walk apart. All US flights use Terminal 2.

securityWaits.summary: In June 2026, Dublin Airport said 95.2% of departing passengers cleared security in under 15 minutes and 98.2% in under 20 minutes. Terminal 2 security is busiest from 05:00 to 12:00, when most US flights leave. Live times on dublinairport.com and in the app show the median wait over the previous 15 minutes. These figures cover Dublin security only, not the US preclearance queue.

gettingThere.rideshare: Taxis wait outside both terminals and drop you at the kerb near check-in. Dublin Airport estimates a metered fare of €30-45 to or from Dublin city centre. Meter rates are €1.32/km Monday to Saturday 8am-8pm, and €1.81-2.20/km at other times.
gettingThere.transit: Dublin Express route 782 runs from the city quays and Heuston Station to the airport from about 03:30 to 01:00 (August 2026 timetable), stopping at Terminal 2 first. From Custom House Quay, its last city stop, the ride to T2 takes about 25 minutes; from George's Quay, about 50 minutes. TFI bus routes 16, 19, 24, 33a, 41, 101, 102 and 109A also serve the airport from Zones 11, 13 and 15, and the TFI network runs 24-hour buses to the city.
gettingThere.driving: The airport is 10 km north of the city, off Junction 2 of the M1. Set-down zones are in front of both terminals; follow signs for T2 Departures. Unattended vehicles are towed. Short-term car parks charge from €4 an hour. Dublin Airport has permission to charge for drop-offs but had not started as of August 2026.

construction2026: Dublin Airport plans to expand the US preclearance facility in Terminal 2. In October 2026 it applied to add a storey to the already approved design. No construction dates have been published.
DUB.bagDrop: Delta and United: check-in and bag drop close 1 hour 15 minutes before departure at Dublin. Aer Lingus: check-in opens 3 hours before; its 2018 fact sheet gave a 75-minute cutoff for economy and 60 minutes for business on US flights, and it offers an evening-before bag drop. American: opens 3.5 hours before; its general cutoff for flights from outside the US is 60 minutes. JetBlue: opens 4 hours before; this research found no published cutoff for Dublin.
tips: Plan on 3 hours, or 4 if you fly Delta. You must finish check-in, Dublin security and US preclearance before boarding.
After Dublin security, watch the screens for your flight's allocated preclearance time, then go straight down to the ground floor.
Use Global Entry kiosks if you are a member. Otherwise, fill in Mobile Passport Control once you reach preclearance to speed up the CBP check.
Do not carry scissors or blades in your cabin bag; Dublin Airport says they are not allowed on US-bound flights.
Food bought before preclearance may be restricted. Keep it in your hand luggage, declare it and show it for inspection.
Eat and shop before preclearance if you can; there are only a few shops after it.

faq.q: How early should I get to Dublin Airport for a flight to the US?
faq.a: Dublin Airport suggests 3 hours before a long-haul flight. Delta recommends 4 hours at Dublin. Delta and United close check-in and bag drop 1 hour 15 minutes before departure.

faq.q: Do I go through US customs in Dublin?
faq.a: Yes, on most direct US flights. US preclearance in Terminal 2 covers US immigration, customs and agriculture checks. You land as a domestic arrival and skip CBP and TSA lines in the US.

faq.q: Which Dublin terminal do US flights leave from?
faq.a: Terminal 2. Aer Lingus, United, American, Delta and JetBlue all check in there.

faq.q: Can I use Global Entry at Dublin preclearance?
faq.a: Yes. Global Entry members can use the self-service kiosks at US preclearance. Mobile Passport Control is also available.

faq.q: Is there Irish passport control when leaving Dublin?
faq.a: No. Ireland has no routine exit passport control. On a precleared US flight, the passport check before boarding is done by US officers at preclearance.

EWR.name: Newark Liberty International Airport

officialArrivalAdvice.domestic: The airport does not publish a set arrival time. Delta and JetBlue (EWR page) both recommend arriving 2 hours before departure.
officialArrivalAdvice.international: Delta recommends arriving at least 3 hours before international departures.

checkpoints.notes: CLEAR+ is on the departures level, to the right of the security checkpoint entrance. Hours are Sun-Fri 4:30am-8:00pm and Sat 4:30am-7:00pm. JetBlue lists the EWR TSA checkpoint as open 24 hours.

notes: Gates 1-7 are 3-6 min from security, 8-28 are 2-10 min, and 29-34 are 3-6 min
The AirTrain does not stop directly at Terminal A. From the AirTrain it is about a 15-minute walk on a covered path, or a 5-minute shuttle.
An airside shuttle to Terminal C (United) leaves from between gates A28 and A29, after security
Terminal A was designed for about 13 million passengers a year but handled about 18 million in 2024. An expansion was approved in September 2026, with construction starting in 2027.

checkpoints.name: Terminal B security

JetBlue international arrivals use Terminal B

checkpoints.notes: CLEAR+ is on Level 3 at Door 2, overlooking the TSA PreCheck checkpoint. CLEAR+ hours are 4:30am-8:00pm.
checkpoints.name: Terminal C security, Level 3

United passengers can check in and drop bags at either Terminal C or Terminal A
An airside shuttle to Terminal A is near gate C71
For-hire vehicle (Uber/Lyft) pickups have permanently moved to Level 3 of the Terminal C garage, reached by the pedestrian bridge

EWR.betweenTerminals: There is no walkway between terminals after security. A continuous airside shuttle links Terminals A and C after TSA screening. The free AirTrain connects Terminals B and C, parking and the Airport Train Station before security, but it does not stop directly at Terminal A.
EWR.precheckNotes: CLEAR's EWR page places the Terminal C CLEAR lane overlooking the TSA PreCheck checkpoint. We could not confirm PreCheck details for Terminals A and B on the airport site.
EWR.touchlessId: Delta lists EWR for TSA PreCheck Touchless ID at security, but not for dedicated Touchless ID bag drop. Southwest's list does not include EWR. We could not confirm United's Touchless ID at EWR.

gettingThere.rideshare: Drop-off is in front of each terminal. Pickups: Terminal A on the Arrivals level, directly across the street from the terminal. Terminal B on the Arrivals-level frontage. Terminal C on Level 3 of the Terminal C garage.
gettingThere.transit: NJ Transit (Northeast Corridor or North Jersey Coast Line) and Amtrak stop at Newark Liberty Airport Station, which links to the terminals by AirTrain ($8.75 each way). NJ Transit to Midtown Manhattan takes about 30 minutes. Through Nov 20, 2026, AirTrain service to and from the Airport Train Station is suspended on weekdays from 5am to 3pm, with shuttle buses running instead. The Newark Airport Express bus serves Grand Central, Bryant Park and Port Authority Bus Terminal in about 50 minutes ($23.50 one way).
gettingThere.driving: Curbs are for active drop-off and pickup only. The free Cell Phone Lot is next to the P4 Daily Parking garage, under five minutes from all terminals. Through Nov 6, 2026, access to P4 from southbound Brewster Road and the I-78 entrance from Brewster Road near P4 are detoured. The Port Authority urges pre-booking parking at least 3 hours ahead to avoid a peak drive-up surcharge.

construction2026: AirTrain Newark replacement work: through Nov 20, 2026, AirTrain service to and from the Airport Train Station (NJ Transit/Amtrak) is suspended on weekdays from 5am to 3pm. Shuttle buses replace it, and AirTrain service between terminals is not affected.
Runway 4L-22R is under a $121 million rehabilitation, with periodic nightly weekday closures. The airport advises checking with your airline for delays.
The FAA's hourly flight cap at Newark (72 arrivals and departures per hour) runs through Oct 24, 2026
Through Nov 6, 2026, access to P4 Daily Parking from southbound Brewster Road and the I-78 entrance from Brewster Road are detoured
On the nights of Oct 14 and 15, 2026 (10pm-5am), two lanes of the main airport entrance before the ramp to Terminal B/C parking are closed
Terminal C for-hire vehicle pickups have permanently moved from the curb to Level 3 of the Terminal C garage
EWR.bagDrop: Delta (no EWR-specific exception): bags must be checked at least 45 minutes before domestic departures, international check-in closes 1 hour before, and you must be at the gate 15 minutes before departure. JetBlue at EWR: check-in and bags 45 minutes before domestic departures and 60 minutes before international. United's EWR cutoffs could not be verified.
tips: If you are flying from Terminal A by train, the AirTrain does not stop at Terminal A. Allow about 15 minutes to walk the covered path, or take the 5-minute shuttle.
Until Nov 20, 2026, the AirTrain to the NJ Transit/Amtrak station is replaced by shuttle buses on weekdays from 5am to 3pm. Allow extra time on weekday mornings.
United flies from both Terminal C and Terminal A, and an airside shuttle links the two after security, so check your departure terminal
At Terminal B, CLEAR is only for passengers flying from gates B40-B49

faq.q: How early should I get to Newark airport?
faq.a: The airport does not publish a set time. JetBlue and Delta recommend 2 hours before domestic flights, and Delta recommends 3 hours for international. Allow extra time if you arrive by train on a weekday morning, because AirTrain shuttle buses replace trains to the rail station from 5am to 3pm through Nov 20, 2026.

faq.q: Does the AirTrain go to Newark Terminal A?
faq.a: Not directly. From the AirTrain, Terminal A is about a 15-minute walk on a covered path or a 5-minute shuttle ride.

faq.q: Can I walk between terminals at Newark after security?
faq.a: No. A continuous airside shuttle links Terminals A and C after screening, but there is no airside link to Terminal B. You reach Terminal B by the landside AirTrain.

FCO.name: Rome Fiumicino Leonardo da Vinci Airport

officialArrivalAdvice.international: Aeroporti di Roma (ADR) gives no single arrival time. It says the right time depends on your destination, the travel period and whether you check bags, and that you should allow time for check-in, security and passport control. Delta suggests arriving at least 3 hours before an international flight.

FCO.passportControl: A flight to the US leaves the Schengen area, so after check-in and security you pass Italian passport control before you reach the E gates. The EU Entry/Exit System (EES) has run at Fiumicino since October 12, 2025 and records your exit with your biometric data; if you registered your fingerprints and photo on arrival, exit is a quick check. ADR says US citizens aged 14 or older with a chip passport can use its e-gates when departing, and EES self-service kiosks are being rolled out for biometric passport holders over 12. Reported waits vary: Ryanair said in April 2026 that queues at Fiumicino and other Italian airports had passed 1-2 hours, and in July 2026 ADR's chief aviation officer told the BBC that average EES waits for UK travelers rose from 7 to 20 minutes. Italy is one of nine countries reported in September 2026 to have informal EU approval to keep pausing biometric capture when queues build.

terminals.name: Terminal 1 (A gates)

checkpoints.notes: ADR says direct flights to the USA operated by airlines that check in at Terminal 1 still use traditional X-ray screening: liquids in containers of up to 100 ml in a clear bag of up to 1 liter, and electronics taken out of your bag. QPass booked slots run here from 5:00 to 20:00, but QPass is not available for flights to the USA.
checkpoints.name: Terminal 1 security

notes: ADR lists ITA Airways in Terminal 1. Terminal 1 is generally used for domestic and Schengen flights
Terminal 1 gates are A1-3, A21-27, A31-52 and A61-83
Non-Schengen departures, including flights to the US, leave from Boarding Area E after passport control
ITA passengers flying to the US must check in at the airport counters; the Airport in the City check-in at Roma Termini does not take US-bound passengers

terminals.name: Terminal 3 (E gates)

checkpoints.notes: ADR says its EDS C3 scanners let you keep laptops and tablets in your bag, and that since July 26, 2025 liquids may be carried in containers of up to 2 liters. At checkpoints without EDS C3 scanners, older rules apply. QPass booked slots run at Terminal 3 East from 3:00 to 23:00, but QPass is not available for flights to the USA.
checkpoints.name: Terminal 3 security

notes: Terminal 3 is mainly used for extra-Schengen and intercontinental flights. ADR's carrier list puts Delta, United and American here
Delta checks in and drops bags in Terminal 3, then passport control is directly behind Terminal 3; Delta says all its flights leave from the E gates
Terminal 3 gates are E1-8, E11-24, E31-44 and E51-61
Gates E31-44 are in a satellite reached by the SkyBridge people mover. The westbound train is for departing passengers only, so you cannot ride back
ADR says Terminal 3 has longer walking routes than Terminal 1

FCO.betweenTerminals: ADR says Terminals 1 and 3 are linked by marked pedestrian routes. It does not publish walking times. The train station is inside the airport area, close to the terminals.

securityWaits.summary: No published security wait times were found for Fiumicino. For US-bound travelers in 2026, the bigger risk has been passport control under EES. Ryanair said in April 2026 that queues had passed 1-2 hours, and ADR told the BBC in July 2026 that average EES waits for UK travelers rose from 7 to 20 minutes.

gettingThere.rideshare: Rome taxis charge a fixed fare of 55 euros between the airport and the city center inside the Aurelian Walls, in either direction, with all supplements included. Fixed fares are 60 euros to or from Tiburtina station and 50 euros to or from Ostiense station. Chauffeur cars (NCC) must be booked in advance.
gettingThere.transit: The Leonardo Express runs nonstop from Roma Termini to the airport in 32 minutes, every 15 minutes, from 4:50 to 23:05. ADR lists the fare as 14 euros. FL1 regional trains link the airport with other Rome stations, including Tiburtina, every 15 minutes on working days and every 30 minutes on weekends and holidays. Buses also run from Roma Termini and other city stops.
gettingThere.driving: The A91 Rome-Fiumicino motorway leads to the airport. Drop-offs use the Kiss&Go area, which has free parking, and the Lunga Sosta (long-stay) car park offers 2 hours free.

construction2026: From October 12, 2026 through February 2027, ADR is upgrading airfield infrastructure, including a second Taxiway Bravo. ADR says take-offs and landings continue as normal and the airport remains fully operational
FCO.bagDrop: Delta: FCO is not on Delta's list of exceptions, so its international rule applies: be checked in at least 1 hour before departure and at the gate 45 minutes before. United: check in at least 1 hour before an international flight. ITA Airways passengers to the US must check in at the departure terminal counters, not at Airport in the City. American's and ITA's FCO bag-drop cutoffs were not confirmed here, so check your booking.
tips: Check your terminal: Delta, United and American use Terminal 3, while ITA Airways checks in at Terminal 1
Do not plan on QPass: ADR's free security time slots are not available for flights to the USA
On ITA and other airlines that check in at Terminal 1, US flights get traditional screening, so pack liquids in 100 ml containers in a clear bag and be ready to take out electronics
US citizens aged 14 or older with a chip passport can use FCO's e-gates at departure passport control
If your gate is E31-44, visit lounges and shops first: the SkyBridge to that satellite runs one way for departing passengers
Allow at least 3 hours before a US flight; EES border queues at Italian airports were reported at 1-2 hours in spring 2026

faq.q: How early should I get to Rome Fiumicino airport for a flight to the US?
faq.a: At least 3 hours before departure. ADR gives no fixed time, Delta suggests 3 hours for international flights, and EES passport queues at Italian airports were reported at 1-2 hours in spring 2026.

faq.q: Which Fiumicino terminal is my US flight in?
faq.a: Delta, United and American check in at Terminal 3. ITA Airways checks in at Terminal 1. US flights board from the E gates after passport control.

faq.q: Can US citizens use the e-gates when leaving Fiumicino?
faq.a: Yes. ADR says US citizens can use the e-gates at departure and arrival if they are 14 or older and have an electronic (chip) passport.

faq.q: How much is a taxi from central Rome to Fiumicino?
faq.a: The fixed fare is 55 euros from inside the Aurelian Walls, with all supplements included. The Leonardo Express train from Roma Termini costs 14 euros and takes 32 minutes.

The ground-transportation pickup area (GTA 4) east of Terminal 4 has been closed until further notice since April 11, 2025

FLL.betweenTerminals: Landside, walk along the curbside walkways or the parking-garage walking trail (follow ground-level arrows), or ride a parking-garage tram. Post-security connectors between Terminals 1-2 and 2-3 are under construction (targeted for late 2027 as of 2024 reporting), so today you generally must re-clear security to change terminals; 2026 travel guides say Terminals 3 and 4 are already linked airside.

securityWaits.summary: FLL does not publish typical waits. On Mar 14, 2026, during spring break, the cruise season and the federal shutdown, the Terminal 1 TSA line stretched outside the building. In TSA's hourly screening counts for Mar 15-21 and Sep 13-19, 2026, about 40% of each day's passengers were screened between 4am and 10am.
busiestTimes: Sundays (busiest day in both sample weeks)
Cruise days: Friday, Saturday, Sunday and Monday mornings

FLL.precheckNotes: The airport links to TSA's PreCheck schedule page for checkpoint opening and closing times instead of publishing its own. PreCheck lane locations by terminal were not verified from an official source.
FLL.touchlessId: FLL appears on an April 2026 list of the 65 airports offering TSA PreCheck Touchless ID. Which airlines support it at FLL was not confirmed from an official source; opt in through your airline profile and check your boarding pass for the Touchless ID indicator.

gettingThere.rideshare: Drop-off is on the upper level (Departures) outside each terminal. Pickup is on the lower level: Terminal 1 riders use a temporary area beyond the taxi podium (Zone Z), Terminal 2 riders use GTA-2, and Terminals 3 and 4 riders cross to the first floor of the southern Palm Garage (Zones A-D).
gettingThere.transit: Free Tri-Rail shuttle buses run from lower-level stops at the terminals to the Fort Lauderdale-Hollywood International Airport Tri-Rail station in Dania Beach, a few miles away. Tri-Rail serves Miami-Dade, Broward and Palm Beach counties. Broward County Transit Route 1 stops at the Rental Car Center, Stop G. Port Everglades is about a 10-minute ride (taxi about $12). For PortMiami the airport says to allow at least 90 minutes.
gettingThere.driving: The airport is at 100 Terminal Drive. The Palm, Hibiscus and Cypress garages have more than 11,000 spaces; long-term is $2 per 20 minutes, up to $20 per day. During peak periods, valet and self-parking can temporarily close when full, and FLL posts updates on X and Facebook.

construction2026: Post-security terminal connectors (Terminals 1-2 and 2-3), about $260M, were targeted for late 2027 completion as of 2024 reporting

The lower-level ground-transportation pickup between Terminals 2 and 3 (GTA 2) has been closed since March 10, 2025 for the connector construction, and GTA 4 east of Terminal 4 since April 11, 2025. Hotel, off-airport parking and Rental Car Center shuttles now use GTA 1 and GTA 3.
Ride-share pickup has moved: a temporary Zone Z serves Terminal 1, and Terminals 3 and 4 use the Palm Garage's southern first floor

Spirit Airlines shut down on May 2, 2026, and Air Canada moved to Terminal 4 on Sep 15, 2026. An August 2026 travel guide says terminal and gate assignments are more fluid than usual during FLL's capital program.
FLL.bagDrop: During peak cruise activity, FLL says airlines may only check bags up to 2 hours before your scheduled flight. The airport also notes that some airlines won't accept bags earlier than 2-3 hours before departure, and you must check bags before going through security. Airline-specific cutoffs were not verified.
tips: On cruise days (Fri-Mon), many returning cruise passengers reach FLL around 8:30am for flights all day, so terminals can be crowded. Don't arrive hours early, because airlines may not take your bags until 2 hours before departure.

Check FLL's 'Where Is My Airline' page before you go. Spirit no longer operates (shut down May 2026), Air Canada moved to Terminal 4 in Sept 2026, and JetBlue splits between Terminal 3 (domestic) and Terminal 4 (Puerto Rico, Dominican Republic, Jamaica).
Returning a rental car: the Rental Car Center is next to Terminal 1, which you reach on foot via the Level 2 bridge. Shuttles to Terminals 2-4 run every 10 minutes, 24/7.
Garages can temporarily close when full during peak periods, so have a backup plan and check FLL's social media updates before driving

faq.q: How early should I get to Fort Lauderdale airport (FLL)?
faq.a: FLL doesn't publish a single recommended arrival time, and says to check your airline's check-in times. During peak cruise periods, airlines may only accept checked bags up to 2 hours before your flight, so arriving much earlier than that may mean waiting with your luggage.

faq.q: Which terminal is my airline in at FLL?
faq.a: Per FLL's airline directory: Southwest, United, Frontier, Alaska, Allegiant and Breeze are in Terminal 1; Delta and WestJet in Terminal 2; JetBlue (domestic), American, Avelo, Porter and Sun Country in Terminal 3; and Air Canada, Avianca, Air Transat and some JetBlue international flights in Terminal 4.

faq.q: Can I walk between terminals at FLL after security?
faq.a: Generally no. Post-security connectors between Terminals 1-2 and 2-3 are still under construction, so you walk between terminals landside via curbside walkways or the garage trail and re-clear security. 2026 travel guides say Terminals 3 and 4 are connected airside.

FRA.name: Frankfurt Airport

officialArrivalAdvice.international: For summer 2026, Frankfurt Airport asked travelers who go through border control (non-EU citizens and anyone flying outside the Schengen area) to be at the airport at least 3 hours before departure. Delta also recommends arriving at least 3 hours before an international flight.

FRA.passportControl: Flying to the US means leaving the Schengen area, so you pass German border control on the way to your gate, and the EU Entry/Exit System (EES, fully operational since April 10, 2026) records your exit; if you registered your face and fingerprints when you arrived, exit is a quick check against that record, otherwise you register on exit. A Financial Times and Qsensor study reported by Euronews on Aug 12, 2026 found the average border wait at Frankfurt reached 120 minutes in July 2026, up from 60 minutes a year earlier, and FRA asked EES travelers to arrive at least 3 hours before departure. US citizens can use the EasyPASS-RTP eGates after a one-time registration with the Federal Police at the airport; FRA says self-service kiosks, where available, are faster than going straight to a desk. On Lufthansa and Discover Airlines flights to the US, the required US entry document check can be done at Fast Bag Drop if you consent to biometric verification during online check-in. In September 2026, reports said Germany is among nine countries that may still pause fingerprint and face capture when queues build; the European Commission declined to comment.

terminals.name: Terminal 1 (Concourses A, B, C, Z)

checkpoints.notes: Serves Schengen and non-Schengen flights. Has an FRA SmartWay lane: book a free time slot up to 72 hours before departure (up to five people per slot). Most Terminal 1 checkpoints have CT scanners, so liquids up to 2 liters and laptops can stay in your bag.
checkpoints.name: Terminal 1, area B security (west and east access, level 2)

checkpoints.notes: FRA lists its SmartWay lane here for Schengen flights only.
checkpoints.name: Terminal 1, area A security (level 2)

checkpoints.notes: In Concourse C you and your carry-on are screened just before the gate. The old 100 ml liquid rules still apply at gates C1, C2, C4 and C6, including to duty-free purchases.
checkpoints.name: Concourse C gate security

notes: Used mainly by Lufthansa Group and Star Alliance airlines, including United
United check-in moved from Hall B to Hall C on October 25
Lufthansa check-in is in Hall A, with Fast Bag Drop at zones 12-13
Discover Airlines checks in at Hall B (Fast Bag Drop zones 12-14) and offers evening-before check-in from 5 to 8pm at zone 14
Condor checks in at Hall C (Fast Bag Drop zones 18-19) and offers evening-before check-in from 6 to 10pm at zone 19; Condor is expected to move to Terminal 3 in summer 2027
Non-Schengen flights, including US flights, leave from the Z gates, gates B20-B63 and Concourse C; Z sits on the floor above Concourse A

terminals.name: Terminal 3 (Piers G, H, J)

checkpoints.notes: Serves Schengen and non-Schengen flights and has an FRA SmartWay lane (free slot, book up to 72 hours ahead). All Terminal 3 checkpoints use CT scanners: liquids up to 2 liters without a plastic bag, and laptops, tablets and cameras stay in your bag.
checkpoints.name: Terminal 3 central security (level 3)

notes: Opened April 23, 2026. Delta and American moved here from Terminal 2 on May 19, 2026
Delta ticket counters are in Zone 36; Delta suggests checking in on its app and self-tagging bags at its kiosks
Pier J handles non-Schengen flights and Pier H Schengen flights; Pier G can handle both but is only partly in use
Terminal 3 has no train station. From the Terminal 1 train stations, the SkyLine takes about 10-15 minutes
Self check-in and Fast Bag Drop are the main check-in options; shops and restaurants are past security

FRA.betweenTerminals: The free SkyLine train links Terminals 1 and 3. It runs from 4am to 11pm about every 2-3 minutes, and a shuttle bus covers the hours outside that. The trip from Terminal 1 to Terminal 3 takes about 8-15 minutes.

securityWaits.summary: FRA does not publish security wait times. The bigger delay for US-bound travelers in 2026 has been border control: the Financial Times and Qsensor found the average border wait reached 120 minutes in July 2026, double the year before.

gettingThere.rideshare: A taxi or car to Frankfurt Central Station or the city center takes about 10-15 minutes. Terminal 3 has a drop-off zone in front of the building.
gettingThere.transit: S-Bahn lines S8 and S9 and regional trains stop at the regional station under Terminal 1 (Level 0); the trip to Frankfurt Central Station takes about 10-12 minutes. Long-distance IC and ICE trains stop at the long-distance station, about a 5-minute walk from Terminal 1. Terminal 3 has no station: change to the SkyLine (about 10-15 minutes). Bus X77 runs every 15 minutes between Gateway Gardens and Terminal 3.
gettingThere.driving: Terminal 3 connects directly to the A5 motorway. Its garage has up to 8,500 spaces; without a reservation use entrance P11. Fraport recommends booking parking online in advance.

construction2026: Terminal 3 opened April 23, 2026, and the airlines from Terminal 2 moved there in waves through June 9, 2026
Terminal 2 closed to passengers on June 9, 2026 for renovation; reports say it will be out of use for years
From October 26, the AiRail Terminal at the long-distance station is no longer available; rail-and-fly passengers check bags at the counters in the departure hall
Condor is expected to move from Terminal 1 to Terminal 3 in summer 2027
FRA.bagDrop: Delta: be checked in, with or without bags, at least 75 minutes before departure at FRA, and at the gate 45 minutes before. United: check in at least 60 minutes before an international flight. Discover Airlines and Condor offer evening-before check-in in Terminal 1. Lufthansa's current FRA cutoff was not confirmed here, so check your boarding pass.
tips: Check your terminal before you go: United, Lufthansa, Discover and Condor use Terminal 1, while Delta and American use Terminal 3
Terminal 3 has no train station, so add about 10-15 minutes for the SkyLine ride from the Terminal 1 stations
Book a free FRA SmartWay security slot up to 72 hours ahead; the Terminal 1 area B and Terminal 3 lanes serve US flights
At CT-scanner checkpoints (all of Terminal 3 and most of Terminal 1), liquids up to 2 liters and laptops can stay in your bag; gates C1, C2, C4 and C6 still use the 100 ml rule
On Lufthansa or Discover, consent to biometric verification during online check-in so the US document check is done at Fast Bag Drop
Plan at least 3 hours before a US flight: border control waits at FRA averaged 120 minutes in July 2026

faq.q: How early should I get to Frankfurt airport for a flight to the US?
faq.a: At least 3 hours before departure. FRA asked travelers going through border control to arrive 3 hours early in summer 2026, Delta recommends 3 hours for international flights, and average border waits hit 120 minutes in July 2026.

faq.q: Which Frankfurt terminal is my US flight in?
faq.a: United, Lufthansa, Discover Airlines and Condor use Terminal 1. Delta and American moved to the new Terminal 3 on May 19, 2026. Terminal 2 closed on June 9, 2026.

faq.q: How do I get to Frankfurt Terminal 3 by train?
faq.a: Take the S-Bahn or a long-distance train to the Terminal 1 stations, then ride the free SkyLine to Terminal 3, about 10-15 minutes. The SkyLine runs 4am-11pm; a shuttle bus runs outside those hours.

faq.q: What happens at passport control when I leave Frankfurt?
faq.a: The EU Entry/Exit System records your exit. If you registered your face and fingerprints on arrival, it is a quick check; if not, you register on exit. US citizens can register once for the EasyPASS-RTP eGates with the Federal Police at the airport.

HNL.name: Daniel K. Inouye International Airport

officialArrivalAdvice.domestic: Arrive at least two hours before overseas flights (including the US mainland) and 90 minutes before interisland flights, or as your airline advises. Add at least 30 minutes if you are parking or returning a rental car.
officialArrivalAdvice.international: Arrive at least two hours before overseas flights

terminals.name: Terminal 1

checkpoints.notes: Standard passengers only. Opens as needed between 6:15 a.m. and 1:30 p.m. based on passenger volume (HNL hours as of May 17, 2026).
checkpoints.name: CP 1A (Mauka)

checkpoints.notes: 4:15 a.m.-11:30 p.m. daily, 1-4 lanes. Dedicated PreCheck lanes 4:15 a.m.-11:30 p.m. Checkpoint 1 is on the right side of Ticket Lobby 2.
checkpoints.name: CP 1B (Makai)

notes: Flights to the US mainland: the USDA inspects all checked and carry-on bags before the flight. Checked bags are inspected at check-in, so be ready to open them. Declare all food, plants and other farm items. Most fresh fruits and vegetables, berries, soil, live insects and snails, cactus and plants in soil are prohibited; fresh pineapple, coconut, coffee and commercially canned foods are allowed after inspection.
Hawaiian and Alaska Neighbor Island check-in and bag drop are in Terminal 1, Lobby 3; HNL lists Alaska-Hawaiian in Lobbies 2 and 3
Ticket counters are on the second level

checkpoints.notes: Opens as needed between 9:15 a.m. and 1:00 p.m. based on passenger volume
checkpoints.name: CP 2

checkpoints.notes: 4:15 a.m.-11:30 p.m. daily, 1-6 lanes. PreCheck in Lane 6 only, 4:15-5:15 a.m. (or as needed) and 2:30-11:30 p.m.
checkpoints.name: CP 3

checkpoints.notes: 9:15 a.m.-1:00 p.m. and 6:15-8:30 p.m. daily, 1-2 lanes
checkpoints.name: CP 4

checkpoints.notes: 5:15 a.m.-9:00 p.m. daily, 1-3 lanes, with a dedicated PreCheck lane
checkpoints.name: CP 5

notes: Flights to the US mainland: the USDA inspects all checked and carry-on bags before the flight. Checked bags are inspected at check-in, so be ready to open them. Declare all food, plants and other farm items. Most fresh fruits and vegetables, berries, soil, live insects and snails, cactus and plants in soil are prohibited; fresh pineapple, coconut, coffee and commercially canned foods are allowed after inspection.
Lobby 4: Hawaiian international flights (moved from Terminal 1 on Oct 3, 2026), Air Canada, Air Premia, Fiji Airways, Korean Air, Philippine Airlines, Qantas, ZIPAIR
Lobby 5: Alaska, Japan Airlines. Lobby 6: Air New Zealand, Southwest (interisland), WestJet. Lobby 7: American, Delta, Southwest (domestic). Lobby 8: ANA, United
Checkpoints 2-5 sit between the ticket lobbies; check the airport map for the one nearest your lobby
Terminal 3 (ground-level counters) serves Mokulele Airlines and is not connected by walkway

HNL.betweenTerminals: Terminals 1 and 2 are connected after security. HNL says the walk from Terminal 2 to Terminal 1 takes 10-15 minutes; people walking between them pass a USDA inspection station for carry-on bags. The free Wiki Wiki bus links Terminals 1, 2 and 3 and the Skyline station (terminal service 6 a.m.-11:30 p.m.), and open-air trams run between Terminals 1 and 2 from 10 a.m. to 6 p.m.

securityWaits.summary: HNL does not publish typical wait times or busiest hours. Several checkpoints (CP 1A, CP 2, CP 4) open only at midday or as needed, so fewer lanes are open early in the morning and late at night.

HNL.precheckNotes: PreCheck has dedicated lanes at CP 1B (Terminal 1, 4:15 a.m.-11:30 p.m.) and CP 5 (Terminal 2, open 5:15 a.m.-9 p.m.). At CP 3, PreCheck uses Lane 6 only, from 4:15-5:15 a.m. or as needed and 2:30-11:30 p.m. HNL says hours can change without notice.

gettingThere.rideshare: Rideshare pickup is on the ground level: Terminal 1 outside Baggage Claim 6; Terminal 2 at the median between Baggage Claims 19 and 20 and at the median across from Baggage Claim 31. Check-in counters are on the second level.
gettingThere.transit: Skyline rail's Lelepaua Station sits between the International and Terminal 2 parking garages (ground level and 4th-floor walkways). Trains run about 4 a.m.-10 p.m., every 10 minutes until 8:30 p.m. and every 15 minutes after, between East Kapolei and Middle Street; you need a HOLO card. TheBus W Line runs to Downtown, Ala Moana and Waikiki from a stop on Ala Onaona Street east of the lei stands, with luggage limits (one medium suitcase plus one small bag).
gettingThere.driving: Garages: Terminal 1 Parking Garage next to Terminal 1, Terminal 2 Parking Garage across from Terminal 2, and the International Parking Garage across from the International Arrivals Building. Since July 1, 2026, parking 8+ hours (including overnight) is $29. Free cell phone waiting areas (60-minute limit, stay with your car) are on Aolele Street near Lagoon Drive and on Service Road A near the Airport Post Office.

construction2026: Concrete repairs on the Terminal 2 roadways continue at the 1st, 2nd and 3rd levels of the Ewa and Diamond Head Concourses and the Connecting Links, including the Departures level; the contract was extended, with project acceptance listed for Dec 13, 2027
A new parking structure at Ualena Street entered construction in June 2026
Hawaiian moved all international check-in to Terminal 2, Lobby 4 on Oct 3, 2026; Neighbor Island check-in stays in Terminal 1
HNL.bagDrop: Hawaiian and Alaska Neighbor Island flights: check in and drop bags at least 50 minutes before departure (since Oct 3, 2026). Delta at HNL: 45 minutes for domestic flights with or without bags, 1 hour for international. Southwest: bags 45 minutes before domestic departure, check-in 30 minutes. United and American: 45 minutes for check-in and bags on most domestic flights.
tips: Flying to the mainland? Keep fresh fruit, plants and flowers out of your bags or declare them; USDA inspects checked bags at check-in and carry-ons before the flight
Find your lobby before you go: Hawaiian Neighbor Island flights use Terminal 1, while Hawaiian international flights now check in at Terminal 2, Lobby 4
For early flights from Terminal 2, CP 3 and CP 5 are the main checkpoints; CP 2 and CP 4 open only part of the day
Add at least 30 minutes if you are parking or returning a rental car, as HNL advises
Allow 10-15 minutes to walk between Terminals 1 and 2, or use the Wiki Wiki bus

faq.q: How early should I get to Honolulu airport?
faq.a: HNL advises at least two hours before overseas flights, including the mainland, and 90 minutes before interisland flights. Add at least 30 minutes if you are parking or returning a rental car.

faq.q: Is there an agricultural inspection when flying from Honolulu to the mainland?
faq.a: Yes. The USDA inspects all checked and carry-on bags before flights from Hawaii to the US mainland. Most fresh fruits and vegetables are not allowed; fresh pineapple, coconut and coffee are allowed after inspection.

faq.q: Which terminal does Hawaiian Airlines use at HNL?
faq.a: Hawaiian uses Terminal 1 (Lobbies 2 and 3), including Neighbor Island check-in in Lobby 3. Since Oct 3, 2026, Hawaiian international check-in is at Terminal 2, Lobby 4.

faq.q: What time does security open at HNL?
faq.a: CP 1B (Terminal 1) and CP 3 (Terminal 2) open at 4:15 a.m. and run until 11:30 p.m. CP 5 opens at 5:15 a.m. Other checkpoints open only part of the day.

IAD.name: Washington Dulles International Airport

officialArrivalAdvice.domestic: Arrive 2 hours before departure for domestic flights
officialArrivalAdvice.international: Arrive 3 hours before international flights

terminals.name: Main Terminal (Concourses A, B, C, D, Z)

checkpoints.notes: Airport pages list different hours (4:00am-10:00pm in the FAQ; 4:00am-9:00pm on the security page). CLEAR kiosk for enrolled members at the lower-level East checkpoint.
checkpoints.name: East Security Checkpoint, Departures (Ticketing/Check-In) level

checkpoints.notes: Airport pages list different hours (3:45am-10:00pm in the FAQ; 4:45am-9:00pm on the security page). An undated banner says PreCheck is also offered here 6:30-8:00am and 3:30-5:00pm.
checkpoints.name: West Security Checkpoint, Departures (Ticketing/Check-In) level

checkpoints.notes: Overnight, when East and West are closed, screening lanes next to PreCheck stay open; the airport says screening is available 24/7. CLEAR kiosk at the PreCheck entrance.
checkpoints.name: TSA PreCheck checkpoint (between East and West), Departures level

notes: United (ticketing Zone 4) is the hub airline; Delta, Sun Country and Breeze are in Zone 1, American in Zone 2, Alaska and Frontier in Zone 3.

After security, the AeroTrain runs from the Terminal station (just past the checkpoints) to the midfield concourses, with less than two minutes between stations; an underground walkway with moving sidewalks also links the Terminal and Concourse B.
Mobile Lounges and Plane Mates carry passengers between the Terminal and Concourses A and D.
Gate counts: A 24, B 31, C 23, D 31, Z 4.
New 14-gate Concourse E for United is scheduled to open in fall 2026 (October target as of September 2026), with direct AeroTrain access.

IAD.betweenTerminals: Single main terminal. After security, the AeroTrain, an underground walkway to Concourse B, and Mobile Lounges connect the terminal to the midfield concourses; leave extra time to reach A, C and D gates.
IAD.precheckNotes: The main TSA PreCheck checkpoint sits between the East and West checkpoints on the Departures level. Airport pages conflict on PreCheck hours (4:30am-9:00pm in the FAQ; 24 hours on the security page), and an undated banner adds PreCheck at the West checkpoint 6:30-8:00am and 3:30-5:00pm.
IAD.touchlessId: TSA lists Touchless ID at 65 airports and tells travelers to check with their airline. Delta lists IAD as a participating airport (without a dedicated Touchless ID bag drop). A March 2026 third-party list includes United, American, Delta and Alaska among participating airlines at IAD.

gettingThere.rideshare: Pickup is at the 3rd curb on the ground level outside Baggage Claim (Doors 2, 4 or 6), zones 3A-3H assigned in the app. Rideshare drop-off is NOT on the departures level: since Nov. 1, 2023 all rideshare drop-offs are at curbs 3A/B and 3G/H, with a short walk inside to escalators up to ticketing.
gettingThere.transit: Metrorail Silver Line: the Washington Dulles International Airport station connects to the main terminal's ticketing and baggage claim levels (and Parking Garage 1) by an indoor pedestrian tunnel with moving sidewalks.
gettingThere.driving: Parking options include a Valet Lot, Garages 1 and 2, Terminal Hourly, Terminal Daily and Economy lots. The airport occasionally closes the Main Terminal arrivals and departures roadways overnight for construction (e.g., 11pm-5am July 23-24, 2026), detouring traffic to the rideshare lanes.

construction2026: Concourse E (14 gates, United) is scheduled to open in fall 2026; MWAA's board was told in September 2026 the opening slipped from late September into October. It will be renamed Concourse C later, and design-construction of its next segments began in 2026.
Overnight closures of Main Terminal arrivals/departures roadways have occurred for construction (11pm July 23 to 5am July 24, 2026), with pickup/drop-off detoured to rideshare lanes.

A roughly $22 billion Dulles overhaul announced July 29, 2026 would replace the Mobile Lounges with an expanded train, a central walking tunnel and new concourses, plus a 32,000-space garage; construction could start in spring 2027.
IAD.bagDrop: Delta (not an exception airport for Delta): domestic bags must be checked at least 45 minutes before departure (30 minutes without bags); bags not accepted more than 6 hours before departure. United's IAD cutoffs were not verified.
tips: Budget time after security: most gates are reached by the AeroTrain, a walkway or a Mobile Lounge rather than on foot from the checkpoint.
Rideshare drop-off is on the ground-level 3rd curb (3A/B or 3G/H), not the upper departures curb; take the escalators up to ticketing.
Screening runs 24/7: when the East and West checkpoints close, use the lanes next to TSA PreCheck in the middle of the Departures level.
The Silver Line station connects to the terminal through an indoor tunnel with moving sidewalks, so Metro riders never go outside.
United's new Concourse E opens in fall 2026; check your gate, as some United flights will use it.

faq.q: How early should I get to Dulles (IAD)?
faq.a: Dulles recommends arriving 2 hours before domestic flights and 3 hours before international flights. Allow extra time to reach midfield gates by AeroTrain or Mobile Lounge.

faq.q: Is TSA security at Dulles open 24 hours?
faq.a: Yes. The airport says screening is available 24/7; overnight, when the East and West checkpoints close, use the screening lanes next to TSA PreCheck on the Departures level.

faq.q: Where do Uber and Lyft drop off at Dulles?
faq.a: Rideshare drop-offs are at ground-level curbs 3A/B and 3G/H outside Baggage Claim, with a short walk inside to escalators up to ticketing. Pickup is at the same 3rd curb, zones 3A-3H.

IAH.name: George Bush Intercontinental Airport

terminals.name: Terminal A

checkpoints.notes: Checkpoint 3:30am-7:30pm; TSA PreCheck 4:00am-6:00pm; CLEAR daily 4:00am-6:00pm
checkpoints.name: Terminal A North

United gates B3-B31 remain in use
United runs an optional shuttle bus between Terminal B (gates 4-11), Terminal C (gates 30-45) and Terminal E (gates 1-10) as an alternative to the Skyway
Terminal B South ride-app passengers should take the Skyway to Terminal A or C for pickup

checkpoints.notes: Checkpoint and TSA PreCheck 4:00am-10:00pm; CLEAR Sun-Fri 4:00am-7:00pm, Sat 4:00am-6:00pm. Also screens Terminal B passengers during the B lobby closure.
checkpoints.name: Terminal C North

METRO's 102 Bush IAH Express bus serves Terminal C

terminals.name: Terminal D (international, including the new Terminal D-West concourse)

checkpoints.notes: Modified hours because only two airlines currently operate from the terminal: Sun, Mon, Wed and Fri 7:00-11:30am and 4:30-8:00pm; Tue, Thu and Sat 7:00am-8:00pm. An April 2026 airport update lists standard screening only. A separate table on the same page lists 4:00am-12:30am with PreCheck 5:00am-7:00pm, which conflicts.
checkpoints.name: Terminal D checkpoint

notes: Terminal D-West is the airport's new international concourse, next to the expanded Terminal E
International arrivals at Terminal D clear Customs in the Terminal E international arrivals hall
The two airlines currently operating from Terminal D were not named on the airport pages reviewed

terminals.name: Terminal E

checkpoints.notes: Checkpoint 4:00am-12:00am; TSA PreCheck 4:00am-8:00pm. CLEAR is listed at Terminal E in the April 2026 airport update, and there is a post-security CLEAR enrollment center open daily 4:00am-6:00pm.
checkpoints.name: Terminal E checkpoint

notes: Customs and Immigration for international arrivals is in the Terminal E international arrivals hall
A TSA recheck area for international connections (opened August 2024) has a dedicated PreCheck lane past baggage claim
The METRO 500 IAH Downtown Direct bus stops at Terminal E, Level 2, Door E201

IAH.betweenTerminals: Inside security, the free Skyway train runs between Terminals A, C and D/E every two minutes (about 4 min 15 s from A to D/E). Outside security, the free Subway train links Terminals A, B, C, D/E and the Airport Marriott every three minutes, 3:15am-12:15am. The airport says the Subway lets you reach an open checkpoint in any terminal.

securityWaits.summary: Houston Airports shows live checkpoint waits online but no typical figures. During the Feb-Apr 2026 federal shutdown it warned of longer-than-normal waits and said PreCheck and CLEAR availability could change day to day. In TSA's hourly screening counts for Mar 15-21 and Sep 13-19, 2026, the heaviest screening was about 5-9am, with a second, smaller peak in mid-afternoon.
busiestTimes: Mondays, Thursdays, Fridays and Sundays are busier; Tuesdays, Wednesdays and Saturdays typically lighter (Houston Airports)

IAH.precheckNotes: PreCheck hours differ by checkpoint: Terminal A North 4:00am-6:00pm, Terminal C North 4:00am-10:00pm, Terminal E 4:00am-8:00pm. Terminal A South and C South list no PreCheck hours, Terminal B's checkpoint is closed, and Terminal D listed standard screening only in April 2026. Houston Airports says PreCheck and CLEAR availability can vary day to day with staffing.
IAH.touchlessId: IAH appears on an April 2026 list of the 65 airports offering TSA PreCheck Touchless ID. Which airlines and checkpoints support it at IAH was not confirmed from an official source.

gettingThere.rideshare: Drop off on the Departures level at all terminals; the airport enforces 'Active Loading', so curbside stops are for immediate unloading only. Ride-app pickups (Arrivals level): Terminal A west side Door A-114; Terminal C south side Doors C-103/C-104; Terminal E west side, Level 2, Zone 5. Terminal B South riders take the Skyway to A or C.
gettingThere.transit: METRO 500 IAH Downtown Direct runs nonstop between Terminal E (Level 2, Door E201) and the George R. Brown Convention Center downtown: $4.50 one way, daily 5:30am-8pm, every 30 minutes. The METRO 102 Bush IAH Express serves Terminal C.
gettingThere.driving: Garage parking becomes reservation-only once garages reach 85% capacity, and ecopark2 (Will Clayton Pkwy) has been reservation-only since June 1, 2026. If you park in the A/B garage for a Terminal B flight, a United express shuttle takes you to your terminal.

construction2026: The United/Houston Airports Terminal B Transformation ($2.5B) is underway. The Terminal B ticketing lobby has been closed since Jan 21, 2025, with reopening expected in fall/late 2026. Until then, Terminal B flyers check in and clear security at Terminal C.

Road work near Terminals A and B ran from 10pm Mon Oct 12 to Fri Oct 16, 2026, with fewer lanes on southbound JFK Blvd near the Marriott as the airport prepares to open the new Terminal B. Drivers leaving A/B should allow extra time and follow detours toward Will Clayton Pkwy.
Terminal D's TSA checkpoint runs reduced, day-specific hours
tips: Flying United from a B gate? Until the new Terminal B opens, you check in, drop bags and clear security at Terminal C, then ride the Skyway to Terminal B.

All terminals are linked airside by the Skyway, and landside by the Subway (3:15am-12:15am), so if your terminal's checkpoint is closed or backed up you can screen at another open one and ride to your gate
Check checkpoint hours before early or late flights: Terminal D's checkpoint keeps reduced hours (as late as 7am opening), and several PreCheck lanes close between 6pm and 10pm
Book parking ahead: garages switch to reservation-only at 85% full, and ecopark2 is reservation-only
Mondays, Thursdays, Fridays and Sundays are the busier days at IAH; Tuesdays, Wednesdays and Saturdays are typically lighter

faq.q: How early should I get to Houston Bush airport (IAH)?
faq.a: Houston Airports doesn't publish a fixed arrival time. It tells passengers to check live TSA wait times, stay in contact with their airline, and arrive early with extra time for screening, especially on busier Mondays, Thursdays, Fridays and Sundays.

faq.q: Where do I check in for United flights from Terminal B at IAH?
faq.a: At Terminal C. The Terminal B ticketing lobby has been closed since Jan 21, 2025 for United's rebuild, which is expected to finish in fall/late 2026. Terminal B passengers check in, drop bags and clear TSA at Terminal C, then take the Skyway to the B gates.

faq.q: Can I move between terminals after security at IAH?
faq.a: Yes. The free Skyway train connects Terminals A, C and D/E inside security every two minutes, about 4 minutes end to end. The Subway train connects all terminals before security.
