IND.name: Indianapolis International Airport

officialArrivalAdvice.domestic: IND recommends arriving two hours before your flight departure time for domestic travel
officialArrivalAdvice.international: IND recommends arriving three hours before international flights

terminals.name: Main Terminal (Concourses A and B)

checkpoints.notes: Opens at 3:30am. IND says TSA PreCheck passengers should use Checkpoint A; Upgraded Points lists PreCheck lanes there from 4am to 7pm. CLEAR lanes run 4am-7pm daily.
checkpoints.name: Checkpoint A

checkpoints.notes: Opens at 3:45am. No PreCheck lanes. CLEAR lanes run 4am-7pm daily.
checkpoints.name: Checkpoint B

notes: All Concourse A and B gates can be reached from either checkpoint by the Concourse Connector after screening
Wikipedia lists Concourse A for Aer Lingus, Air Canada, Alaska, Avelo, Delta, Frontier, Sun Country and United, and Concourse B for Allegiant, American and Southwest
JetBlue starts daily nonstops to Fort Lauderdale on Nov 2, 2026; IND has not said which concourse it will use
You can enroll in CLEAR at kiosks in the Ticketing Hall across from the Guest Services desk

IND.betweenTerminals: Single terminal with two concourses. After either checkpoint, the Concourse Connector links Concourses A and B, so you can reach any gate without screening again.

securityWaits.summary: IND says about one-third of its passengers leave before 9am. On peak fall-break days in October 2026, it said most travelers flew out between 4am and 6am. MyTSA data for mid-June to mid-August 2026 put IND's average wait at 8.4 minutes, below the 9.9-minute average for the 50 busiest US airports.

IND.precheckNotes: PreCheck lanes are only at Checkpoint A. Upgraded Points lists them as open 4am-7pm, so very early and evening flyers may have only standard lanes. Both checkpoints lead to all gates.
IND.touchlessId: A March 2026 airport list shows TSA PreCheck Touchless ID at IND for Delta. You opt in through your airline profile.

gettingThere.rideshare: Drop-off is at the curb on the departures level. Vehicles may stop only while loading or unloading, and unattended vehicles are towed. Uber and Lyft pickup is at the Ground Transportation Center on the first floor of the Terminal Garage.
gettingThere.transit: IndyGo Route 8 (Washington Street) runs between the airport and downtown Indianapolis, about every 30 minutes
gettingThere.driving: Terminal Garage daily parking is $23/day, hourly parking (Level 3) is $2 per half hour, and valet (Level 3) is $32/day. In the Long Term Lot, Park & Walk is $14/day and Economy is $9/day, with shuttles 24/7 every 5-7 minutes. IND does not take parking reservations, and garage levels can fill, so check availability on ind.com before you leave. Drivers picking up can wait free in the Cell Phone Lot.

IND.bagDrop: Southwest: bags checked less than 45 minutes before a domestic departure may not be accepted (60 minutes for international); bags are accepted no earlier than 4 hours ahead. American and United: check-in and bag deadline is 45 minutes before domestic departure. Delta: check bags at least 45 minutes before domestic departure, no more than 6 hours ahead.
tips: PreCheck members should go to Checkpoint A. Checkpoint B has no PreCheck lanes.
Either checkpoint gets you to every gate through the Concourse Connector, so pick the shorter line if you are not in PreCheck
Early mornings are the busiest. About one-third of IND passengers depart before 9am.
Checkpoint A opens at 3:30am and Checkpoint B at 3:45am
IND does not take parking reservations and garage levels can fill. Check live availability online and allow time for the Economy Lot shuttle.

faq.q: How early should I get to Indianapolis airport?
faq.a: IND recommends two hours before domestic flights and three hours before international flights. Early mornings are the busiest time.

faq.q: Which checkpoint has TSA PreCheck at IND?
faq.a: Checkpoint A. Checkpoint B has standard and CLEAR lanes only. Both checkpoints lead to all gates.

faq.q: Are Concourses A and B connected after security at IND?
faq.a: Yes. The Concourse Connector links them after either checkpoint, so you never need to screen twice.

faq.q: Where do I get an Uber or Lyft at Indianapolis airport?
faq.a: Pickup is at the Ground Transportation Center on the first floor of the Terminal Garage. Drop-off is at the departures-level curb.

JAX.name: Jacksonville International Airport

officialArrivalAdvice.domestic: JAX recommended arriving at least 2 hours before a domestic flight (holiday guidance reported by WOKV, December 2025). It said to allow time to find parking, check bags and get through security.
officialArrivalAdvice.international: JAX recommended arriving at least 3 hours before an international flight (WOKV, December 2025)

terminals.name: Concourse A

checkpoints.notes: JAX has one security checkpoint, on the mezzanine past ticketing, serving Concourses A and C. JAX says it opens at 4:00am; JetBlue's JAX page lists it as open 4:00am to 10:30pm. In mid-September 2026 TSA counts, a small amount of screening began in the 3am hour every day, and it was very light after 8pm.
checkpoints.name: Main Checkpoint

notes: Gates A1-A10
JetBlue lists Concourse A, with its ticket counter open 3:30am to 8:30pm. Its lobby is cashless.
Kayak lists Frontier at both Concourse A and Concourse C; check your boarding pass.

terminals.name: Concourse C

checkpoints.notes: Same single checkpoint as Concourse A. After screening, Concourse A is to one side and Concourse C to the other.
checkpoints.name: Main Checkpoint

notes: Gates C1-C10
Southwest lists gates C1, C2 and C4. Its ticket counter opens 90 minutes before the first departing flight.
Air Canada's Toronto service is seasonal.
American is due to move to the new Concourse B in late January 2027.

JAX.betweenTerminals: JAX has one terminal and one security checkpoint on the mezzanine. After security you walk to Concourse A or Concourse C; no train or shuttle is needed, and you do not clear security again to switch concourses. A third-party map guide puts the walk between the far ends of the two concourses at about 10 minutes. A new Concourse B between A and C is due to open in late January 2027.

securityWaits.summary: This research found no typical peak times published by JAX. In TSA's hourly screening counts for Sep 13-19, 2026, JAX was busiest from 4am to 7am, peaking 5-6am. There was a second peak at 10-11am. Traffic held fairly steady from 7am to 6pm, dropped after 6pm and was very light after 8pm. Thursday, Monday, Sunday and Friday were the busiest days that week; Tuesday and Saturday were the quietest.
busiestTimes: Thursdays, Mondays, Sundays and Fridays (TSA counts, week of Sep 13, 2026)

JAX.precheckNotes: TSA PreCheck lanes are available at the main checkpoint (Kayak, December 2025). Global Entry, NEXUS and SENTRI members can use PreCheck by adding their Known Traveler Number to their airline booking. This research found no published PreCheck lane hours.
JAX.touchlessId: A March 2026 list of TSA PreCheck Touchless ID airports shows JAX for American and Southwest. Southwest's JAX page also lists a Touchless ID checkpoint. You opt in through your airline profile and need a valid passport.

gettingThere.rideshare: Uber and Lyft may drop off on the Upper Departure Curb only. For pickup, request the ride once you are at the curb; App-Based Rides Service signs are on the Lower Arrival Curb next to baggage claim, at Poles 1 and 2.
gettingThere.transit: Wikipedia lists JTA Route 1 between the airport and downtown Jacksonville. This research could not open JTA's current route pages, and JTA changed Route 1's schedule in June 2026, so check times with JTA before you go.
gettingThere.driving: Daily maximum rates: Hourly Garage $26 (next to the terminal), Daily Garage $22 (behind it), Daily Surface Lot $16 (walking distance), Economy Lots 1-3 $10 (card only). Economy shuttles run 24/7, about every 15 minutes, and stop on the Lower Arrival curb outside Door A. Valet is $30 per 24 hours; drop off at the valet booth on the Departure Level, no reservation needed. Garages and surface lots have been filling up in 2026, so check the parking availability page before you leave.

construction2026: The new Concourse B (six gates) is not open yet. JAX expects a ribbon-cutting on January 27, 2027, with American Airlines starting flights from five of its gates on January 28. Until then, American uses Concourse C.

A third parking garage of about 2,000 spaces is being built next to the existing two and was expected to be finished by Thanksgiving 2026. Garages and surface lots have been filling up, and some travelers have been using the economy lot.
JAX.bagDrop: Delta: check bags at least 45 minutes before a domestic departure, check in at least 30 minutes ahead without bags, and bags are not accepted more than 6 hours ahead. Southwest: bags 45 minutes before a domestic flight (60 minutes international); check-in closes 30 minutes before a domestic flight. JetBlue: bags 45 minutes before departure; check-in 30 minutes ahead without bags. American and United: check in and check bags 45 minutes before domestic departure (AP, May 2025).
tips: JAX has one checkpoint for both concourses, so you can go through security and then walk to your gate on A or C
Early mornings are the busiest time. In mid-September 2026 TSA counts, 5-6am was the peak hour, and the checkpoint opens around 4am.
Driving? Garages and close-in lots have been filling up. Check JAX's parking availability page and allow time for the economy lot shuttle if needed.
Being dropped off by Uber or Lyft? Drop-off is on the Upper Departure Curb only.
Flying American after late January 2027? Check your gate. American is moving to the new Concourse B.

faq.q: How early should I get to Jacksonville airport (JAX)?
faq.a: JAX recommends at least 2 hours before a domestic flight and 3 hours before an international flight. That leaves time to park, check bags and clear security.

faq.q: Is the new Concourse B at JAX open?
faq.a: Not yet. JAX expects to open it with a ribbon-cutting on January 27, 2027. American Airlines is due to start flights from it on January 28.

faq.q: Are JAX's concourses connected after security?
faq.a: Yes. There is one checkpoint, and after it you walk to Concourse A or C without clearing security again.

faq.q: What time does security open at JAX?
faq.a: JAX says the TSA checkpoint opens at 4:00am. The terminal is open 24 hours.

faq.q: Does JAX have CLEAR?
faq.a: No. CLEAR's list of airport locations does not include JAX. TSA PreCheck lanes are available.

JFK.name: John F. Kennedy International Airport

officialArrivalAdvice.domestic: The airport does not publish a set arrival time. JetBlue (Terminal 5) recommends arriving 3 hours before domestic flights at JFK. Delta's general domestic guidance is at least 2 hours.
officialArrivalAdvice.international: JetBlue recommends 4 hours before international flights at JFK. Delta's general international guidance is at least 3 hours.

terminals.name: Terminal 1
notes: Airport lists a 1-5 minute walk from security to all gates

This is the old Terminal 1. The New Terminal One next door has not opened yet: as of September 2026 its operator expects to welcome passengers in Q1 2027. Phase one will have 13 gates plus 1 temporary gate.
For drivers, the Port Authority says to use the Van Wyck Expressway for direct access to Terminals 1 and 4

terminals.name: Terminal 4

checkpoints.notes: CLEAR+ lanes are on the departures level, to the right of the security checkpoint near Row 1 at Delta Priority check-in. Departures-lane hours are mostly 4:30am-10:00pm and vary by day. You can book a free T4 Reserve security time slot 7 days ahead, but availability depends on airline and destination.
checkpoints.name: Terminal 4 Departures checkpoint

notes: Concourse A gates A3-A8 are 3-6 min from security and A9-A21 are 8-10 min
Concourse B gates B18-B31 are 4-6 min, B32-B41 are 7-9 min, and B42-B55 are 10-14 min
A free Delta shuttle between concourses stops at B23, B54 and near A9 without re-screening. The airport notes it may not be faster than walking.
Delta has consolidated all of its JFK operations in Terminal 4

terminals.name: Terminal 5
notes: Gates 501-507 are 3-5 min from security, 508-521 are 5-10 min, and 522-530 are 3-7 min
JetBlue lists the T5 TSA checkpoint hours as 3:00am-12:00am and the ticket counter as 2:30am-12:00am
The terminal is being upgraded, with completion planned for 2026
Ride-app (Uber/Lyft) pickups have moved to the Howard Beach AirTrain station lot. Drop-offs still happen in front of the terminal.

terminals.name: Terminal 7
notes: Airport lists a 1-5 minute walk from security to all gates
Since 9/22/2026, departures drop-off is on the ground level of the Terminal 7 parking garage, not at the curb
Ride-app pickups have moved to the Howard Beach AirTrain station lot
Terminal 7 is being replaced by the new Terminal 6, which is still under construction

terminals.name: Terminal 8
notes: Gates 1-10 are 2-5 min from security and 12-20 are 2-4 min
Gates 31-41 are 6-12 min and 42-47 are 6-8 min
For drivers, the Port Authority says to use the JFK Expressway for direct access to Terminals 5, 7 and 8

JFK.betweenTerminals: Take the AirTrain, which links all terminals in under 10 minutes and is free between terminals. Trains run every 5-15 minutes. You must go through TSA screening again at the new terminal.
JFK.precheckNotes: We could not confirm which JFK checkpoints have PreCheck from an official source. CLEAR's JFK page lists PreCheck hours alongside the Terminal 4 CLEAR lanes.
JFK.touchlessId: Delta offers TSA PreCheck Touchless ID at JFK Terminal 4 for domestic and international flights, including dedicated Touchless ID bag drop. We could not confirm Touchless ID for other airlines or terminals at JFK.

gettingThere.rideshare: Rideshare drivers generally drop off and pick up in front of each terminal. Exceptions: Terminal 5 and 7 ride-app pickups are at the Howard Beach AirTrain station lot (the AirTrain ride there is free), and Terminal 7 drop-offs are on the ground level of the T7 parking garage. The free Lefferts Blvd AirTrain lot is another drop-off option that avoids the terminal curbs (about an 8-minute AirTrain ride to the terminals).
gettingThere.transit: LIRR trains take about 20 minutes from Penn Station or Grand Central to Jamaica. From Jamaica, take AirTrain JFK, which also connects to the subway at Jamaica and Howard Beach. The AirTrain costs $8.75 when you enter or exit at Jamaica or Howard Beach and is free between terminals. The Port Authority strongly advises using mass transit during construction.
gettingThere.driving: Under the new roadway layout, use the Van Wyck Expressway for Terminals 1 and 4 and the JFK Expressway for Terminals 5, 7 and 8. Expect detours and closures on the airport roads during construction. The Port Authority urges pre-booking parking at least 3 hours ahead, because drive-up parkers without a booking pay a peak-period surcharge.

construction2026: JFK's $19 billion redevelopment is underway. The Port Authority warns drivers and for-hire riders to expect delays, detours and closures on airport roads and strongly advises mass transit.
New Terminal One (replacing Terminal 1) has been delayed from 2026. As of September 2026, passengers are expected in the first quarter of 2027.
New Terminal 6 (on the old T6/T7 site, with JetBlue as partner airline) was slated to open its first gates in late 2026. It had not been confirmed open as of mid-September 2026.
Terminal 7 departures drop-off moved into the T7 parking garage (ground level) on 9/22/2026. The T7 taxi stand has also moved to the garage.
Ride-app pickups for Terminals 5 and 7 have moved to the Howard Beach AirTrain station lot until further notice
JFK.bagDrop: Delta at JFK: domestic bags must be checked at least 60 minutes before departure (45 minutes without bags), international check-in closes 1 hour before, and you must be at the gate 15 minutes before departure. JetBlue at JFK: check-in and bags 45 minutes before domestic departures and 60 minutes before international.
tips: JetBlue recommends arriving 3 hours early for domestic flights and 4 hours early for international flights at JFK. That is longer than many travelers expect.
If your flight leaves from Terminal 7, your driver will drop you inside the T7 parking garage (ground level), not at the curb
To skip the terminal curbs, get dropped at the free Lefferts Blvd AirTrain lot and take the free AirTrain to your terminal (about 8 minutes)
Terminal 4 gates B42-B55 are listed at 10-14 minutes' walk from security, so allow extra time at the gate end
Check the airport's alerts before late-night trips: AirTrain JFK has scheduled overnight shutdowns, with shuttle buses running instead
The New Terminal One is not open yet. Airlines such as Air France, Lufthansa and Korean Air still operate from the existing Terminal 1.

faq.q: How early should I get to JFK?
faq.a: The airport does not publish a set time. JetBlue recommends 3 hours before domestic flights and 4 hours before international flights at JFK. Delta's general guidance is at least 2 hours for domestic and 3 hours for international. Construction on airport roads can add travel time, so the Port Authority advises using mass transit.

faq.q: Is JFK's New Terminal One open?
faq.a: Not yet. As of September 2026, the New Terminal One is expected to welcome passengers in the first quarter of 2027. Until then, its future airlines operate from their current terminals.

faq.q: Can I walk between terminals at JFK after security?
faq.a: No. You travel between terminals on the free AirTrain and must go through TSA screening again at your new terminal. The exception is Terminal 4, where Delta's free shuttle links the concourses without re-screening.

LAS.name: Harry Reid International Airport

officialArrivalAdvice.domestic: Arrive at least 2 hours before your scheduled departure; allow extra time on weekends, holidays and during major conventions
officialArrivalAdvice.international: Arrive at least 3 hours before your scheduled departure

terminals.name: Terminal 1 (A, B, C and D gates)

checkpoints.notes: 3:15 a.m.-1 a.m. per LAS security page (another LAS page says 3:30 a.m.-1 a.m.). CLEAR lane 4 a.m.-8 p.m. Sun/Mon/Thu/Fri and 4 a.m.-7:30 p.m. Tue/Wed/Sat.
checkpoints.name: A/B Gates checkpoint

checkpoints.notes: 3:05 a.m.-10 p.m. per LAS security page (another LAS page says closing 9:30 p.m.). CLEAR 4 a.m.-8 p.m.
checkpoints.name: C Gates (Southwest) / C Annex checkpoint

checkpoints.notes: Open 24 hours. CLEAR 4 a.m.-10 p.m.
checkpoints.name: C/D Gates checkpoint

notes: Terminal 1 has ticketing, check-in and baggage claim for airlines using A, B, C and D gates
D gates are a satellite concourse reached by automated tram
Rideshare pickup is on Level 2 of the Terminal 1 parking garage
The RTC public bus stop (Routes 108 and Red Line) is at Terminal 1, Level Zero

terminals.name: Terminal 3 (D and E gates)

checkpoints.notes: 3:30 a.m.-1:30 a.m. CLEAR 4 a.m.-8 p.m. Sun/Mon/Thu/Fri and 4 a.m.-7:30 p.m. Tue/Wed/Sat.
checkpoints.name: Terminal 3 Level 2 checkpoint (D and E gates)

checkpoints.notes: TSA PreCheck travelers only; self-service screening pilot. 5 a.m.-1:30 p.m. per LAS security page and Aug 2026 reporting (another LAS page says 6 a.m.-2 p.m.).
checkpoints.name: Innovation Checkpoint (Terminal 3, Level Zero)

notes: Home to all international airlines and some domestic carriers, and has its own ticketing, check-in, baggage claim and Customs
An automated tram connects Terminal 3 to the D gates
Rideshare pickup is on the Valet Level of the Terminal 3 parking garage

LAS.betweenTerminals: Airside, trams connect Terminal 1 and Terminal 3 to the D gates, and LAS says Terminal 3 security can be used for Terminal 1 flights. Landside, a free inter-terminal shuttle runs about every 20-30 minutes from Level Zero at each terminal.

securityWaits.summary: LAS shows estimated current and hourly expected checkpoint waits on its Security Wait Times page (added April 2026). It warns these change minute to minute and should not be used to plan a later arrival.

LAS.precheckNotes: LAS's site does not list PreCheck lanes by checkpoint. The Terminal 3 Innovation Checkpoint (Level Zero, about 5 a.m.-1:30 p.m.) is PreCheck-only, with self-service screening. Since Sept 2026, PreCheck members can reserve Gateside passes 1-3 days ahead on TSA.gov to go airside without a ticket.
LAS.touchlessId: LAS is on an April 2026 list of 65 airports with TSA PreCheck Touchless ID; participating airlines there were not specified. Opt in with your airline.

gettingThere.rideshare: Uber and Lyft drop off at the regular Departures curbs of Terminal 1 and Terminal 3. Pickups are in the garages: Level 2 at Terminal 1 and Valet Level at Terminal 3.
gettingThere.transit: RTC Route 108 (Paradise) and the Red Line (formerly Route 109, Maryland Parkway) stop at Terminal 1, Level Zero. Terminal 3 travelers take the inter-terminal shuttle. LAS does not publish typical travel times to the Strip.
gettingThere.driving: Both terminals have garages; there are 17,000+ public spaces including Economy and a Remote Lot with free shuttles. New parking rates took effect July 1, 2026. Discounted Terminal 3 Long Term parking ($16, Sat-Wed) requires a reservation. Expect lane reductions in the Airport Connector Tunnels through December 2026.

construction2026: Airport Connector Tunnel pavement project: since Aug 10, 2026, northbound and southbound tunnels are down to two lanes from 5 a.m. to midnight, and to one lane from midnight to 5 a.m. Sunday-Friday. Expected to finish by end of December 2026; LAS advises extra travel time.
Separate Clark County Public Works I-215/Airport Connector Interchange project and NDOT Sunset Road paving project are also under way, per LAS
Parking rates changed July 1, 2026
LAS.bagDrop: Delta at LAS: check-in at least 45 min before departure with or without bags, 1 hour for international-bound flights, at the gate 15 min before. Southwest: bags 45 min, check-in 30 min (domestic). Alaska: check-in and bag drop typically close 40 min before departure.
tips: Parked at Terminal 3 but flying from Terminal 1 with no bags? LAS suggests using the Terminal 3 checkpoint and taking the tram, since it connects to the D gates and Terminal 1.
The C/D Gates checkpoint in Terminal 1 is open 24 hours, while the other checkpoints close overnight
PreCheck members flying from Terminal 3 in the morning can use the self-service Innovation Checkpoint on Level Zero, open about 5 a.m.-1:30 p.m.
Remote Lot and Economy parking are cheaper; discounted Terminal 3 Long Term ($16) is reservation-only and Saturday-Wednesday only
The Airport Connector Tunnels have reduced lanes through December 2026, so allow extra driving time
LAS warns that weekends, holidays and big conventions can call for more than the standard 2 hours

faq.q: How early should I get to the Las Vegas airport?
faq.a: Harry Reid International recommends at least 2 hours before domestic flights and 3 hours before international flights. Add extra time on weekends, holidays or during major conventions.

faq.q: Which terminal is my airline in at LAS?
faq.a: Southwest, American, Delta, Allegiant and Sun Country use Terminal 1. United, Alaska, JetBlue, Frontier, Hawaiian and all international airlines use Terminal 3. A free courtesy shuttle connects the terminals landside about every 20-30 minutes, so go to the right terminal if you are checking bags.

faq.q: Is any security checkpoint at LAS open 24 hours?
faq.a: Yes. The Terminal 1 C/D Gates checkpoint is open 24 hours. The A/B, C Annex and Terminal 3 checkpoints open between about 3 and 3:30 a.m. and close in the late evening or after midnight.

LAX.name: Los Angeles International Airport

officialArrivalAdvice.domestic: Allow at least 2 hours before domestic departures to check bags, clear security and reach the gate
officialArrivalAdvice.international: Arrive 3 hours before international flights

terminals.name: Terminal 1
notes: JetBlue moved here from Terminal 5 in October 2025
LAX-it rideshare and taxi pickup lot is just east of Terminal 1
Terminal 1.5 links Terminals 1 and 2 and has a bus gate to Tom Bradley

LAX.betweenTerminals: LAWA says most terminals are connected after security by walkways; long walks are possible (Terminal 4 to Terminals 6-8 is via an underground walkway). The SkyLink people mover is not yet open to passengers.
LAX.precheckNotes: A third-party September 2026 guide reports a PreCheck lane at each terminal's checkpoint, with hours that vary by terminal. Checkpoints generally open around 4-5am and close between 11:30pm and 2:30am depending on terminal; check with your airline.
LAX.touchlessId: TSA PreCheck Touchless ID is listed at LAX for Alaska, American, Delta, Southwest and United (opt in through your airline profile)

gettingThere.rideshare: Uber and Lyft drop off at the terminal curbs on the upper Departures level. Pickup is only at the LAX-it lot east of Terminal 1: walk there or take the free LAX-it shuttle from the lower Arrivals level.
gettingThere.transit: LAX/Metro Transit Center has Metro C and K line rail connections; a free LAX shuttle runs from pink 'LAX Shuttles' signs on the lower Arrivals level. FlyAway buses serve Union Station and Van Nuys.
gettingThere.driving: The Central Terminal Area loop is congested and under construction, with roadway closures and detours. Westbound Century Boulevard between Jetway Boulevard and Vicksburg Avenue has nightly full closures Sept 21-Nov 13, 2026. Reserve parking at parking.flylax.com, since lots can fill on peak days.

construction2026: SkyLink automated people mover still in testing and not open to travelers as of Aug 2026; it missed the World Cup target, and the contractor is in litigation with the city (project longstop Dec 8, 2026)
Terminal 5 closed (since Oct 2025) for demolition and rebuild, expected to reopen in 2028; American moved to Terminal 4, JetBlue to Terminal 1 and Spirit to Terminal 2
Airfield and Terminal Modernization Program roadway work (4.4 miles of roads) has periodic closures through 2030, including Sepulveda/Century pedestrian bridge work
Nightly directional full closures of westbound Century Boulevard (Jetway Blvd to Vicksburg Ave) Sept 21-Nov 13, 2026
Active work at Tom Bradley International Terminal, Terminal 4 and the future Terminal 5 continued into fall 2026
LAX.bagDrop: Delta: bags 45 minutes before domestic departure (30 minutes without bags); be at the gate 15 minutes before. United and American: 45 minutes for domestic, 60 minutes for international. Alaska: 50 minutes with or without bags (60 international). Southwest: checked bags 45 minutes before domestic departure.
tips: Terminal 5 is closed: American now checks in at Terminal 4, JetBlue at Terminal 1 and Spirit at Terminal 2
Rideshare and taxi pickups are not at the terminal curb; they're at the LAX-it lot east of Terminal 1
The SkyLink train is not running yet, so allow time for shuttle buses if you're coming from the Metro Transit Center or remote lots
United's Terminal 8 has no checkpoint of its own; screen at Terminal 7
Reserve parking ahead at parking.flylax.com; LAX says pre-booking is the only way to guarantee a space

faq.q: How early should I get to LAX?
faq.a: LAX recommends allowing at least 2 hours before domestic flights and 3 hours before international flights. Add time for traffic and construction around the terminal loop.

faq.q: Is the LAX train (SkyLink people mover) open?
faq.a: Not as of the latest reporting (August 2026). SkyLink is about 99% built but still testing, and it missed its World Cup opening target. Use the free shuttles for now.

faq.q: Where do Uber and Lyft pick up at LAX?
faq.a: At the LAX-it lot just east of Terminal 1. You can walk there or take the free LAX-it shuttle from the lower Arrivals level. Drop-offs still happen at the terminal curbs.

LGA.name: LaGuardia Airport

officialArrivalAdvice.domestic: The airport does not publish a set arrival time. Delta and JetBlue (LGA page) both recommend arriving at least 2 hours before domestic departures.
officialArrivalAdvice.international: Delta recommends arriving at least 3 hours before international departures.

terminals.name: Terminal A (Marine Air Terminal)
notes: On the airport's terminal list it appears as the historic Marine Air Terminal, serving Modern Aviation. No commercial airlines are listed there.

terminals.name: Terminal B

checkpoints.notes: TSA PreCheck is available, as is TSA PreCheck Touchless ID with participating airlines. B-FAST Express Pass is a paid front-of-line lane. JetBlue lists the checkpoint hours as 3:30am-11:00pm.
checkpoints.name: Terminal B security

notes: Gates 11-31 are about 4-6 min from security and gates 40-59 about 6-9 min
Curbside check-in is available. American charges $4 per bag on top of bag fees; Southwest charges only standard bag fees.
Ride-app pickup is on Level 2 of the Terminal B parking garage

terminals.name: Terminal C

checkpoints.notes: CLEAR+ lanes are in front of the security checkpoint entrance on Level 3. Hours are Sun-Fri 4:30am-9:00pm and Sat 4:30am-5:30pm.
checkpoints.name: Terminal C security, Level 3

notes: Gates 60-69 are 9-11 min from security, 70-79 are 5-7 min, 80-89B are 3-5 min, and 92-98 are 5-10 min
Delta offers free curbside check-in (standard bag fees apply)
Ride-app pickup is in the Arrivals inner lane

LGA.betweenTerminals: A free on-airport bus connects all terminals, and a pedestrian path links Terminals B and C. The airport's connections guide does not say whether you must clear security again.
LGA.precheckNotes: Terminal B has TSA PreCheck and Touchless ID for select airlines. We could not confirm PreCheck lane details for Terminal C on the airport site.
LGA.touchlessId: Delta lists LGA for TSA PreCheck Touchless ID, with dedicated Touchless ID bag drop. Southwest also lists LGA. The Terminal B page says Touchless ID is available through select participating airlines.

gettingThere.rideshare: Drop off at the terminal departures curb, which is for active drop-offs only. Ride-app pickup: Terminal B is on Level 2 of the Terminal B parking garage, and Terminal C is in the Arrivals inner lane. Confirm the spot in your app.
gettingThere.transit: The LaGuardia Link Q70 bus is free year-round and serves Terminals B and C. It connects to the Jackson Heights-Roosevelt Av and 74 St-Broadway subway hubs and to LIRR at Woodside. Five MTA bus routes stop outside each terminal.
gettingThere.driving: Curbs are for active drop-off and pickup only, and unattended vehicles are towed. The free Cell Phone Lot is off-airport on 94th Street between 23rd Avenue and Ditmars Blvd (open 7:00am-11:59pm). The Port Authority urges pre-booking parking, because drive-up parkers without a booking pay a peak-period surcharge.

LGA.bagDrop: Delta at LGA: domestic bags and check-in close 45 minutes before departure, international check-in closes 1 hour before, and you must be at the gate 15 minutes before departure. JetBlue at LGA: check-in and bags 45 minutes before domestic departures. JetBlue's LGA counter opens 2 hours before departure and closes 30 minutes before.
tips: Terminal C gates 60-69 are listed at 9-11 minutes' walk from security, the longest at LGA
The Q70 LaGuardia Link bus is free all year and connects to the subway and LIRR. It is a cheap way to avoid the terminal roads.
Whoever picks you up cannot wait at the curb. They should use the Cell Phone Lot on 94th Street until you are outside with your bags.
American's curbside check-in at Terminal B costs $4 per bag extra, while Delta's curbside at Terminal C has no extra fee

faq.q: How early should I get to LaGuardia?
faq.a: The airport does not publish a set time. Delta and JetBlue both recommend arriving at least 2 hours before domestic flights, and Delta recommends 3 hours for international. Delta and JetBlue stop checking bags 45 minutes before domestic departures at LGA.

faq.q: Which terminal is my airline at LaGuardia?
faq.a: Delta operates Terminal C. Terminal B serves American, United, Southwest, JetBlue, Air Canada, Frontier and Porter.

faq.q: Is there free public transit to LaGuardia?
faq.a: Yes. The LaGuardia Link Q70 bus is fare-free year-round. It runs between Terminals B and C and the Jackson Heights-Roosevelt Av subway hub, with an LIRR connection at Woodside.

LHR.name: London Heathrow Airport
LHR.passportControl: The UK has no exit passport control, so no border officer checks you on the way out. Routine embarkation checks at airports ended in 1998. Since April 2015, exit checks work through passport data your airline sends to the Home Office (Advance Passenger Information). If you fly British Airways long-haul from Terminal 3 or 5 with hand baggage only, BA says it must check your passport and visa before security, so go to an Assistance desk first. Heathrow is not a US preclearance airport, so you clear US immigration and customs after you land.

officialArrivalAdvice.international: Heathrow recommends arriving three hours before your flight if you are travelling internationally (long-haul)

terminals.name: Terminal 2 (The Queen's Terminal)

checkpoints.notes: Heathrow sells Fast Track security from £12.99 per person, booked in one-hour arrival windows, 06:00-21:00 daily. Premium cabins and some frequent flyers may already have it; check with your airline.
checkpoints.name: Departures security

notes: Mainly Star Alliance airlines, including United
Terminals 2 and 3 share one rail station and are within walking distance of each other
Heathrow Express from Paddington takes about 15 minutes to Terminals 2 & 3

terminals.name: Terminal 3

checkpoints.notes: Fast Track security can be booked from £12.99 per person, 06:00-21:00 daily.
checkpoints.name: Departures security

checkpoints.notes: Private security channel for Virgin Atlantic Upper Class passengers.
checkpoints.name: Virgin Atlantic Upper Class Wing

notes: Heathrow lists American, Delta, Virgin Atlantic and Alaska in T3; British Airways operates from both T3 and T5, so check your booking
Virgin Atlantic: arrive in Zone A and follow signs to its bag drop
BA overnight bag drop at T3 runs 16:00-21:30 for flights leaving before 10:00 the next day

terminals.name: Terminal 4
notes: Heathrow lists no US airline at T4, and this research found no nonstop US flights from it; SkyTeam's Air France uses T4 if you fly home via Paris
Heathrow Express does not stop at T4; ride it to Terminals 2 & 3 and change to the free Elizabeth line (about 4 more minutes)
The T4 multi-storey car park closed on 23 June 2026 for redevelopment; parking is now in Zone A of the T4 Park & Ride, with free shuttles every five minutes

terminals.name: Terminal 5

checkpoints.notes: Fast Track security can be booked from £12.99 per person, 06:00-21:00 daily; BA premium cabins and some status holders may have it included.
checkpoints.name: Departures security

notes: British Airways' main Heathrow hub
Gates in satellites B and C are reached by an underground people mover (the Transit) after security
BA overnight bag drop at T5 runs 16:00-22:00 for flights leaving before 10:00 the next day
Heathrow Express from Paddington takes about 21 minutes to T5

LHR.betweenTerminals: Terminals 2 and 3 are a short walk apart. Heathrow Express is free between Terminals 2 & 3 and Terminal 5 (get a free ticket at the platform machines or tap in with contactless or Oyster). The Elizabeth line is free from Terminals 2 & 3 to Terminal 4. Airside transfer buses are for connecting passengers only.

securityWaits.summary: Heathrow's published figures show average security queues under five minutes at every terminal, though they leave out time walking through the queue area. In a Which? member survey (April 2025, published May 2026), passengers estimated about 17 minutes at T5, 18 at T3, 19 at T2 and 23 at T4. The Heathrow app shows live security times.

gettingThere.rideshare: Taxis to central London take at least an hour, depending on traffic. Every car that enters a terminal drop-off area pays a £7 charge per visit (raised from £6 on 1 January 2026). Pay online or by phone by midnight the next day; unpaid charges lead to an £80 penalty.
gettingThere.transit: Heathrow Express runs non-stop from London Paddington every 15 minutes: about 15 minutes to Terminals 2 & 3 and 21 minutes to Terminal 5 (no T4 stop). The Elizabeth line serves Terminals 2 & 3 (6 trains an hour), Terminal 4 (4 an hour) and Terminal 5 (2 an hour); fares through Zone 1 start at £13.90. The Piccadilly line (Underground) stops at Terminals 2 & 3, 4 and 5, runs about every 10 minutes and takes under an hour from central London; fares from £5.50.
gettingThere.driving: Drop-off at the terminal costs £7 per visit. Drop-off is free at Heathrow's Park & Ride car parks, with a free bus to the terminal. Terminal 4 parking moved to Park & Ride Zone A in June 2026.

construction2026: Terminal 4 redevelopment: the T4 multi-storey car park closed on 23 June 2026. Plans include a replacement car park, a reconfigured drop-off area and upgraded facilities. T4 stays open, and drop-off continues as normal for now.
LHR.bagDrop: British Airways: check-in closes 60 minutes before long-haul departures at Heathrow (90 minutes for some destinations; check Manage My Booking). Virgin Atlantic: check-in opens four hours and closes one hour before departure. American: 60 minutes for check-in and bags on flights from outside the US. Delta: check in at least 1 hour before departure. United: generally at least 1 hour before international departures.
tips: Heathrow's new scanners let you keep liquids in containers up to 2 litres, and laptops, in your bag at Terminals 2, 3, 4 and 5. Empty metal or insulated bottles before security.
Check your terminal before you leave: United and JetBlue use T2; American, Delta, Virgin Atlantic and Alaska use T3; British Airways uses T5 and some T3.
Flying BA long-haul from T3 or T5 with hand baggage only? Go to a BA Assistance desk for a passport and visa check before security.
Being dropped off by car? Pay the £7 drop-off charge online by midnight the next day, or use the free drop-off at a Park & Ride car park.
Use the Heathrow app for live security times. Fast Track security costs from £12.99 and runs 06:00-21:00.

faq.q: How early should I get to Heathrow for a flight to the US?
faq.a: Heathrow recommends arriving three hours before an international flight. Most airlines' bag drop closes 60 minutes before departure for US flights, so do not cut it closer than that.

faq.q: Do I go through passport control when leaving the UK?
faq.a: No. The UK has no exit passport control. Your airline sends your passport details to the Home Office, and BA checks documents for hand-baggage-only long-haul passengers at an Assistance desk.

faq.q: Which Heathrow terminal is my flight to the US from?
faq.a: United and JetBlue fly from Terminal 2. American, Delta, Virgin Atlantic and Alaska fly from Terminal 3. British Airways flies mainly from Terminal 5, with some flights from Terminal 3.

faq.q: Can I take liquids over 100ml through Heathrow security?
faq.a: Yes. Containers up to 2 litres can stay in your cabin bag at Terminals 2, 3, 4 and 5. Many other airports still have a 100ml limit.

faq.q: What is the fastest way from central London to Heathrow?
faq.a: Heathrow Express from Paddington, about 15 minutes to Terminals 2 & 3 and 21 minutes to Terminal 5, every 15 minutes. For Terminal 4, change to the free Elizabeth line at Terminals 2 & 3.

MAD.name: Adolfo Suárez Madrid-Barajas Airport

officialArrivalAdvice.international: Aena does not publish a general arrival time for Madrid-Barajas. Delta suggests arriving at least 3 hours before an international flight.

MAD.passportControl: A flight to the US leaves the Schengen area, so you pass Spanish passport control after security, and the EU Entry/Exit System (EES) records your exit; Madrid-Barajas was the first Spanish airport to start EES, on October 12, 2025. In T1 (Delta, United, Air Europa), passport control is to the right after the security checkpoint; if your T4 flight (Iberia, American) leaves from the T4S satellite, you ride the people mover there and pass passport control on level -1 before going up to the S gates. In February 2026, The Objective reported long queues at T4 passport control for several days, with police sources saying the system ran slower than expected because officers must take fingerprints and photos, and in May 2026 Merca2 reported waits of more than 60 minutes at Barajas and El Prat. Aena lists its automated border gates for EU, Iceland, Norway and Swiss citizens only, so US passport holders should expect a staffed booth. Spain was not among the nine countries reported in September 2026 to have informal EU approval to keep pausing biometric capture.

terminals.name: Terminal T1

checkpoints.notes: Screens at the checkpoint show estimated waiting times. Aena offers Fast Track for first and business class passengers in all terminals. For non-Schengen flights, passport control is to the right after security.
checkpoints.name: Terminal T1 security checkpoint

notes: Delta checks in on the 1st floor at desks 130-135
United checks in on the 1st floor at desks 140-149
Air Europa checks in for non-Schengen flights, including the US, on the 1st floor at desks 206-222; its Schengen flights use T2
Aena says desk numbers can change, so check the screens in the terminal

terminals.name: Terminal T4 and T4 Satellite (T4S)

checkpoints.notes: Fully opened in summer 2026 with 36 scanners, so you can keep liquids and electronic devices in your carry-on. It has lanes for families and passengers with reduced mobility and a separate Fast Track area. Screens show estimated waiting times.
checkpoints.name: T4 central security checkpoint (floor +2)

notes: Iberia checks in on floor 2; desks 870-899 serve the USA, Japan and the United Kingdom, and desks 780-799 serve business class
American checks in on floor 2 at desks 930-949
Aena describes the T4 main building as handling check-in, security and boarding for domestic and Schengen flights, with the T4S satellite used for international hub flights
From T4 (gates H, J, K, floor -2) the automated people mover takes about 5 minutes to T4S and runs every 4 to 12 minutes, all day, every day
In T4S, go to level -1 for passport control, then up to level 1 for the S (non-Schengen) gates

MAD.betweenTerminals: A free bus links T1, T2 and T4 24 hours a day. It runs every 5 minutes from 6:00 to 22:00 and every 20 minutes from 22:00 to 6:00. Stops are T1 floor 1, T2 floor 2 (departures) and T4 floor 2 (departures). An automated train links T4 and T4S; the ride takes about 5 minutes.

securityWaits.summary: Aena does not publish security wait times online, but screens at the T1, T2 and T4 security checkpoints show estimated waits. For US-bound travelers in 2026, the bigger risk has been EES passport control: T4 had long queues in February 2026, and waits of more than 60 minutes were reported at Barajas in May 2026.

gettingThere.rideshare: Madrid taxis charge a flat fare of 33 euros between the airport and anywhere inside the M-30 ring road, 24 hours a day, with no supplements added. Official taxis are white with a red stripe and the city coat of arms.
gettingThere.transit: Metro Line 8 runs from Nuevos Ministerios to the airport, with stations at T1-T2-T3 (in T2, floor 1) and T4 (floor -1), from 6:05 to 2:00. A 3 euro airport supplement is added to the regular fare. Cercanías line C1 links Príncipe Pío, Atocha and Chamartín with a station in T4 only. The 203 Airport Express bus runs 24 hours between Atocha station and the airport (T1, T2 and T4) for a flat 5 euros.
gettingThere.driving: T4 has the P4, First Class and Long Stay car parks. Aena takes parking bookings through its app or parking.aena.es and gives discounts for app bookings; the plate on the booking must match the car.

construction2026: In July 2026 Aena put out to tender a 35-month expansion of the T4 North apron, to be built in five phases alongside normal operations
Aena also tendered a 24-month extension of the T4S south pier by 36 meters, adding three new boarding bridges for non-Schengen flights
Aena's wider plan, mostly for 2027-2031, extends T4 and T4S and adds a new processor building in front of T1, T2 and T3. Aena has not announced passenger impacts
MAD.bagDrop: Delta: MAD is not on Delta's list of exceptions, so its international rule applies: be checked in at least 1 hour before departure and at the gate 45 minutes before. United: check in at least 1 hour before an international flight. Iberia's and American's MAD cutoffs were not confirmed here, so check your booking.
tips: Check your terminal: Delta, United and Air Europa's US flights check in at T1, while Iberia and American use T4
On Iberia or American, budget extra time for the people mover to T4S (about 5 minutes, every 4-12 minutes) and passport control there
At the T4 central security checkpoint, liquids and electronics can stay in your carry-on
US passports cannot use Aena's automated border gates, which are for EU, Iceland, Norway and Swiss citizens
Cercanías trains stop only at T4. For T1, take Metro Line 8, the 203 Airport Express bus or the free shuttle bus from T4

faq.q: How early should I get to Madrid airport for a flight to the US?
faq.a: At least 3 hours before departure. Delta suggests 3 hours for international flights, and EES passport queues at Barajas were reported at more than an hour in 2026.

faq.q: Which Madrid terminal is my US flight in?
faq.a: Delta and United check in at T1, and so does Air Europa for non-Schengen flights. Iberia and American check in at T4. Aena says the T4S satellite handles international hub flights, and its S gates serve non-Schengen flights.

faq.q: How do I get from T4 to T4S?
faq.a: Take the automated people mover from floor -2 of T4. The ride is about 5 minutes and trains run every 4 to 12 minutes. In T4S, go to level -1 for passport control, then up to the S gates.

faq.q: How much is a taxi to Madrid airport?
faq.a: A flat 33 euros from anywhere inside the M-30 ring road, at any hour, with no supplements.

MCI.name: Kansas City International Airport

officialArrivalAdvice.domestic: Allow at least 2 hours before a domestic departure, because check-in and security can take longer at busy times (FlyKC, Nov 2025). Southwest also suggests 120 minutes at MCI.
officialArrivalAdvice.international: Allow at least 2 hours 30 minutes before an international flight (FlyKC, Nov 2025)

terminals.name: Single Terminal (Concourses A and B)

checkpoints.notes: One checkpoint in the middle of the terminal serves both concourses. Since April 2026, most travelers enter at one central point near the middle of the check-in hall, near Dunkin'. General, TSA PreCheck, Touchless ID and one of the two ADA lanes enter side by side there. CLEAR lanes are at either end of the queue area, and CLEAR eGates opened in December 2025. Screening officers work for the contractor VMD Corp., under TSA oversight, and wear gray shirts. Upgraded Points (Aug 2026) lists 16 lanes. Checkpoint hours are not published.
checkpoints.name: Central Security Checkpoint, Departures level

notes: Concourse A (gates A1-A20): American A1-A6, Alaska A10 and Allegiant A12-A16, per FlyKC's airline page
Concourse B (gates B40-B69): Delta B40-B52, United B43-B51, Frontier B57 and Southwest B54-B69, per FlyKC. Southwest's own site lists B54-B68.
Drop-off and check-in are on the upper Departures level. Check-in areas are on each side of the hall, depending on your airline.
From the garage, lighted crosswalks on Level 3 lead to the check-in counters
Travelers who used to enter security near the United and American check-in desks may now walk farther to the central entry
Wikipedia also lists Sun Country Airlines at MCI; FlyKC's airline page does not

MCI.betweenTerminals: Single terminal. One checkpoint serves Concourses A and B, and you can walk between them after security without screening again. An indoor walkway with moving walkways links them, a few minutes apart.

securityWaits.summary: MCI does not publish typical wait times or peak hours that this research could find. For Thanksgiving 2025, the airport named the Saturday, Sunday and Monday after the holiday as the busiest days, and it expected most parking lots to fill. In April 2026 it made the general boarding queue larger to handle holiday crowds.
busiestTimes: The Saturday, Sunday and Monday after Thanksgiving (FlyKC, Nov 2025)

MCI.precheckNotes: PreCheck lanes are at the central entry, next to general boarding and Touchless ID. FlyKC's airline page lists PreCheck for Alaska, American, Delta, Frontier, Southwest and United, and lists Allegiant as "No". This research could not confirm PreCheck lane hours.
MCI.touchlessId: A TSA Touchless ID lane is at the central security entry (April 2026), and Southwest's MCI page lists a TSA PreCheck Touchless ID checkpoint. Opt in through your airline profile. This research could not confirm which other airlines offer it at MCI.

gettingThere.rideshare: Drop-off is at the upper-level Departures curb. Uber and Lyft pickup is at the Arrivals (lower level) commercial curb, at the purple signposts 2K-2N.
gettingThere.transit: RideKC Route 229 (Boardwalk-KCI) stops at the airport. On weekdays it runs about once an hour; the first trip leaves East Village Transit Center downtown at 5:49am, the last leaves the airport at 10:10pm, and the ride takes about an hour. Since fares returned on June 1, 2026, a ride costs $2, paid by contactless card, phone or the RideKCGO app. Cash is not accepted on board.
gettingThere.driving: Use 1 Kansas City Boulevard, Kansas City, MO 64153 for navigation. Parking on the curbs is not allowed. Garage: $30 daily max. Surface lot (walkable, uncovered): $22 daily max. Economy Lot: $9 per day, with free shuttles about every 15-20 minutes, 24/7. Valet is inside the garage: $40 daily max. The free cell phone lot is at 50 Bern St (45-minute limit).

MCI.bagDrop: Southwest: check bags at least 45 minutes before domestic departure (60 minutes for international) and check in at least 30 minutes before domestic departure. Be at the gate 10 minutes before departure. Its MCI ticket counter opens 90 minutes before the first departing flight. American, United and Delta: check bags at least 45 minutes before domestic departure. Alaska: check in at least 50 minutes before domestic departure.
tips: Security now has one central entry near the middle of the check-in hall, near Dunkin'. CLEAR members enter at either end of the queue area.
You can walk between Concourses A and B after security, so either check-in side gets you to any gate
Do not wait at the curb. Drivers picking someone up should use the free cell phone lot at 50 Bern St (45 minutes max).
Economy parking is $9 a day with a free shuttle every 15-20 minutes. Shuttles stop on the Arrivals level, so take the escalator or elevator up to Departures.
FlyKC expects most lots to fill at holidays. Take a photo of your floor and row so you can find your car.
Taking the 229 bus? Bring a contactless card or phone, or use the RideKCGO app. Buses no longer take cash.

faq.q: How early should I get to Kansas City airport?
faq.a: The airport says to allow at least 2 hours before a domestic flight and 2 hours 30 minutes before an international flight. Southwest also suggests 120 minutes at MCI.

faq.q: How many security checkpoints does Kansas City airport have?
faq.a: One. It sits in the middle of the terminal and serves both concourses. Since April 2026, most travelers enter at one central point near the middle of the check-in hall.

faq.q: Can I walk between Concourse A and Concourse B at MCI?
faq.a: Yes. One checkpoint serves both concourses, and you can walk between them after security without screening again.

faq.q: Where do Uber and Lyft pick up at Kansas City airport?
faq.a: At the Arrivals (lower level) commercial curb, at the purple signposts 2K-2N. Drop-off is at the upper-level Departures curb.

faq.q: Who runs security at Kansas City airport?
faq.a: Screening is done by officers from VMD Corp., a private contractor, under TSA's Screening Partnership Program. TSA audits the work, and the procedures are the same as at TSA-staffed airports.

officialArrivalAdvice.domestic: The Greater Orlando Aviation Authority recommends arriving at the security checkpoint 2 hours before scheduled departure; check with your airline for flight-specific advice

After security you can reach only the paired gate areas: Gates 1-29 with 30-59, or Gates 70-99 with 100-129
Southwest is listed at Gates 70-99 and 100-129; Frontier at Gates 1-29 and 70-99

JetBlue uses Gates C230-C238; most international carriers use C240-C245
Four new gates opened June 30, 2026, and Virgin Atlantic moved all its Orlando flights from Terminal A to Terminal C
Terminal C has early bag storage in its baggage system; ask your airline how early you can check bags

MCO.betweenTerminals: Terminals A and B: walk across Level 3 of the shared building (525 ft). Terminal C: ride the 24-hour Terminal Link people mover from Terminal B to the Train Station, then walk about 1,200 ft through Parking Garage C, or take the 24-hour shuttle bus between Terminal B Level 1 (space B65) and Terminal C Level 1 (space C272). All of these are pre-security, so you must clear security again.

securityWaits.summary: MCO publishes no typical wait figures. On a spring-break Monday morning in March 2026, local news reported waits of about 40 minutes, with lines at times stretching down terminal hallways. In TSA's hourly screening counts for Mar 15-21 and Sep 13-19, 2026, volume stayed high from about 4am through 6pm, and the heaviest hours were 5-9am.
busiestTimes: Sundays (busiest day in both TSA sample weeks)

MCO.precheckNotes: The airport lists normal TSA PreCheck operating hours as 4:00am to 8:30pm and says to check TSA's site to confirm the lanes will be open for your flight time. The airline directory lists PreCheck for nearly every carrier; GOL (Terminal C) is shown as not participating. PreCheck enrollment is offered at the three CLEAR locations at the checkpoints.
MCO.touchlessId: TSA PreCheck Touchless ID has a dedicated lane at MCO, reported in place since at least winter 2026. An April 2026 travel-blog report names Alaska, American, Delta, Southwest and United as participating airlines; you must opt in through your airline profile with your Known Traveler Number and passport. The writer used it at the Gates 70-129 checkpoint and said other checkpoints may differ.

gettingThere.rideshare: Uber, Lyft and other ride-share drop-offs: Departures curb Level 3 at Terminals A and B, Level 2 at Terminal C. Pickups: Arrivals curb Level 2 at A and B 24 hours a day (also the Level 3 Departures curb from 9:00pm to 2:00am); Arrivals curb Level 6 at Terminal C.
gettingThere.transit: Lynx local buses leave from Terminal A, Level 1, Commercial Lane spaces A38-A41 ($2 per trip or $4.50 all day). They serve Downtown Orlando, the Convention Center and the Sand Lake Road SunRail station; SunRail runs Monday to Friday, 5:30am-9:30pm. Brightline trains to South Florida use the MCO Train Station, open daily 5am-11pm. The airport's approximate taxi fare to downtown Orlando is $38-$45.
gettingThere.driving: Jeff Fuqua Blvd is the main entry road. Private cars drop off at Level 3 (Departures) at Terminals A and B or Level 2 at Terminal C, and cannot wait at the curb. The Quick Park ramp at the end of the Departures curb leads to Garages A and B. Free cell phone lots are available for pickups.

construction2026: Gate Link tram replacement for Gates 70-129 ($253M) runs December 2025 to Fall 2027, with one tram line out of service at a time. Departing passengers to Gates 100-129 may be routed by tram to Gates 70-99 and then by COBUS shuttle, and shuttles are routine overnight (11pm-4am). The airport says to expect only a few extra minutes.

The first upgraded Gate Link track to Gates 100-129 entered service October 1, 2026. The second 100-129 track is scheduled to be worked on through December 2026, then the Gates 70-99 lines from December 2026 to October 2027.
Terminal C opened four new gates on June 30, 2026, and Virgin Atlantic moved from Terminal A to Terminal C
Florida directed $2.5M (posted January 2026) to improve the congested Jeff Fuqua Blvd / Station Loop Road junction, the main road into the airport; no construction timeline has been announced
MCO.bagDrop: Terminal C has early bag storage within its baggage system, so ask your airline how far ahead you can check bags. No airline-specific bag cutoffs for MCO were verified.
tips: MCO's 2-hour advice is for arriving at the security checkpoint, not the curb. Add time for parking, rental-car return and bag check.

Without PreCheck or CLEAR, you can book a free MCO Reserve security time slot up to 7 days ahead. Reserve lanes run 5am-5pm at Terminals A and B (flights 6:30am-8:30pm) and 5am-7pm at Terminal C (flights 6:30am-10:30pm), with limited slots.

Check your terminal before you leave: JetBlue and most international airlines are in Terminal C, which has its own entrance, Level 2 drop-off and checkpoint. It is not reachable airside from Terminals A and B.
At Terminals A and B, pick the checkpoint by gate number (1-59 or 70-129). Once through, you can reach only the paired gate area, and a Gate Link tram ride is still needed to reach your gate.
Through Fall 2027, trips to Gates 70-129 may include a COBUS shuttle hop during the Gate Link replacement, so build a few extra minutes in after security

faq.q: How early should I get to Orlando airport (MCO)?
faq.a: The Greater Orlando Aviation Authority recommends arriving at the security checkpoint 2 hours before your scheduled departure, and says to check your airline's own recommendation. Add time for parking, rental-car return and bag drop on top of that.

faq.q: Which terminal is my airline in at MCO?
faq.a: Per the airport's directory, JetBlue and most international airlines (British Airways, Virgin Atlantic, Emirates, Aer Lingus and others) use Terminal C. Southwest, Frontier and Avelo are listed in Terminal A, and American, Delta, United and Alaska in Terminal B.

faq.q: Can I get from Terminal C to Terminals A and B after security?
faq.a: No. Terminal C has its own single checkpoint, and you must clear security again for Terminals A and B. You connect landside on the 24-hour Terminal Link from Terminal B plus a walk of about 1,200 ft through Garage C, or on the 24-hour shuttle bus.

MDW.name: Chicago Midway International Airport

officialArrivalAdvice.domestic: Southwest, Midway's main airline, suggests arriving 120 minutes before domestic flights at MDW. Delta also recommends at least 2 hours. The Chicago Department of Aviation's TSA page gives no arrival time.
officialArrivalAdvice.international: Southwest suggests 120 minutes before international flights at MDW

terminals.name: Main Terminal (Concourses A, B and C)

checkpoints.notes: The CDA lists checkpoint hours of 3:30am-11pm daily and PreCheck 4:30am-8pm daily. CLEAR lane and enrollment run 4am-8pm daily. One checkpoint serves all concourses; Wikipedia says widening the Cicero Avenue bridge made room for up to 17 lanes.
checkpoints.name: Main Security Checkpoint

notes: Concourse A: Southwest, Delta and Volaris (Upgraded Points, Sept 2026). Southwest lists gates A4a, A4b, A9, A11 and A15-A19
Concourse B: Southwest only. Southwest lists gates B1-B3, B5, B7-B12 and B14-B26
Concourse C (gates C1-C3): Upgraded Points lists Frontier, Avelo and North Country Sky
Porter moved its Toronto Billy Bishop flights from Midway to O'Hare on Sept 1, 2026
Drop off at the upper-level departures curb at the concourse for your airline; signs show which concourse each airline uses

MDW.betweenTerminals: Single terminal. All three concourses (A, B and C) are connected after security, so you can walk between them without screening again.

securityWaits.summary: The CDA does not publish a routine wait pattern for Midway. For Labor Day weekend 2026, it projected Monday as Midway's busiest day, with nearly 58,000 travelers.
busiestTimes: The Monday at the end of a holiday weekend (Labor Day 2026 projection)

MDW.precheckNotes: Midway has one checkpoint. Standard screening runs 3:30am-11pm, but the CDA lists PreCheck lanes only from 4:30am to 8pm, so evening flyers may face standard lanes only.
MDW.touchlessId: TSA PreCheck Touchless ID is listed at MDW for Delta and Southwest (opt in through your airline profile); Southwest's MDW page also lists a Touchless ID checkpoint

gettingThere.rideshare: Drop-off is at the upper-level departures curb. Rideshare pickup is on the lower level, center lane, outside baggage claim: Blue Zones A and B (Doors 2-3), Orange Zones C and D (Doors 3-4) and Green Zones E and F (Door 4).
gettingThere.transit: The CTA Orange Line station is east of the terminal, reached by an enclosed walkway (follow 'Trains to City'). The trip downtown takes 20-25 minutes. Trains leave Midway for the Loop from about 3:30am on weekdays, 4am on Saturdays and 4:30am on Sundays, until about 1:05am. The N62 Archer bus runs overnight.
gettingThere.driving: The terminal garage is next to the terminal: hourly parking on Level 1 and daily parking on Levels 2-6 ($43 for 8-24 hours). Economy Garage and Lot at 5050 W. 55th St. cost $15 a day, with free shuttles every 10-15 minutes. The Daily Lot is temporarily closed. The CDA says terminal roadways can get congested at peak times; the CTA Kiss and Ride at 59th and Kilpatrick lets drivers avoid them. Curbside waiting is not allowed; the free cell phone lot is at 61st Street and Cicero Avenue.

construction2026: Runway 22L closed Oct 20, 2026, to repair its safety overrun system, with completion targeted for mid-November. The CDA warns of possible flight delays and cancellations, depending on wind, and says to check flight status before leaving for the airport
The Daily Lot is temporarily closed; the CDA does not give a reopening date
MDW.bagDrop: Southwest: all bags must be checked 45 minutes before scheduled departure (60 minutes for international); check in at least 30 minutes before domestic departure and be at the gate 10 minutes before. Its MDW ticket counter opens 90 minutes before the first departing flight. Delta: bags 45 minutes before domestic departure, 30 minutes to check in without bags.
tips: Midway has one checkpoint for all concourses, and the concourses are connected after security
PreCheck closes at 8pm and CLEAR at 8pm, while standard screening runs until 11pm
Runway 22L is closed until about mid-November 2026, so check your flight status before you leave
Southwest's Midway ticket counter opens 90 minutes before the first flight of the day, and bags must be checked 45 minutes before departure
The CTA Orange Line reaches downtown in 20-25 minutes, and its Kiss and Ride lets drivers skip the terminal roadways
The Daily Lot is closed; the economy lots are $15 a day with shuttles every 10-15 minutes

faq.q: How early should I get to Midway airport?
faq.a: Southwest suggests arriving 120 minutes before your flight at Midway, for both domestic and international flights. Delta also recommends 2 hours for domestic flights.

faq.q: What time does security open at Midway?
faq.a: The checkpoint runs from 3:30am to 11pm every day. PreCheck lanes are open 4:30am to 8pm, and CLEAR 4am to 8pm.

faq.q: Where do Uber and Lyft pick up at Midway?
faq.a: On the lower level outside baggage claim, in the center lane, at Doors 2-4 (Blue, Orange and Green zones).

faq.q: Can you walk between concourses at Midway after security?
faq.a: Yes. Concourses A, B and C are all connected after the checkpoint.

faq.q: How do I get from Midway to downtown Chicago by train?
faq.a: Take the CTA Orange Line from the station next to the terminal. The ride takes 20-25 minutes, and trains run from early morning until about 1am.

Opt in through your airline with your Known Traveler Number and passport on file, and carry a physical ID as backup.

gettingThere.rideshare: Ride-app pickups are on Level 1 (arrivals) and Level 2 (departures); check your app for the designated door number. Check-in and ticketing are on Level 2. Taxis use the Level 1 curb outside baggage claim and have a $15 minimum fare from MIA.
gettingThere.transit: The free MIA Mover (1.25 miles) runs from Level 3 between the Dolphin and Flamingo garages to the Miami Intermodal Center / Central Station. From there take Metrorail ($2.25; the Orange Line serves Brickell and Government Center downtown), Tri-Rail to Fort Lauderdale and West Palm Beach, or Metrobus routes 37, 42, 57, J and the 150 Miami Beach Airport Express ($2.25, every 30 minutes 6am-11:40pm). As of Oct 14, 2026, MIA posts a transit alert that Metrorail riders must transfer at Earlington Heights for the Orange Line train to MIA.
gettingThere.driving: Curbside is for active loading and unloading only; unattended vehicles are towed. Park in the Dolphin (North) garage for American or Qatar Airways and the Flamingo (South) garage for all other airlines.

construction2026: MIA's $14B 'Modernization in Action' program is renovating 600+ elevators, escalators and moving walkways in phases. MIA says under 10% are out of service on an average day, and some units can be down for up to a year.
Restroom renovation Phase 2 (Concourses D, E, F, G, H and J) is scheduled for completion by Fall 2026
Longer-term plans include a full redevelopment of the Central Terminal between Concourses E and G, and a new Concourse K expanding the South Terminal
Metrorail service alert (posted on MIA's homepage, Oct 2026): transfer at Earlington Heights for the Orange Line to MIA
tips: Pick your checkpoint by concourse. MIA's checkpoints are spread across D, E-G and H-J, and only D-E and H-J connect after security, so a walk to the 'wrong' concourse means screening again.
In Concourse D, only Checkpoint 1 is listed with TSA PreCheck (4:00am-8:15pm), while all Central and South Terminal checkpoints list it. Concourses D and E are connected behind security.
Checkpoint 9 (South Terminal) is the only one open 24 hours, and most others open between 3:30am and 4:15am, so very early or late flights should check hours
Concourse D is long. Use the Skytrain on the upper level, which has 4 stations, to reach far gates.
Paid 'Concierge Powered by CLEAR' curb-to-gate escort service launched in June 2026 for all travelers, from $99 for departures; CLEAR membership is not required

faq.q: How early should I get to Miami airport (MIA)?
faq.a: MIA says recommendations vary by airline and day, and cites TSA's guidance: at least 2 hours before domestic flights and 3 hours before international flights. Check your airline's own advice too.

faq.q: Which MIA terminal is my airline in?
faq.a: American uses the North Terminal (Concourse D) and also Concourse E. Delta and United check in at Concourse H in the South Terminal, and most long-haul international carriers are at J. Southwest, Frontier, Alaska and several others are in the Central Terminal (E, F, G).

faq.q: Can I walk between concourses at MIA after security?
faq.a: Only between Concourses D and E, and between H and J. Other moves require leaving the secure area, using the Level 3 moving walkways, and clearing security again. MIA suggests allowing 15 minutes between the North and South Terminals.

MSP.name: Minneapolis-Saint Paul International Airport

officialArrivalAdvice.domestic: Arrive at least 2 hours before domestic flights
officialArrivalAdvice.international: Arrive at least 3 hours before international flights

terminals.name: Terminal 1

checkpoints.notes: To the right as you enter the ticketing lobby; MSP says it often has shorter waits. MSP RESERVE lane is here. All gates reachable.
checkpoints.name: North Checkpoint, Ticketing (Departures) level

checkpoints.notes: All gates reachable. One of the two T1 checkpoints is open 24 hours.
checkpoints.name: South Checkpoint, Ticketing (Departures) level

checkpoints.notes: Temporarily closed per MSP.
checkpoints.name: Skyway Security Checkpoint (Concourse C/G connector bridge)

notes: Security was consolidated from six checkpoints to two (north and south ends of the ticketing lobby) under a $600M program substantially completed in 2025.
Wait-time boards at both ends of the ticketing lobby show current checkpoint waits.
Drivers can drop off or pick up on either level of the Terminal 1 roadway loop; Departures is the upper level.
Terminal 1 FLEX Lane on the left side of Departures Drive serves doors 5-8 (Green/Gold ramps) with sky bridges to ticketing.
Terminal 1 light rail station is below the Red and Blue ramps, reached by tram.

terminals.name: Terminal 2 (Humphrey)

checkpoints.notes: Open 4:00am until the last scheduled departure.
checkpoints.name: Checkpoint 1, Level 2

checkpoints.notes: Open 4:00am-5:15pm; only for TSA PreCheck, MSP RESERVE and Priority passengers.
checkpoints.name: Checkpoint 2, Level 2

notes: Checkpoints are on Level 2 near the Orange and Purple ramp skyways.
Terminal 2 is a separate building at 7150 Humphrey Drive; it is not connected airside to Terminal 1.
Terminal 2 light rail station is on the north side of the Orange Ramp.
Terminal 2 North Expansion ($263M, two added gates near H13/H14) is scheduled to finish in early 2027.

MSP.betweenTerminals: METRO Blue Line light rail; free between the two terminal stations and available 24 hours a day. A shuttle is available for passengers with mobility needs.
MSP.precheckNotes: PreCheck lanes are at open Terminal 1 checkpoints. At Terminal 2, Checkpoint 2 (4:00am-5:15pm) is restricted to PreCheck, MSP RESERVE and Priority passengers. MSP RESERVE is a free reserved security time slot, bookable up to one week ahead; at Terminal 1 the RESERVE lane is at the North Checkpoint and availability is limited.
MSP.touchlessId: TSA lists Touchless ID at 65 airports and tells travelers to check with their airline. Delta lists MSP as a participating airport with dedicated Touchless ID bag drop. A March 2026 third-party list shows Alaska, American, Delta and United participating at MSP.

gettingThere.rideshare: Terminal 1: rideshare pickup is at the Ground Transportation Center, Level 1 of the Green/Gold ramps. Terminal 2: rideshare pickup and drop-off moved to Level 2 of the Purple Ramp, with a sky bridge to the terminal.
gettingThere.transit: METRO Blue Line light rail serves both terminals; about 25 minutes to downtown Minneapolis (Warehouse District). Trains run every 15-30 minutes, roughly 3:30am to midnight. MSP suggests the Blue Line if Hwy 5 is backed up.
gettingThere.driving: Terminal 1 is at 4300 Glumack Drive, Terminal 2 at 7150 Humphrey Drive. Pre-book parking online for the lowest daily rates; bookings must be made at least 12 hours before arrival. Terminal 2 Express Lane on Level 2 of the Purple Ramp is a free, covered, 24-hour drop-off alternative to the curb. Free cell phone lots are on Post Road.

construction2026: Terminal 2 roadway: a fifth curb lane is being added in front of Terminal 2 (work began mid-June 2026, scheduled for completion in late November 2026); at least three lanes stay open during all phases.
Rideshare at Terminal 2 relocated off the front curb to Level 2 of the Purple Ramp ahead of the roadway work.
Post Road was under construction as of July 2026 with eastbound-only traffic (away from Terminal 2 toward Hwy 5, also the route to the cell phone lot).
Concourse G expansion between gates G8 and G13 is underway, expected to finish in 2028.
Terminal 2 North Expansion is under construction, scheduled for completion in early 2027.
MSP.bagDrop: Delta (Terminal 1): domestic bags must be checked at least 45 minutes before departure (30 minutes if no checked bags); bags are not accepted more than 6 hours before departure; be at the gate 15 minutes before departure.
tips: MSP has two separate terminals: Delta and most legacy/foreign carriers use Terminal 1, while Sun Country, Southwest, Frontier and Icelandair use Terminal 2. Confirm before you go.
At Terminal 1, check the wait-time boards at both ends of the ticketing lobby; the North Checkpoint (right as you enter) often has shorter waits and every gate is reachable from either checkpoint.
MSP RESERVE lets you book a free security time slot up to a week ahead; at Terminal 1 the lane is at the North Checkpoint.
Terminal 2 Checkpoint 2 is PreCheck/RESERVE/Priority only and closes at 5:15pm; after that everyone uses Checkpoint 1.
Parking reservations must be made at least 12 hours before arrival, so book the night before at the latest.
Through late November 2026, Terminal 2 curb lane construction can slow traffic; the free Terminal 2 Express Lane in the Purple Ramp avoids the curb.

faq.q: How early should I get to MSP?
faq.a: The Metropolitan Airports Commission advises arriving at least 2 hours before a domestic flight and 3 hours before an international flight. Delta also requires bags to be checked at least 45 minutes before domestic departures.

faq.q: Which terminal is Sun Country or Southwest at MSP?
faq.a: Sun Country, Southwest, Frontier and Icelandair use Terminal 2 (Humphrey). Delta, American, United, Alaska and most international carriers use Terminal 1.

faq.q: How do I get between Terminal 1 and Terminal 2 at MSP?
faq.a: Take the METRO Blue Line light rail, which is free between the two terminal stations and runs 24 hours a day. The two terminals are separate buildings, so arrive at the correct one for your airline.

MSY.name: Louis Armstrong New Orleans International Airport

officialArrivalAdvice.domestic: MSY recommends arriving at least two hours before the scheduled departure time for domestic flights

terminals.name: Main Terminal (Concourses A, B and C)

checkpoints.notes: The only checkpoint, serving all gates. MSY says it opens at 3:30am and stays open until 30 minutes before the last scheduled departure. MSY says dedicated CLEAR lanes are available for standard and PreCheck screening, for all airlines. CLEAR lists its lanes here as closing at 7pm.
checkpoints.name: Consolidated Security Checkpoint, Level 2

notes: All passengers use one security checkpoint on Level 2 of the terminal
The three concourses (A, B and C) are connected inside the secure area
Concourse A handles international flights and has the customs facility
A May 2026 airport guide places Southwest and American on Concourse B and Delta and United on Concourse C. MSY does not publish airline concourse assignments, so check your boarding pass.
Curbside check-in is available for Delta, Southwest and United
Baggage claim and ground transportation pickup are on Level 1

MSY.betweenTerminals: Single terminal. One checkpoint leads to all three concourses, which connect by indoor walkways inside security. A May 2026 guide says the farthest Concourse A gates are about a 10-minute walk from the checkpoint.

securityWaits.summary: MSY says its peak security periods are 4-7am and 3-6pm. During a TSA staffing shortage in March 2026, Sundays and Mondays were the heaviest days and waits reached up to 2 hours. In normal summer conditions (mid-June to mid-August 2026), MyTSA data put MSY's average wait at 4.1 minutes, the second-shortest of the 50 busiest US airports.

MSY.precheckNotes: PreCheck screening is at the single Level 2 checkpoint, with a dedicated CLEAR lane for PreCheck members. MSY does not publish separate PreCheck lane hours. CLEAR lists its lanes as open until 7pm.
MSY.touchlessId: MSY added TSA PreCheck Touchless ID in May 2026 for Alaska, American, Delta, Southwest and United, with a dedicated lane at the checkpoint. Opt in through your airline's app or profile, with your Known Traveler Number and passport details saved. Carry a physical ID as backup.

gettingThere.rideshare: Drop-off is at the terminal curb; stopping, parking and waiting there are not allowed. Uber and Lyft pickup is outside Level 1 Baggage Claim on the middle curb. Lyft riders use Doors 7-9 and UberX riders use Doors 9-11.
gettingThere.transit: Buses stop at Level 1 Baggage Claim outside Door 2 (Zones B4 and B5). The RTA Airport Express (Route 202) costs $1.25 and stops at Elk Place at Cleveland and the Union Passenger Terminal. The JET E1 (Veterans-Airport) runs to City Park Avenue: $1.50 within Jefferson Parish, $2.00 into New Orleans.
gettingThere.driving: Daily maximums: Short Term garage $26, Long Term $22, Surface Lot $20, Economy Garage $12 (shuttle to the terminal), valet $36. Parking payment is by credit card only. You can reserve any facility online; reservations cannot be changed within 24 hours and are non-refundable. A third-party guide places the free cell phone lot at Airline Drive and Hollandey Street.

construction2026: The $84.5M Express Shuttle Connector Road, a dedicated shuttle road between the south-campus parking garages and the terminal, broke ground in August 2025 and is due before the end of the decade
In March 2026, MSY said it would soon start building 400 more parking spaces near the terminal. It gave no completion date.
MSY.bagDrop: Southwest: bags checked less than 45 minutes before a domestic departure may not be accepted (60 minutes for international); bags are accepted no earlier than 4 hours ahead. Delta: check bags at least 45 minutes before domestic departure, no more than 6 hours ahead. American and United: check-in and bag deadline is 45 minutes before domestic departure.
tips: There is one checkpoint for every gate, on Level 2. It is busiest 4-7am and 3-6pm, so leave extra time for flights in or just after those windows.
After security you can walk between Concourses A, B and C, so you can eat or shop in any concourse
Delta, Southwest and United offer curbside check-in at the departures curb
Reserve parking ahead in busy seasons. MSY asked travelers to book ahead for summer 2026, and reservations must be made at least 24 hours in advance.
Drivers cannot wait at the curb. The Short Term garage's first half hour is free.

faq.q: How early should I get to New Orleans airport?
faq.a: MSY recommends at least two hours before a domestic flight. Allow more if your flight is during its 4-7am or 3-6pm peaks or you are checking bags.

faq.q: How many security checkpoints does MSY have?
faq.a: One. All passengers use the consolidated checkpoint on Level 2. It has PreCheck and CLEAR lanes and leads to Concourses A, B and C.

faq.q: Are the concourses at MSY connected after security?
faq.a: Yes. Concourses A, B and C are connected inside the secure area, so you do not need to clear security again.

faq.q: Where do I get an Uber or Lyft at New Orleans airport?
faq.a: Go to the middle curb outside Level 1 Baggage Claim. Lyft riders exit Doors 7-9 and UberX riders exit Doors 9-11.
