officialArrivalAdvice.domestic: OAK says it always recommends arriving at least 2 hours before a domestic flight. (Its FAQ, in a section on wheelchair help, says at least 90 minutes.)
officialArrivalAdvice.international: At least 3 hours before an international flight (OAK's FAQ, in its wheelchair section, says at least 120 minutes)

terminals.name: Terminal 1

checkpoints.notes: TSA's screening counts list it as TERM1; it handled about 27% of OAK's screenings in the week of Sep 13, 2026. OAK does not publish checkpoint hours; in TSA's counts, screening started in the 3am hour. Upgraded Points (Aug 2026) says both checkpoints have PreCheck lanes. CLEAR's site lists CLEAR only in Terminal 2.
checkpoints.name: Terminal 1 checkpoint

notes: OAK says Terminal 1 serves all airlines, including Southwest
International flights that are not pre-cleared are processed in Terminal 1
The BART station is across from the Terminal 1 baggage claim
JSX flies from a separate facility, not the main terminals

terminals.name: Terminal 2

checkpoints.notes: TSA's screening counts list it as TERM2; it handled about 73% of OAK's screenings in the week of Sep 13, 2026. CLEAR's site lists CLEAR to the left of the checkpoint entrance: 4:15am-8pm Sunday, Thursday and Friday, and 4:15am-7:30pm Monday-Wednesday and Saturday. CLEAR eGates opened here in January 2026. CLEAR's page lists PreCheck hours here, but gives two different sets.
checkpoints.name: Terminal 2 checkpoint

notes: OAK says Terminal 2 is Southwest only
Curbside wheelchairs are available only at Southwest in Terminal 2
CLEAR also offers TSA PreCheck enrollment in Terminal 2

OAK.betweenTerminals: Terminals 1 and 2 are connected after security, through a connecting area between the two terminals. Before security, you can walk between the two buildings on a walkway just outside them (Upgraded Points). The BART station is a short walk from both terminals.

securityWaits.summary: OAK does not publish typical peak times. In TSA's hourly screening counts for Sep 13-19, 2026, OAK was busiest from 5am to 1pm, with peaks at 5-6am and 11am-noon. Traffic stayed moderate through the afternoon and was much lighter after 7pm. Friday and Thursday were the busiest days that week, followed by Sunday and Monday; Tuesday and Saturday were the quietest.
busiestTimes: Fridays and Thursdays, then Sundays and Mondays (TSA counts, week of Sep 13, 2026)

OAK.precheckNotes: OAK does not list PreCheck lanes on its own site. Upgraded Points (Aug 2026) says both checkpoints have dedicated PreCheck lanes, with hours that vary. CLEAR lists PreCheck hours at Terminal 2 but gives two different sets. Since January 2026, CLEAR offers PreCheck enrollment and renewal in Terminal 2.
OAK.touchlessId: Southwest lists OAK among its TSA PreCheck Touchless ID airports. You need a Rapid Rewards account, PreCheck with a valid KTN, a valid passport, and a mobile boarding pass, and you must be 18 or older. This research did not confirm which other airlines offer it at OAK.

gettingThere.rideshare: Lyft, Uber and Wingz operate at OAK. Pickup is on the 3rd Curb, Sections 3C2-3C9. For drop-off, OAK's directions say to use the right lanes for Terminal 1 and the left lanes for Terminal 2. Prolonged stopping at the curb is not allowed.
gettingThere.transit: BART's OAK station is across the street from the terminals. Trains run to Coliseum station in about 8 minutes, then connect to the rest of BART. Trains leave about every 6 minutes from 5am on weekdays, 6am on Saturdays and 8am on Sundays, and every 20 minutes from 11pm to midnight. Fares depend on distance; fare gates take Clipper and contactless bank cards. AC Transit Line 73 links OAK and Coliseum BART every 15 minutes, about 4:56am-12:06am, and late-night Line 805 runs hourly, about 12:35am-4:30am.
gettingThere.driving: From I-880 in either direction, exit at 98th Avenue and follow it to the airport. Daily maximums (since July 1, 2025): Premier $40 (in front of the terminals; gives a security checkpoint fast pass on entry), Hourly $36, Daily $26 (5-8 minute walk) and Economy $18 (free shuttle every 15-20 minutes, on-demand 2-5am). Reserve at least 2 hours ahead to guarantee entry when lots sell out. The Park & Call lot is free for up to 30 minutes.

construction2026: Public restroom renovations are in progress, with completion expected by June 2028. No other construction affecting departures was found.
OAK.bagDrop: Southwest: check bags at least 45 minutes before a domestic flight's scheduled departure (60 minutes for international), and check in at least 30 minutes before a domestic flight. Alaska: check in at least 50 minutes before a domestic flight (AP, May 2025). Delta: bags 45 minutes before domestic departure, check-in 30 minutes without bags.
tips: Southwest uses Terminal 2, and some Southwest flights use Terminal 1. The terminals connect after security, so you can walk to a gate in the other terminal.
BART service starts at 8am on Sundays and 6am on Saturdays. For an early weekend flight, plan another way to get there.
Reserve parking at least 2 hours ahead. A reservation guarantees entry even when drive-up parking is sold out.
CLEAR is only in Terminal 2, and only until about 7:30-8pm
In TSA's counts for mid-September 2026, security was busiest from 5am to 1pm, and Thursdays and Fridays were the busiest days

faq.q: How early should I get to Oakland airport (OAK)?
faq.a: OAK recommends at least 2 hours before a domestic flight and 3 hours before an international flight. Security is busiest from 5am to 1pm, and Thursdays and Fridays are the busiest days.

faq.q: Which terminal is Southwest at OAK?
faq.a: Terminal 2 is Southwest only, and Terminal 1 also serves Southwest. The terminals are connected after security, so you can reach any gate.

faq.q: Are OAK's Terminal 1 and Terminal 2 connected?
faq.a: Yes. They connect after security, so you can walk between the gate areas without screening again.

faq.q: Can I take BART to OAK?
faq.a: Yes. BART's OAK station is across the street from the terminals, about 8 minutes from Coliseum station. Trains run about every 6 minutes, starting at 5am on weekdays, 6am on Saturdays and 8am on Sundays.

faq.q: Does OAK have TSA PreCheck and CLEAR?
faq.a: Yes. CLEAR is in Terminal 2, from 4:15am until 7:30pm or 8pm depending on the day. PreCheck lanes are reported at both checkpoints, and CLEAR offers PreCheck enrollment in Terminal 2.

gettingThere.driving: Hourly parking in the main garage (Lot A, next to the domestic terminals) and Lot D (next to Terminal 5). Economy Lot F is reached by the free ATS. Free cell phone lot at 560 N. Bessie Coleman Drive.

faq.q: How early should I get to O'Hare?

faq.q: Can you walk between terminals at O'Hare after security?
faq.a: Terminals 1, 2 and 3 are connected after security. Terminal 5 isn't: use the ATS train (24/7) and go through security again, or, if connecting, the Terminal Transfer Bus (11:30am-9:30pm).

faq.q: Where do Uber and Lyft pick up at O'Hare?
faq.a: On the upper level of Terminal 2 (orange poles 2A-2G) and Terminal 3 (green poles 3G-3K). There is no rideshare pickup at Terminal 5.

PDX.name: Portland International Airport

officialArrivalAdvice.domestic: Arrive two hours before your domestic flight during the busy early-morning hours; first-time visitors since the new terminal opened should allow extra time to find their way
officialArrivalAdvice.international: Arrive three hours before all departing international flights

terminals.name: Main Terminal (Concourses B, C, D, E)

checkpoints.notes: Serves Concourses B and C (south side). Closed 10 p.m.-3 a.m. PreCheck lanes open 4 a.m. to about 4 p.m. daily. CLEAR enrollment staff here 4:30 a.m.-9 p.m.
checkpoints.name: B/C Checkpoint

checkpoints.notes: Serves Concourses D and E (north side). Open 24 hours, 7 days a week. PreCheck lanes open 4 a.m. to about 4 p.m. daily. CLEAR enrollment staff here 4 a.m.-10 p.m.
checkpoints.name: D/E Checkpoint

notes: PDX says you can reach all gates from either checkpoint, but you save time by using the checkpoint that matches your gate

Alaska and Horizon use Concourse B (Port of Portland, 2021). Southwest moved to Concourse E in 2020, joining Delta and United on the north side; Alaska, American and JetBlue were on the south side (The Points Guy, 2020). Many gates are common-use, so check the monitors for your gate.
The new main terminal opened in phases from August 2024 and was declared complete on June 30, 2026
Express Lanes are usually open at the busiest departure times for eligible travelers (some airline elite status, First or Business Class, and Portland-Seattle flyers at B/C)

PDX.betweenTerminals: One terminal with two security wings: B/C to the south and D/E to the north. The post-security concourse connector has reopened, so you can walk between the wings after screening. Some older guides still say it is closed.

securityWaits.summary: PDX does not publish average waits on its tips page. It names early morning as the busy time and says check-in lines may be long in the early morning and at lunchtime. Live wait times for both checkpoints are shown on the flypdx.com home page.

PDX.precheckNotes: PreCheck lanes at both checkpoints open at 4 a.m. and close at about 4 p.m. daily. Evening flyers should expect standard lanes only. After 10 p.m. only the D/E checkpoint is open.
PDX.touchlessId: Alaska announced in June 2025 that it was bringing TSA PreCheck Touchless ID to PDX for Mileage Plan members 18+ who add a KTN and passport details on alaskaair.com. Which PDX checkpoints offer it was not confirmed.

gettingThere.rideshare: Drivers drop off on the departures level. Uber, Lyft and Wingz pickups are inside Level 1 of the Short-Term Parking garage at the Transportation Plaza; columns are marked by company.
gettingThere.transit: TriMet MAX Red Line stops at the terminal near baggage claim. TriMet says the ride to downtown takes about 40 minutes, trains run about every 15 minutes most of the day, and the adult fare is $2.80 for 2.5 hours (Dec 2025).
gettingThere.driving: Take I-205 to the Airport Way West exit and follow Airport Way to the terminal. PDX says to allow 30-45 minutes from downtown. Parking is first-come, first-served: Short-Term $30/day, Long-Term $24/day, Economy $15/day (free shuttle about every 7-9 minutes), Valet $45/day. The free cell phone waiting area off NE Airport Way and NE 82nd Ave allows up to 30 minutes. Curbside is for active loading only.

construction2026: Baggage claim renovation (new ceiling, lighting and restrooms) continues in sections into 2027, with some baggage claim areas closed; follow posted signs
The main terminal project (PDX Next) was declared complete on June 30, 2026, so the ticket lobby and pre-security layout differ from before 2024
PDX.bagDrop: Alaska: check-in cutoff is 50 minutes before domestic departure, with or without bags (AP, May 2025). Southwest: bags 45 minutes before domestic departure, check-in 30 minutes. Delta: bags 45 minutes before domestic departure, check-in 30 minutes without bags. United and American: 45 minutes for check-in and bags on most domestic flights.
tips: Use the checkpoint that matches your gate: B/C for B and C gates, D/E for D and E gates
The B/C checkpoint closes 10 p.m.-3 a.m.; for overnight and very early flights use D/E, which is open 24 hours
PreCheck lanes close at about 4 p.m., so afternoon and evening PreCheck members will go through standard lanes
Parking cannot be reserved; Valet ($45/day) is never full if the garages are tight
Get your boarding pass before you go to security; both checkpoints scan mobile boarding passes

faq.q: How early should I get to Portland airport?
faq.a: PDX advises two hours before a domestic flight during the busy early-morning hours and three hours before an international flight.

faq.q: Which PDX security checkpoint should I use?
faq.a: Use the one that matches your gate: B/C for B and C gates, D/E for D and E gates. The concourse connector lets you reach any gate after screening, but the matching checkpoint is quicker.

faq.q: Is PDX security open 24 hours?
faq.a: Only the D/E checkpoint is open 24 hours. The B/C checkpoint is closed from 10 p.m. to 3 a.m.

faq.q: When is TSA PreCheck open at PDX?
faq.a: PreCheck lanes at both checkpoints open at 4 a.m. and close at about 4 p.m. daily.

PHL.name: Philadelphia International Airport

officialArrivalAdvice.domestic: PHL, relaying TSA advice, says to arrive 2 hours before boarding time for domestic flights
officialArrivalAdvice.international: PHL, relaying TSA advice, says to arrive 3 hours before international flights

terminals.name: Terminal A-West

checkpoints.notes: Open 5:00am-10:15pm
checkpoints.name: Terminal A-West checkpoint

checkpoints.notes: TSA PreCheck lane, open 3:00pm-5:30pm on Sun, Mon, Thu and Fri only (closed Tue, Wed and Sat)
checkpoints.name: Terminal A-West 1 checkpoint

notes: American's Flagship Lounge and Admirals Club are in A-West between gates A15 and A16

terminals.name: Terminal A-East

checkpoints.notes: Open 4:15am-8:15pm. PreCheck lane open 4:15am-6:30pm.
checkpoints.name: Terminal A-East checkpoint

notes: American offers curbside check-in at A-East and at B/C ticketing

terminals.name: Terminal B

checkpoints.notes: Standard screening only, 3:30am-9:15pm
checkpoints.name: Terminal B checkpoint

notes: The airport lists American's ticketing, gates and baggage claim at Terminal A-East and B/C

terminals.name: Terminal C

checkpoints.notes: TSA PreCheck only, 4:15am-8:00pm. Non-PreCheck passengers cannot use this checkpoint.
checkpoints.name: Terminal C checkpoint

notes: The United Club is in the C/D walkway

terminals.name: Terminal D

checkpoints.notes: Open 3:15am-10:15pm. PreCheck lane open 3:45am-8:00pm.
checkpoints.name: Terminal D/E checkpoint

notes: Alaska, JetBlue and Sun Country ticket in Terminal E, but their gates and baggage claim are in Terminal D

terminals.name: Terminal E

checkpoints.notes: Open 3:15am-10:15pm. PreCheck lane open 3:45am-8:00pm.
checkpoints.name: Terminal D/E checkpoint (shared with Terminal D)

notes: Terminal E is also the ticketing area for Alaska, JetBlue and Sun Country, whose gates are in Terminal D

checkpoints.notes: Standard screening only, 4:30am-9:15pm
checkpoints.name: Terminal F checkpoint

PHL.betweenTerminals: After screening, you can walk between terminals without leaving and re-entering security. You can use any TSA checkpoint to reach any terminal.
PHL.precheckNotes: TSA PreCheck is at A-West 1 (3:00pm-5:30pm, Sun/Mon/Thu/Fri only), A-East (4:15am-6:30pm), C (PreCheck only, 4:15am-8:00pm) and D/E (3:45am-8:00pm). Terminals B and F have no PreCheck lane.
PHL.touchlessId: Delta and Southwest both list PHL for TSA PreCheck Touchless ID. Delta does not list PHL for dedicated Touchless ID bag drop.

gettingThere.rideshare: Ride-app pickups are in Zone 7 on S. Commercial Road, outside each Baggage Claim. Follow the 'Ride App/Zone 7' signs.
gettingThere.transit: SEPTA's Airport Regional Rail Line runs every 30 minutes. It stops at Terminals E&F, C&D, B and A, then continues to Penn Medicine, 30th Street (Amtrak/NJ Transit connections), Suburban, Jefferson and Temple University. Tap-to-pay is accepted. SEPTA bus routes 37, 108 and 115 stop at Zone 1 outside baggage claim.
gettingThere.driving: From Center City, take I-95 South to the airport exit or I-76 East following airport signs. Garages A, B, D and E/F are open and Garage C is closed. Garages are $32 per day and link to the terminals by pedestrian bridges. The Economy Lot is $18 per day with 24-hour shuttles.

construction2026: PHL's nearly $2 billion modernization program continues through 2026. The airport says construction itself can affect the traveler experience.
Garage C is listed as closed. Garages A, B, D and E/F and Economy Parking are open.
PHL.bagDrop: Delta at PHL: domestic check-in and bags close 45 minutes before departure, international check-in closes 1 hour before, and you must be at the gate 15 minutes before departure. JetBlue at PHL: bags must be checked 45 minutes before departure, and check-in without bags closes 30 minutes before.
tips: The Terminal C checkpoint is PreCheck-only. Without PreCheck, use another checkpoint. Every checkpoint leads to every terminal once you are through.
PreCheck lanes close early in the evening: A-East at 6:30pm and C and D/E at 8:00pm. Plan for standard screening on evening departures.
Terminals B and F have only standard screening. Any checkpoint reaches every terminal, so PreCheck members can use the PreCheck checkpoints (C, A-East or D/E) during their hours.
Alaska, JetBlue and Sun Country passengers check in at Terminal E, but their gates are in Terminal D
Garage C is closed. Use Garages A, B, D or E/F, or the Economy Lot ($18 per day with 24-hour shuttles).

faq.q: How early should I get to Philadelphia airport?
faq.a: PHL, citing TSA, advises arriving 2 hours before boarding for domestic flights and 3 hours before international flights. Delta closes domestic check-in 45 minutes before departure at PHL.

faq.q: Does PHL have CLEAR?
faq.a: PHL is not on CLEAR's list of airport locations. For expedited screening, the airport offers TSA PreCheck lanes at A-West 1 (limited hours), A-East, C and D/E.

faq.q: Can I walk between terminals at PHL after security?
faq.a: Yes. Once screened, you can walk between terminals without re-entering security, and any checkpoint gives access to any terminal.

PHX.name: Phoenix Sky Harbor International Airport

officialArrivalAdvice.domestic: If flying domestically, arrive at least two hours early
officialArrivalAdvice.international: For international travel, allow at least three hours

terminals.name: Terminal 3

checkpoints.notes: Open 24 hours. TSA PreCheck 5 a.m.-2 p.m. only. PHX RESERVE appointments available 24 hours.
checkpoints.name: Terminal 3 TSA Security Checkpoint

notes: A new six-gate North Concourse is under construction, expected to finish in 2027
The PHX Sky Train station is on Level 5; take the ticketing escalators to Level 4, then up to Level 5
Frontier closes its ticket counters 1 hour before departure, and Porter's close 90 minutes before

terminals.name: Terminal 4

checkpoints.notes: Open 24 hours. TSA PreCheck 5 a.m.-7 p.m.
checkpoints.name: Checkpoint A

checkpoints.notes: 4:15 a.m.-8:30 p.m. TSA PreCheck 5 a.m.-7 p.m.
checkpoints.name: Checkpoint B

checkpoints.notes: 3:15 a.m.-12:30 a.m. TSA PreCheck 5 a.m.-7 p.m.
checkpoints.name: Checkpoint C

checkpoints.notes: 3:15 a.m.-7:30 p.m. TSA PreCheck 5 a.m.-7 p.m.
checkpoints.name: Checkpoint D

notes: PHX says any Terminal 4 checkpoint can be used to reach any Terminal 4 gate
The PHX Sky Train arrives on Level 3, a short walk from the security checkpoints
The Global Entry Enrollment Center is on Level 3

PHX.betweenTerminals: The free PHX Sky Train runs 24/7 between Terminals 3 and 4, both Economy lots, the Rental Car Center and the 44th St Valley Metro Rail station. Waits average about 3.5-7 minutes from 5 a.m. to 10 p.m. and can be 15+ minutes during nightly maintenance (10 p.m.-5 a.m.). Passengers changing terminals must be screened again.

securityWaits.summary: PHX posts live checkpoint wait times on the skyharbor.com homepage and terminal flight information screens; it publishes no typical wait figures.

PHX.precheckNotes: PreCheck hours are limited: Terminal 3 from 5 a.m.-2 p.m., and all Terminal 4 checkpoints (A-D) from 5 a.m.-7 p.m., subject to change. Outside those hours, PreCheck travelers go through regular screening. Free PHX RESERVE appointments (book up to 6 days ahead, for 60-240 min before departure) are for general-screening passengers only.
PHX.touchlessId: PHX is on an April 2026 list of 65 airports with TSA PreCheck Touchless ID; participating airlines there were not specified. Opt in with your airline.

gettingThere.rideshare: Uber, Lyft, Wridz, Waymo and HUM serve PHX. Pickups are on the Terminal 3 outer curbs and Terminal 4 Level 1 outer curbs (doors 1, 2, 6, 8). Waymo picks up and drops off at each terminal's rideshare location 24/7. PHX suggests using the 24th St or 44th St PHX Sky Train stations for drop-offs to avoid terminal traffic.
gettingThere.transit: Valley Metro Rail connects directly to the PHX Sky Train at the 44th St & Washington station, with access to Phoenix, Tempe and Mesa. Bus Route 13 stops at the 24th St Sky Train station and Route 44 at the 44th St station. PHX does not publish a downtown travel time.
gettingThere.driving: Expect construction on Sky Harbor Boulevard: a realignment took effect Oct 10, westbound west-airport traffic is down to a single lane (since Aug 14), and Terminal 3 has indefinite overnight lane restrictions. Reserve parking in advance, and use the free 24-hour cell phone waiting lots.

construction2026: Terminal 3 North Concourse (six new gates) under construction, completion expected 2027. Overnight lane restrictions on Sky Harbor Blvd at Terminal 3 are indefinite, and at times the Terminal 3 garage can be entered and exited only from the south side via westbound Sky Harbor Blvd.
Eastbound and westbound Sky Harbor Boulevard realignment on the west side of the airport took effect Oct 10

Taxiway Uniform project: westbound Sky Harbor Blvd on the west end reduced to a single lane since 5 a.m. Aug 14, until further notice; eastbound Sky Harbor Blvd rerouted beneath the new taxiway bridge. PHX advises planning for longer travel times.
PHX Sky Train nightly maintenance from 10 p.m.-5 a.m. can mean 15+ minute waits; staged buses run from 44th St Station to the Terminal 3 and Terminal 4 curbs
Sept 21, 2026: PHX named American Airlines the primary carrier for a future West Terminal (Destination PHX 2050); no 2026 passenger impact announced
PHX.bagDrop: Delta: bags at least 45 min before departure, check-in at least 30 min without bags, at the gate 15 min before. Southwest: bags 45 min, check-in 30 min (domestic). Alaska: check-in and bag drop typically close 40 min before. At PHX, Frontier closes ticket counters 1 hour before departure and Porter 90 minutes before. Free Early Bag Check (Rental Car Center and East Economy, 5 a.m.-5 p.m.) requires bags at least 90 minutes and no more than 4 hours before departure, for domestic flights on Alaska, American, Delta, Frontier, Southwest and United.
tips: PreCheck lanes close early (2 p.m. at Terminal 3 and 7 p.m. at Terminal 4). On evening flights, plan for standard screening or book a free PHX RESERVE slot.
Book PHX RESERVE up to six days ahead for a dedicated general-screening lane; appointments have a 15-minute grace period
Terminals 3 and 4 are not connected after security, so confirm your terminal: Southwest and American use Terminal 4, while Delta, United and Alaska use Terminal 3
Returning a rental car or parking at East Economy? Free Early Bag Check (5 a.m.-5 p.m.) lets you drop domestic bags before taking the Sky Train
Late-night Sky Train trips can involve 15+ minute waits during nightly maintenance (10 p.m.-5 a.m.), so add buffer time
Frontier's ticket counters at PHX close 1 hour before departure, earlier than most airlines

faq.q: How early should I get to Phoenix Sky Harbor?
faq.a: PHX recommends arriving at least two hours early for domestic flights and at least three hours for international travel.

faq.q: Can I walk between Terminal 3 and Terminal 4 at PHX after security?
faq.a: No. Use the free 24-hour PHX Sky Train to change terminals, and expect to go through security again at the other terminal.

faq.q: Is TSA PreCheck open all day at PHX?
faq.a: No. PHX lists PreCheck hours of 5 a.m.-2 p.m. at Terminal 3 and 5 a.m.-7 p.m. at Terminal 4 Checkpoints A-D, subject to change.

PIT.name: Pittsburgh International Airport

officialArrivalAdvice.domestic: PIT recommends arriving at least 2 hours before a domestic flight. At peak times, including flights leaving between 5am and 8am, it says to arrive 2 to 3 hours early. Southwest suggests 90 minutes at PIT.
officialArrivalAdvice.international: PIT recommends arriving at least 3 hours before an international flight

terminals.name: Landside Terminal and Airside Terminal (Concourses A-D)

checkpoints.notes: One consolidated checkpoint in the new Landside Terminal (opened Nov 18, 2025), with 12 lanes. Lanes include TSA PreCheck, CLEAR and Priority; lane use changes with demand. A dedicated TSA PreCheck Touchless ID lane opened Oct 13, 2026. PIT says checkpoints are closed 10:30pm-2:30am daily. Southwest says the checkpoint closes at 10:15pm. TSA's screening data calls it the Main Checkpoint.
checkpoints.name: Main Checkpoint, Landside Terminal

notes: Departures (drop-off and check-in) is on the top level of the new Landside Terminal. Arrivals is on the middle level, and rideshare, taxis and buses use the ground level.
Airline check-in counters are in the main lobby. American and Southwest, PIT's two biggest airlines, have the counters closest to security.
After security, walk about 160 feet across a bridge and through a tunnel to the Airside Terminal, then take escalators or elevators down to the center core and the gates.
The old landside terminal and the underground people mover (tram) closed when the new terminal opened. You now walk from check-in to the gates.
Southwest lists its PIT gates as A1, A3, A7 and A9 in Concourse A
Concourse C gates handle international arrivals

PIT.betweenTerminals: Single terminal. One checkpoint serves all four concourses (A, B, C and D), which meet at the Airside Terminal's center core. You can walk between them after security.

securityWaits.summary: PIT shows live estimated waits for Standard, Priority, CLEAR and PreCheck lanes on its security page. It does not publish typical peak times. In TSA's hourly screening counts for Sep 13-19, 2026, PIT was busiest from 4am to 7am, peaking 5-6am. Smaller rises came around 11am-noon and from about 3pm to 6pm, and traffic was light after 7pm. Monday, Sunday, Friday and Thursday were the busiest days that week; Saturday and Tuesday were the quietest.
busiestTimes: Mondays, Sundays, Fridays and Thursdays (TSA counts, week of Sep 13, 2026)

PIT.precheckNotes: PIT says TSA PreCheck and CLEAR are both available, and the 12-lane checkpoint has PreCheck lanes. Since Oct 13, 2026, there is also a dedicated PreCheck Touchless ID lane. This research could not confirm PreCheck lane hours. CLEAR's location page lists CLEAR lanes from 4am to 7pm, but that page may not reflect the new terminal.
PIT.touchlessId: A dedicated TSA PreCheck Touchless ID lane opened Oct 13, 2026. It is for PreCheck members with a valid passport who opt in through Alaska, American, Delta, Hawaiian, Southwest or United, or through Google Wallet. Your mobile boarding pass must show a Touchless ID indicator. Carry a REAL ID or other accepted ID anyway.

gettingThere.rideshare: Drop-off is at the departures curb on the top level. Uber and Lyft pickup is on the ground level, across the commercial curb from Door 7.
gettingThere.transit: Pittsburgh Regional Transit's 28X Airport Flyer stops outside Door 9 on the ground level. It runs to Robinson Town Center, Downtown Pittsburgh and Oakland about every 30-40 minutes, seven days a week, from about 5am to midnight. Fare is $2.75 (exact change if paying cash; no cards on the bus). A ticket machine near Door 8 or 9 takes cards.
gettingThere.driving: Use I-376 Exit 53. The Terminal Garage ($38/day drive-up) and Terminal Lot ($28/day drive-up) are a 3-5 minute walk. The Shuttle Lot is $12/day drive-up, with shuttles about every 10 minutes, 24/7, that drop off at Door 5. Lower rates need a reservation at least 7 days ahead on ParkAtPIT.com. The Free Wait Lot is free for the first hour.

construction2026: Four outdoor terraces (two before security and two after) were still being finished in 2026, after the new terminal opened in November 2025
PIT plans further Airside Terminal renovations, including reconfiguring Concourses A and B; this research found no dates

I-376 Parkway West: work on the Route 22/30 interchange in Robinson is expected to run until fall 2029. The westbound right shoulder between the Crafton (Exit 60B) and Robinson Town Centre (Exit 59) exits is closed through July 2027. This is on the drive from Downtown to the airport.
PIT.bagDrop: Southwest: check bags at least 45 minutes before domestic departure (60 minutes for international) and check in at least 30 minutes before domestic departure. Be at the gate 10 minutes before departure. Its PIT ticket counter opens 90 minutes before the first departing flight. American, United and Delta: check bags at least 45 minutes before domestic departure. Alaska: check in at least 50 minutes before domestic departure.
tips: Security is closed from 10:30pm to 2:30am, and Southwest says it closes at 10:15pm. For very early flights, do not arrive before 2:30am expecting to get through.
There is no train to the gates anymore. After security you walk across a short bridge and tunnel, then go down to the center core.
Flights leaving 5am-8am are PIT's peak. The airport says to arrive 2 to 3 hours early for them.
American offers curbside check-in on the departures curb from 4am to 11:30am daily. Southwest also offers curbside check-in.
Reserve parking at least 7 days ahead for lower rates. Shuttle Lot buses run about every 10 minutes and the ride takes under 10 minutes.
Using Touchless ID? Check that your mobile boarding pass shows the Touchless ID indicator before you get in that lane.

faq.q: How early should I get to Pittsburgh airport?
faq.a: PIT recommends at least 2 hours before a domestic flight and 3 hours before an international flight. For flights between 5am and 8am and other peak times, it says 2 to 3 hours.

faq.q: What time does security open at Pittsburgh airport?
faq.a: Security checkpoints are closed from 10:30pm to 2:30am daily, so screening starts at 2:30am. Southwest says the checkpoint closes at 10:15pm.

faq.q: Is there still a train to the gates at PIT?
faq.a: No. The people mover closed when the new terminal opened on Nov 18, 2025. After security you walk about 160 feet across a bridge and through a tunnel to the gates.

faq.q: Where do Uber and Lyft pick up at Pittsburgh airport?
faq.a: On the ground level, across the commercial curb from Door 7. Drop-off is at the departures curb on the top level.

faq.q: Can I take a bus from Pittsburgh airport to downtown?
faq.a: Yes. The 28X Airport Flyer leaves from outside Door 9 on the ground level about every 30-40 minutes. It goes to Downtown and Oakland and costs $2.75.

RDU.name: Raleigh-Durham International Airport

officialArrivalAdvice.domestic: Arrive at least 2 hours before a domestic flight to allow for parking, check-in and security; more time may be needed at peak periods
officialArrivalAdvice.international: Arrive at least 3 hours before an international flight

terminals.name: Terminal 1 (A gates)

checkpoints.notes: Open 3:30am-10:30pm daily, per RDU. RDU lists CLEAR here 4am-7:45pm daily (standard lane) and 4am-7pm weekdays, 4am-6pm weekends (PreCheck lane); CLEAR's own site lists slightly different hours.
checkpoints.name: Terminal 1 Checkpoint

notes: Terminal 1 has gates A1-A9
Breeze and Sun Country moved from Terminal 2 to Terminal 1 in April 2024
Post-security pet relief area is near Gate A7

terminals.name: Terminal 2 (C and D gates)

checkpoints.notes: Open 3:30am-10:30pm daily, per RDU. RDU lists one CLEAR lane for standard and PreCheck travelers, 4am-7:45pm daily; CLEAR's own site lists 4am-7pm on Tuesday, Wednesday and Saturday.
checkpoints.name: Terminal 2 Checkpoint

notes: Terminal 2 has 36 gates on Concourses C and D and handles all international arrivals
Delta has the largest market share at RDU
Air Canada and Frontier ticketing is at Counter D
The north end of the ticketing hall has been walled off for expansion work since January 2026, for about two years; all ticket counters and checkpoint lanes stay open
The TSA PreCheck enrollment center is in Terminal 2 near Bag Claim 5 (Mon 9am-1pm; Tue-Fri 9am-1pm and 2-6pm)

RDU.betweenTerminals: The terminals are not connected after security. Walk between them through the parking garage atrium (5-10 minutes) or take a free parking shuttle: from Terminal 1 to Terminal 2 use the ParkRDU Economy shuttle, and from Terminal 2 to Terminal 1 use the ParkRDU Express shuttle. You will go through security again in the other terminal.

securityWaits.summary: RDU publishes no typical wait times or peak hours. In TSA's hourly screening counts for Sep 13-19, 2026, RDU was busiest from 4am to 7am, peaking 5-6am. A second busy stretch ran from about noon to 6pm, and traffic dropped sharply after 7pm. Thursday, Friday and Sunday were the busiest days that week; Tuesday was the quietest. A few Terminal 2 hours could not be read from TSA's file, so treat these as a pattern, not exact counts.
busiestTimes: Thursdays, Fridays and Sundays (TSA counts, week of Sep 13, 2026)

RDU.precheckNotes: RDU takes part in TSA PreCheck, and both terminals have PreCheck screening, including a CLEAR lane for PreCheck travelers. Both checkpoints open at 3:30am and close at 10:30pm, but CLEAR lanes close earlier in the evening.
RDU.touchlessId: The Points Guy reported in April 2026 that TSA PreCheck Touchless ID had recently come online at RDU. This research could not confirm which airlines offer it there.

gettingThere.rideshare: Drop off at the Terminal 1 curb or the Terminal 2 upper level (Departures). Ride app and prearranged pickups are outside baggage claim: Terminal 1 Zone 1 and Terminal 2 Zone 8. Curbs are for active loading only; the free Cell Lot is at 1000 Trade Drive, about three minutes from the terminals.
gettingThere.transit: GoTriangle serves RDU. The RDU Shuttle runs from the Regional Transit Center Monday-Saturday, 6am-6pm. Route 100 runs direct from downtown Raleigh after 6:30pm Monday-Saturday and all day Sunday. Stops are between Zones 2 and 3 at Terminal 1 and between Zones 6 and 7 at Terminal 2.
gettingThere.driving: From I-40 take Exit 284 or 285; from I-540 take Exit 2 (Aviation Parkway). Parking is cashless. Drive-up rates: Premier $34/day, Central $22.75/day (both in the garage between the terminals), Express $18.50/day (shuttle every 5-10 minutes) and Economy 3 $14.50/day (shuttle about every 20 minutes, 24/7). Book online at least 24 hours ahead to guarantee a space; if Central is full and you have not booked, follow signs to another lot.

construction2026: Terminal 2 expansion: a floor-to-ceiling wall closes the north end of the ticketing hall for about two years (from January 2026) while crews add ticketing, international arrivals and checkpoint lanes. All ticket counters and checkpoint lanes remain open, but you may hear construction noise. The full project is due in 2032.

John Brantley Boulevard, the main road serving both terminals, is being widened and extended. Utility work is underway now; lane closures are expected to start in summer 2027, and a temporary Terminal 2 departures curb near Terminal 1 is expected in early 2028.
A new primary runway (5L-23R) is under construction and due to open in 2029. This is airfield work and does not change terminal access.
RDU.bagDrop: Delta: bags 45 minutes before domestic departure (30 minutes without bags). Southwest: bags 45 minutes before a domestic flight (60 minutes international), check in at least 30 minutes before. American and United: check in and check bags 45 minutes before domestic departure (AP, May 2025). Most RDU ticket counters open around 4:30am, and curbside check-in is offered for select airlines.
tips: Check your terminal first: Southwest and the low-cost carriers use Terminal 1; Delta, American, United, JetBlue and all international airlines use Terminal 2
Morning is the busiest time at security, peaking 5-6am, so early flyers should not cut it close
Book parking online at least 24 hours ahead to guarantee a spot in the lot you want, especially for the garage
CLEAR lanes close around 6-7:45pm, before the checkpoints close at 10:30pm, so evening flyers may get only standard or PreCheck lanes
Went to the wrong terminal? Walk through the garage atrium in 5-10 minutes rather than driving around
Terminal 2's ticketing hall is partly walled off for construction, but every counter and checkpoint lane is open

faq.q: How early should I get to RDU?
faq.a: RDU says to arrive at least 2 hours before a domestic flight and 3 hours before an international flight, and more at peak times. The busiest hour at security is usually 5-6am.

faq.q: What time does security open at RDU?
faq.a: Both checkpoints, in Terminal 1 and Terminal 2, open at 3:30am and close at 10:30pm daily. Most airline ticket counters open around 4:30am.

faq.q: Which terminal is my airline at RDU?
faq.a: Terminal 1: Southwest, Alaska, Avelo, Breeze and Sun Country. Terminal 2: Delta, American, United, JetBlue, Frontier and all international airlines, including Air Canada, Air France, Lufthansa, Icelandair, Aer Lingus, Aeromexico, Copa, BermudAir and Volaris.

faq.q: Can I walk between Terminal 1 and Terminal 2 at RDU?
faq.a: Yes, but not after security. Walk through the parking garage atrium, about 5-10 minutes, or take a free parking shuttle, then go through security in the other terminal.

RSW.name: Southwest Florida International Airport

officialArrivalAdvice.domestic: RSW advised arriving at least 2 hours before a domestic flight (RSW post quoted by The News-Press, March 2026). It said lines are long at certain times of day in the busy season and vary by concourse.
officialArrivalAdvice.international: RSW advised arriving at least 3 hours before an international flight (RSW post quoted by The News-Press, March 2026)

terminals.name: Concourse B

checkpoints.notes: Hours are not published on a page this research could open. TSA's screening counts list two screening points for this concourse, Checkpoint B Lower and Checkpoint B Upper. In mid-September 2026, B Lower was in use from about 4am to 9pm.
checkpoints.name: Concourse B checkpoint

notes: Southwest lists its RSW gates as B2, B4, B6 and B8
Customs and immigration are on the lower level of Concourse B
Southwest's ticket counter opens 120 minutes before the first departing flight

terminals.name: Concourse C

checkpoints.notes: A temporary checkpoint for Concourse C opened in early February 2026 during terminal expansion work. It opened first for TSA PreCheck passengers, then for all Concourse C passengers. Hours are not published on a page this research could open. In mid-September 2026 TSA counts, it was in use from about 4am to 6pm, with almost no screening after 6pm.
checkpoints.name: Concourse C temporary checkpoint

notes: Delta was RSW's largest airline by passengers in March 2026
Follow the signs for the temporary Concourse C checkpoint; its entrance changed when it opened in February 2026

terminals.name: Concourse D

checkpoints.notes: Hours are not published on a page this research could open. TSA's screening counts call it Checkpoint D Lower. In mid-September 2026 it was in use from about 4am to 8pm.
checkpoints.name: Concourse D checkpoint

notes: JetBlue lists Concourse D for its RSW flights, with ticket counter hours of 4am-10pm

RSW.betweenTerminals: RSW has one terminal with three concourses (B, C and D). Each has its own checkpoint, and the concourses are not connected after security. Use the checkpoint for your airline's concourse. A single consolidated checkpoint is planned as part of the terminal expansion.

securityWaits.summary: This research found no typical peak times published by RSW. In TSA's hourly screening counts for Sep 13-19, 2026 (mid-September, RSW's quietest season), RSW was busiest from 9am to noon, peaking 10-11am. There was a smaller early rise from 4am to 7am, peaking 5-6am. Traffic held steady until about 5pm, dropped after that and was very light after 8pm. Thursday, Friday, Sunday and Monday were the busiest days that week; Tuesday was the quietest. Winter and spring are much busier. The Lee County Port Authority's monthly counts show March as the peak month: 1,521,149 passengers in March 2026, compared with 550,259 in September 2025.
busiestTimes: Thursdays, Fridays, Sundays and Mondays (TSA counts, week of Sep 13, 2026)
January to April, peaking in March (Lee County Port Authority monthly passenger counts)

RSW.precheckNotes: TSA PreCheck is available at the temporary Concourse C checkpoint, which opened first for PreCheck passengers in February 2026. This research could not confirm current PreCheck lanes or hours at the Concourse B and D checkpoints.
RSW.touchlessId: TSA says Touchless ID is at 65 airports but does not list them in the text of its page. RSW was not on a March 2026 list of Touchless ID airports, so this research could not confirm it at RSW.

gettingThere.rideshare: Uber drops off at the departures curb for your airline. Uber pickup is on the Arrival level, outside Doors 1-6, one level below baggage claim; the app shows your exact door.
gettingThere.transit: LeeTran Route 50 serves the airport. This research could not open LeeTran's current timetable, so check times and fares with LeeTran before you go.
gettingThere.driving: The Terminal Access Road connects directly to I-75 at Exit 128. The Short-term Parking Garage is across from the terminal, and the Long-term Parking Lot has a shuttle to the terminal. Since March 10, 2026, the only crosswalks between the terminal and the garage, rental cars and ground transportation (including the long-term lot shuttle) are Crosswalk 2 on the upper level and Crosswalks 2 and 6 on the lower level. The Port Authority says this adds a little time and suggests dropping passengers at the curb before parking.

construction2026: A temporary TSA checkpoint for Concourse C (Delta, United, WestJet) has been in use since early February 2026 while the terminal is rebuilt. Concourses B and D were not affected.

Since March 10, 2026, roadway work has limited the walking routes between the terminal and the Short-term Garage, rental cars and ground transportation to Crosswalk 2 (upper level) and Crosswalks 2 and 6 (lower level). Allow extra time if you park in the garage or ride the long-term lot shuttle.
The expansion will combine the three checkpoints into one and add Concourse E (14 gates), targeted for completion by the end of 2027. The Phase 1 construction contract was extended to March 31, 2029.
RSW.bagDrop: Southwest: check bags at least 45 minutes before a domestic flight (60 minutes for international); check in at least 30 minutes before a domestic flight. Southwest suggests arriving 120 minutes before departure at RSW. Delta: bags 45 minutes before domestic departure, 30 minutes without bags, and no more than 6 hours ahead. American and United: check in and check bags 45 minutes before domestic departure (AP, May 2025). JetBlue: bags 45 minutes before departure.
tips: Know your concourse before you go. Southwest, Allegiant, Frontier and Sun Country use Concourse B; Delta, United and WestJet use Concourse C; American, JetBlue and Breeze use Concourse D.
The concourses are not connected after security, so use the checkpoint for your airline's concourse
Plan more time from January to April. March is RSW's busiest month, with almost three times September's traffic.
Flying Delta, United or WestJet? Concourse C passengers use a temporary checkpoint during construction. Follow the signs and allow a few extra minutes.
Parking in the Short-term Garage? Construction has cut the number of crosswalks, so drop off passengers and bags at the curb first
In mid-September TSA counts, mid-morning (9am-noon) was busier than the early morning at RSW

faq.q: How early should I get to Fort Myers airport (RSW)?
faq.a: RSW advises at least 2 hours before a domestic flight and 3 hours before an international flight. Allow more time from January to April, when the airport is busiest, and if you park in the garage during construction.

faq.q: Which concourse is my airline at RSW?
faq.a: Concourse B: Southwest, Allegiant, Frontier, Sun Country, Avelo, Alaska, Air Canada, Porter and Discover. Concourse C: Delta, United and WestJet. Concourse D: American, JetBlue and Breeze.

faq.q: Are RSW's concourses connected after security?
faq.a: No. Each concourse has its own checkpoint, so go through the one for your airline's concourse.

faq.q: When is RSW busiest?
faq.a: Winter and spring. March is the peak month (1.52 million passengers in March 2026). In mid-September 2026 TSA counts, the busiest hours were 9am-noon, peaking 10-11am, with a smaller rise at 5-6am.

faq.q: Does RSW have CLEAR?
faq.a: CLEAR's list of airport locations does not include RSW. TSA PreCheck is available, including at the temporary Concourse C checkpoint.

SAN.name: San Diego International Airport

officialArrivalAdvice.domestic: As a general rule, allow at least two hours for domestic travel; contact your airline for specific guidance
officialArrivalAdvice.international: Allow at least three hours for international travel

terminals.name: Terminal 1 (new)

checkpoints.notes: New 13-lane checkpoint. SAN lists TSA PreCheck in both terminals and CLEAR only at Terminal 2 East.
checkpoints.name: Terminal 1 security checkpoint

notes: The first phase of the new Terminal 1 (19 gates) opened in September 2025, and the original 1967 Terminal 1 is closed and being demolished
Phase 1B construction is adding 11 more gates, lounges and a children's play area, with completion in 2028
The Terminal 1 Parking Plaza is directly across from the terminal ($3 per 15 min, $40 daily max)

terminals.name: Terminal 2 (East and West)

checkpoints.notes: CLEAR+ 4:00 a.m.-7:30 p.m. daily. SAN says PreCheck is available in Terminal 2 but does not list it by checkpoint.
checkpoints.name: Terminal 2 East checkpoint

notes: SAN's four lounges are in Terminal 2
Terminal 2 Parking Plaza is directly across from the terminal (about 2,900 spaces, 8'2" clearance)

SAN.betweenTerminals: Terminals 1 and 2 are not connected after security. During construction the roadway between them is closed to all traffic; SAN says the best way between terminals is the free Inter-Terminal Shuttle (daily 4 a.m.-2 a.m.) from the Terminal 1 curb. A secured walkway connector to Terminal 2 East is planned, with construction expected to start in 2027.
SAN.precheckNotes: SAN says TSA PreCheck is available in both Terminal 1 and Terminal 2 but does not publish lane hours or locations by checkpoint. Add your Known Traveler Number to your reservation.
SAN.touchlessId: SAN is on an April 2026 list of 65 airports with TSA PreCheck Touchless ID; participating airlines there were not specified. Opt in with your airline.

gettingThere.rideshare: Uber, Lyft, Wingz and PrimeTime can drop off curbside at both Terminals 1 and 2. Pickup is across the crosswalk from baggage claim at Terminal 1, and in the second lane of the Transportation Plaza at Terminal 2.
gettingThere.transit: MTS Route 992 stops at both terminals every 15 minutes, 4:15 a.m.-midnight, and connects downtown (Broadway & Kettner) with the Trolley, COASTER and Amtrak. The free San Diego Flyer shuttle runs between both terminals and the Old Town Transit Center. The Trolley does not stop at the airport.
gettingThere.driving: Take I-5 to the airport exits (Hawthorn St northbound, Sassafras St southbound) and then N. Harbor Dr. A three-lane airport entrance road opened Aug 1, 2025, just past Laurel St & Harbor Dr, giving a signal-free route to both terminals. Terminal 1 and 2 Parking Plazas cost $3 per 15 min ($40 daily max) and can be reserved up to 30 days ahead; valet is $60/day; the free Cell Phone Lot (1-hour limit) is at 2311 McCain Rd.

construction2026: Terminal 1 Phase 1B under way (11 more gates, completion 2028); the original Terminal 1 is being demolished
The roadway between Terminals 1 and 2 is closed to all traffic during construction; use the Inter-Terminal Shuttle (4 a.m.-2 a.m.)
Terminal 1 to Terminal 2 East connector in design, construction expected to begin in 2027
SAN.bagDrop: Southwest (Terminal 1): bags at least 45 min before departure, check-in 30 min (domestic). Delta: bags 45 min, check-in 30 min without bags, at the gate 15 min before. Alaska: check-in and bag drop typically close 40 min before. SAN says ticket counters are typically staffed by 5:00 a.m.
tips: Know your terminal before you go. Terminals 1 and 2 are not connected after security and the road between them is closed, so a wrong-terminal drop-off means a shuttle ride (Inter-Terminal Shuttle, 4 a.m.-2 a.m.).
Southwest, JetBlue and Frontier fly from the new Terminal 1; Alaska, American, Delta, United and most international airlines use Terminal 2
CLEAR at SAN is only at Terminal 2 East, 4:00 a.m.-7:30 p.m.
The airport entrance road off Harbor Dr just past Laurel St skips the Harbor Drive stoplights
Parking reservations can sell out while drive-up space remains; SAN says to call SP+ at 619-291-2087 to check availability
SAN says departures operate without penalty only between 6:30 a.m. and 11:30 p.m.

faq.q: How early should I get to the San Diego airport?
faq.a: SAN recommends allowing at least two hours for domestic flights and three hours for international flights, and checking with your airline for specific guidance.

faq.q: Are Terminal 1 and Terminal 2 connected at SAN?
faq.a: Not after security. During new Terminal 1 construction the roadway between terminals is closed, and SAN recommends the free Inter-Terminal Shuttle, which runs daily from 4 a.m. to 2 a.m.

faq.q: Which terminal is Southwest in at San Diego?
faq.a: Southwest flies from Terminal 1, along with JetBlue, Frontier, Sun Country, Breeze, Air Canada and WestJet.

SAT.name: San Antonio International Airport

officialArrivalAdvice.domestic: SAT says its airlines recommend arriving 90 minutes before your scheduled departure for domestic travel, and 2 hours before during peak travel times

terminals.name: Terminal A

checkpoints.notes: At the east end of Terminal A (Upgraded Points). Opens at 3:30am. SAT lists PreCheck hours as 3:30am-6pm daily. CLEAR+ lanes: 4am-7pm Sun, Thu and Fri; 4am-6:30pm Mon-Wed and Sat.
checkpoints.name: Terminal A checkpoint

notes: SAT's airline list shows United at both Terminal A and Terminal B; check your boarding pass
All international carriers use Terminal A, which has the customs facility
Rideshare pickup is on the outer commercial curb on the lower level of Terminal A

terminals.name: Terminal B

checkpoints.notes: At the entrance to Concourse B (Upgraded Points). Opens at 3:30am. SAT lists PreCheck hours as 3:30am-5pm daily. CLEAR+ lanes: 4am-6pm Sun-Fri; 4am-4:30pm Sat.
checkpoints.name: Terminal B checkpoint

notes: Terminal C construction has closed two of the four curb lanes at the far end of Terminal B, on both levels, plus some doors into Terminal B
The VIA Route 5 bus stop is at the far west end of Terminal B on the lower level

SAT.betweenTerminals: Terminals A and B are in one building, and you can walk between them on the ticketing and arrivals levels before security. They are not connected after security, so changing terminals means leaving the secure area and screening again.

securityWaits.summary: SAT does not publish wait times or busiest hours. MyTSA data for mid-June to mid-August 2026 put SAT's average wait at 3.7 minutes, the shortest of the 50 busiest US airports.

SAT.precheckNotes: Both checkpoints have PreCheck lanes. SAT lists PreCheck hours as 3:30am-6pm at Terminal A and 3:30am-5pm at Terminal B, so evening flyers may have only standard lanes. Checkpoints themselves open at 3:30am.
SAT.touchlessId: A March 2026 airport list shows TSA PreCheck Touchless ID at SAT for Alaska and American. You opt in through your airline profile.

gettingThere.rideshare: Rideshare drop-off is at the departures curb. Pickup is on the outer commercial curb, lower level of Terminal A. SAT says construction has shifted rideshare, hotel shuttle and off-site parking shuttle pickup spots slightly; they remain outside baggage claim on the lower level.
gettingThere.transit: VIA Route 5 runs daily between the airport and downtown in about 30 minutes for $1.30. It stops on the lower (arrivals) roadway at the far west end of Terminal B. VIA Route 7 Stone Oak Express runs weekdays from the Stone Oak Park & Ride every 30 minutes (5:45am-7pm), about 15-20 minutes nonstop, for $2.60.
gettingThere.driving: New parking rates start Nov 1, 2026: Economy $10/day, Long Term $20/day, Short Term $30/day. Economy lots are about half a mile away with a courtesy shuttle. During construction SAT suggests using the Short-Term Garage's 3-hour spaces ($5 the first hour, $4 each extra hour) for drop-off. Use the free 24/7 Cell Phone Waiting Lot (with Wi-Fi) instead of waiting at the curb.

construction2026: Phase I of Terminal C curbside construction runs March 23 through December 2026. Two of the four lanes at the far end of Terminal B are closed on both the upper and lower levels, and some doors into Terminal B are closed. Departures stay open with limited access.
Phase II is expected to start near the end of 2026. It will move lane changes further along Terminal Drive, in front of Terminal B. Phase III will mainly affect Terminal A. No dates have been set.
Terminal C, with up to 17 gates and a central screening area for all terminals, is scheduled to open in 2028
SAT.bagDrop: Southwest: bags checked less than 45 minutes before a domestic departure may not be accepted (60 minutes for international); bags are accepted no earlier than 4 hours ahead. American and United: check-in and bag deadline is 45 minutes before domestic departure (United: 60 minutes for international). Delta: check bags at least 45 minutes before domestic departure, no more than 6 hours ahead.
tips: Go to the right terminal. Southwest, Delta and the international airlines use Terminal A; American uses Terminal B; United uses both.
Terminals are not connected after security, so clear security at the terminal your gate is in
PreCheck lanes close early: 6pm at Terminal A and 5pm at Terminal B, per SAT
Expect reduced curb space at Terminal B during construction. SAT suggests arriving early and using the Short-Term Garage for drop-off.
Parking rates go up on Nov 1, 2026. Short Term will be $30 a day and Economy $10 a day.

faq.q: How early should I get to San Antonio airport?
faq.a: SAT says its airlines recommend 90 minutes before a domestic flight and 2 hours during peak travel times. Allow extra time at Terminal B while curb lanes are closed for construction.

faq.q: Are Terminals A and B at SAT connected after security?
faq.a: No. You can walk between them before security, but each terminal has its own checkpoint. Changing terminals means screening again.

faq.q: Which terminal is my airline in at San Antonio?
faq.a: Southwest, Delta, Alaska, Frontier, Breeze, Sun Country and the international carriers use Terminal A. American uses Terminal B. United uses both, so check your boarding pass.

faq.q: Does San Antonio airport have TSA PreCheck and CLEAR?
faq.a: Yes, at both checkpoints. SAT lists PreCheck hours as 3:30am-6pm (Terminal A) and 3:30am-5pm (Terminal B). CLEAR+ lanes open at 4am and close between 4:30pm and 7pm, depending on terminal and day.

officialArrivalAdvice.domestic: Arrive two hours before your departure time
officialArrivalAdvice.international: Arrive three hours before your departure time

checkpoints.notes: 4 a.m.-8 p.m. Closest to A and S gates. General screening, CLEAR (general), TSA PreCheck and Gateside by TSA PreCheck. New checkpoint that opened in 2025.

SEA.betweenTerminals: Everything is one terminal. Concourses A-D connect by walkway, and the SEA Underground train runs to the N and S satellite concourses. Buses connect the satellites during train maintenance, including intermittent overnight closures through 2027.

securityWaits.summary: SEA says the new Checkpoint 1 and redesigned Checkpoint 6 (opened 2025) have lines moving quickly, with over 94% of travelers getting through in 20 minutes or less. More than a third of daily passengers arrive before 9 a.m.

SEA.precheckNotes: PreCheck is offered at Checkpoints 1, 2, 3, 5 and 6, but not 4. Checkpoint 3 PreCheck runs only 4 a.m.-8 p.m., Checkpoint 2 closes at 4 p.m., and Checkpoints 1 and 5 close at 8 p.m. After 10 p.m. only Checkpoints 3 (to 11:30 p.m.) and 4 (24 hours, no PreCheck) are listed as open. SEA's wait-times page lists slightly different screening types per checkpoint than its security page; SEA says hours and types are approximate, so check terminal signage.
SEA.touchlessId: TSA PreCheck Touchless ID is offered at Checkpoint 3 (4 a.m.-8 p.m.) and Checkpoint 6 for participating airlines only. Alaska announced in June 2025 that it was bringing Touchless ID to SEA (Mileage Plan members 18+, opt in with a KTN and passport), and SEA appears on an April 2026 list of 65 Touchless ID airports.

gettingThere.rideshare: Uber and Lyft drop off at the terminal on the airport drives; at peak times drivers may use the Arrivals drive to avoid traffic. Departures drives are often congested 6-8 a.m. Pickups are on the 3rd floor of the parking garage (stalls 1-34).
gettingThere.transit: Sound Transit Link light rail takes about 38 minutes from downtown Seattle. The Airport/SeaTac station connects to the terminal via the parking garage and 4th-floor skybridges, and a free Train-to-Plane shuttle runs between the station and the garage 5 a.m.-midnight.
gettingThere.driving: Arrive via the Airport Expressway; parking on its shoulders is illegal. The on-site garage has more than 11,000 spaces: drive-up General Parking on Levels 1-3, 6-8 and Level 5 Rows A-M, and Reserved Parking on Level 4 and Level 5 Rows N-W, bookable up to 120 days ahead. The free Cell Phone Lot is off the S. 170th St exit.

construction2026: Roadway Improvements (in progress) are widening the southbound Northern Airport Expressway from 4 to 6 lanes from S. 170th St to the curbsides and Main Garage. SEA listed main-work completion as Q2 2026 but still shows the project in progress.
SEA Underground train controls replacement brings intermittent overnight closures, with buses taking passengers to the N and S Concourses; completion estimated Q3 2027
Parking garage elevator refurbishment causes intermittent closures; as of an Aug 14, 2026 update, all yellow elevators were out of service
SEA Spot Saver, the free security-appointment program, ends November 30, 2026
S Concourse Evolution (international concourse renovation) is approved and in design
SEA.bagDrop: Alaska: check-in and bag drop typically close 40 minutes before departure, earlier for international. Delta: bags at least 45 min before departure, check-in at least 30 min without bags, at the gate 15 min before. Southwest: bags 45 min, check-in 30 min (domestic).
tips: In the morning, get dropped off on the lower Arrivals level to skip the congested Departures drive (SEA's own 'think opposite' advice)
Checkpoint 4 is the only 24-hour checkpoint but has no PreCheck lane. Late-night PreCheck travelers should know most PreCheck lanes close at 8 p.m.
Book SEA Spot Saver at Checkpoint 4 for a free reserved screening time (4 a.m.-10 p.m., 60-240 min before departure) until it ends Nov 30, 2026
Flights at N or S gates need extra minutes for the SEA Underground train, or a bus if the train is down
During peaks your flight may board by bus from the D Annex (Gates D21-26, across from D5) when gates are full
Reserved garage parking (Level 4 and Level 5 Rows N-W) guarantees a space; drive-up parking can mean extra time hunting for a stall in busy periods

faq.q: How early should I get to Sea-Tac?
faq.a: The Port of Seattle advises arriving two hours before a domestic flight and three hours before an international flight. More than a third of the day's passengers arrive before 9 a.m., so early-morning departures are the busiest.

faq.q: Which Sea-Tac security checkpoint should I use?
faq.a: Any checkpoint reaches all gates. Checkpoints 1-3 are closest to A and S gates, Checkpoint 4 to B and C gates, and Checkpoints 5-6 to C, D and N gates. PreCheck is not offered at Checkpoint 4.

faq.q: How long is the Link light rail ride from downtown Seattle to Sea-Tac?
faq.a: The Port of Seattle says it is about a 38-minute ride. From the Airport/SeaTac station, walk through the parking garage to the skybridges, or take the free Train-to-Plane shuttle (5 a.m.-midnight).

SFO.betweenTerminals: All terminals are connected by walkways before and after security, and you can enter at any checkpoint with a same-day boarding pass. AirTrain (free, 24 hours, as often as every 4 minutes) Red Line loops all terminals, garages and BART in about 9 minutes; the Blue Line adds the Rental Car Center and Long-Term Parking (about 25-minute loop).

securityWaits.summary: SFO does not publish typical waits, but its Check In & Security page shows live General and PreCheck wait times for each checkpoint. SFO says TSA PreCheck waits average 5 minutes or less.

SFO.precheckNotes: SFO says every checkpoint offers TSA PreCheck, Priority and CLEAR lanes. At Terminal 1, the live board lists PreCheck at the Mezzanine Level checkpoint (4:00 a.m.-11:00 p.m.), not at the Departures Level one.
SFO.touchlessId: TSA PreCheck Touchless ID is offered in Domestic Terminals 1, 2 and 3 for Alaska, American, Delta, Southwest and United passengers who opt in with their airline. You still need to carry a REAL ID-compliant physical ID.

gettingThere.rideshare: Lyft, Uber and Wingz drop off curbside on the Departures level of the domestic terminals; SFO suggests asking for an Arrivals level or garage drop-off at peak times. Domestic Lyft and Uber pickups are on Level 5 of the Domestic Garage. Waymo autonomous rides are available to select users in a pilot program.
gettingThere.transit: BART stops inside the International Terminal (G side), and BART says the ride to downtown San Francisco takes about 30 minutes. Domestic terminals reach it on the free AirTrain. Weekday BART service from SFO starts at 4:58 a.m. and Sunday service at 8:08 a.m. Caltrain connects via BART at Millbrae, and SamTrans Route 292 stops at the terminals.
gettingThere.driving: Curbs are for active drop-off only, with no waiting. Kiss & Fly drop-off is at the Rental Car Center on North McDonnell Rd, which connects to the terminals by AirTrain Blue Line. Parking options are the Domestic Garage (6'6" clearance), International Garages A and G, ParkFAST, Long-Term and Grand Hyatt valet; you can book online and change or cancel up to 2 hours before entry.

construction2026: Terminal 3 West modernization: the Departures Level curb is closed between Doors 6-13. SFO suggests dropping off at Terminal 2 or the Terminal 3 Arrivals level, especially in the morning.
The Terminal 3 AirTrain station is closed until 2027, and the Terminal 2 station serves both terminals
The F walkway from the Domestic Garage is closed; follow signs to the E walkway
Runway 1R was closed for repaving from March 30, 2026, causing flight delays. On Sept 16, 2026, SFO said it would reopen no later than Sept 29, 2026, ahead of schedule.
SFO.bagDrop: Delta: bags at least 45 min before departure, check-in at least 30 min without bags, at the gate 15 min before. Southwest: bags 45 min, check-in 30 min (domestic). Alaska: check-in and bag drop typically close 40 min before departure. SFO Remote Bag Check (Rental Car Center and Long-Term Parking, 4 a.m.-8 p.m.) requires bags at least 90 min before departure.
tips: United flying from D or E gates: check in at the United counters on the west side of Terminal 2. Use the Terminal 3 counters only for F-gate flights.
Without bags to check, SFO suggests getting dropped at Terminal 2 and using that checkpoint, since all gates connect after security

Free Remote Bag Check at the Rental Car Center (Kiss & Fly) and Long-Term Parking lets you check bags for domestic flights on participating airlines, including Alaska, American, Delta, Frontier, JetBlue and United. It's open 4 a.m.-8 p.m., and bags must be in at least 90 min before departure.
BART tells travelers with early Sunday-morning flights to make other plans because Sunday service starts late
Checkpoints B, D and F1 open at 3:15 a.m.; Checkpoint A opens at 4:15 a.m. and G at 4:30 a.m.
Without an acceptable ID, TSA ConfirmID costs $45 and takes 10-15 minutes on average, sometimes 30+ minutes

faq.q: How early should I get to SFO?
faq.a: SFO says arrival recommendations vary by airline and day of travel, and points to TSA's advice of 2 hours before domestic flights and 3 hours before international flights. Add time for parking or transit, checking bags and security.

faq.q: Can I use any security checkpoint at SFO?
faq.a: Yes. SFO says you can enter at any checkpoint in any terminal with a same-day boarding pass, and once through you can walk to all gates.

faq.q: Where do I check in for United at SFO during Terminal 3 construction?
faq.a: United's west-end Terminal 3 counters are closed. Check in at Terminal 2's west-side United counters for D and E gate flights, or at Terminal 3's east-end counters for F gate flights.

officialArrivalAdvice.domestic: Arrive at least 2 hours before domestic flights, and allow extra time for parking, check-in and screening
officialArrivalAdvice.international: Arrive at least 3 hours before international flights

checkpoints.notes: Opens 4:00 a.m.; standard closing 11 p.m., later if flights depart late. PreCheck is offered at peak times set by TSA. CLEAR Sun-Fri 4:30 a.m.-7 p.m., Sat 4:30 a.m.-4 p.m.

CLEAR Sun-Fri 4:30 a.m.-8 p.m., Sat 4:30 a.m.-6 p.m. CLEAR eGates for CLEAR+ members in the PreCheck lane (since March 2026). In-person PreCheck enrollment and renewal here, no appointment.

SJC.betweenTerminals: Terminals A and B are connected after security, so your boarding pass works at either checkpoint. The layout is linear, with less than a mile from Gate 1 to Gate 36 and no train. Before security, free shuttles run between the terminals every 7-10 minutes, 24 hours a day.

securityWaits.summary: SJC does not publish typical wait times or busiest hours. It says PreCheck lanes run during peak periods set by TSA.

SJC.precheckNotes: PreCheck is at both checkpoints but only during peak periods set by TSA, with no fixed hours published. Touchless ID is available for opted-in PreCheck members on American, Alaska, Delta, Hawaiian, Southwest and United.
SJC.touchlessId: TSA PreCheck Touchless ID is offered at SJC for PreCheck members flying American, Alaska, Delta, Hawaiian, Southwest or United who add their KTN and passport to their airline profile and opt in. Carry ID as a backup.

gettingThere.rideshare: Rideshares drop off at the departures curb of both terminals. Terminal A pickup: Stop 1 (Lyft, Tesla, Uber, Wingz) and Stop 9 (Waymo). Terminal B pickup at the ground transportation island: Stop 7 (Waymo), Stop 8 (Tesla, Uber), Stop 9 (Uber), Stop 10 (Lyft, Wingz).
gettingThere.transit: VTA Route 60 (Airport Flyer) stops at Terminal A (Stop 7) and Terminal B (Stop 5) and is free to ride from SJC. It links to Milpitas BART, Winchester station and Santa Clara Transit Center (Caltrain). To downtown San José, ride to Metro/Airport and take light rail (fare applies); SJC estimates 25-35 minutes.
gettingThere.driving: Parking can be reserved online as little as 2 hours ahead. Daily rates: Economy Lot 1 $19 (free shuttle every 7-10 minutes, 24/7), Terminal A Garage (Lot 2) $25, Terminal B Garage (Lot 3) $41, Daily Lot 4 and Lot 5 $31. Free cell phone waiting area at 2470 Airport Blvd. Never leave a vehicle unattended at the curb.

SJC.bagDrop: Southwest: bags 45 minutes before domestic departure, check-in 30 minutes. Alaska: check-in cutoff 50 minutes before domestic departure (AP, May 2025). Delta: bags 45 minutes before domestic departure. United and American: 45 minutes for check-in and bags on most domestic flights.
tips: Check your terminal: American, Delta, Frontier and United use Terminal A; Southwest, Alaska and Hawaiian use Terminal B
Both checkpoints reach every gate, since Terminals A and B connect after security
Checkpoints open at 4:00 a.m. (Terminal A) and 4:15 a.m. (Terminal B), so arriving earlier for a first-wave flight means waiting
PreCheck lanes are not open all day; they run during TSA-set peak periods
Reserve parking online to lock in a space; Economy Lot 1 is cheapest and has a 24-hour shuttle

faq.q: How early should I get to San José airport?
faq.a: SJC cites TSA advice: at least 2 hours before a domestic flight and 3 hours before an international flight. Add time if you are parking.

faq.q: Which terminal is my airline at SJC?
faq.a: Terminal A: American, Delta, Frontier, United and Volaris. Terminal B: Southwest, Alaska, Hawaiian and ZIPAIR.

faq.q: What time does security open at SJC?
faq.a: Terminal A opens at 4:00 a.m. and Terminal B at 4:15 a.m. Standard closing is 11 p.m., and TSA stays open later for late departures.

faq.q: Can I walk between Terminal A and Terminal B after security?
faq.a: Yes. The terminals are connected inside security, so you can clear either checkpoint and walk to any gate.

SJD.name: Los Cabos International Airport
SJD.passportControl: Mexico has no separate exit immigration check for air departures. Your airline checks your passport at check-in. US airlines fly from Terminal 2. Air arrivals get either a passport stamp or, at the Terminal 2 e-gates, a printed ticket with a QR code. E-gate users get no stamp, and the ticket links to the digital FMM. UK government advice says you must show your passport with its entry stamp, or the printed e-gate ticket, when you leave. If you lose your passport, replacing the entry stamp costs about 700 pesos at an airport immigration office. Baja California Sur charges international visitors an 'Embrace It' fee, reported at 470 pesos in December 2025. Reports say airport checks of the QR receipt are rare, but they can happen. Los Cabos has no US preclearance, so you clear US immigration and customs after you land.

officialArrivalAdvice.international: When you're traveling outside of the United States, we suggest arriving at least 3 hours prior to your departure. (Delta; Southwest and JetBlue also advise 3 hours at Los Cabos.)

terminals.name: Terminal 1
notes: Domestic Mexican flights; no US airlines are listed here
Domestic flights are due to move into Terminal 2 by late 2027, after which Terminal 1 will close for a time

checkpoints.notes: JetBlue lists security checkpoint hours of 7:00am-9:00pm. No published wait times found.
checkpoints.name: Departures security

notes: International terminal; customs and immigration are on the ground floor
Being expanded in 2026; expect temporary walls, rerouted corridors and longer walks to gates
Southwest's ticket counter opens three hours before its first departure; gates change daily
JetBlue's ticket counter opens 3 hours before departure; its lobby is cashless and it has no priority security lane or curbside check-in here

securityWaits.summary: This research found no published security wait times for Los Cabos. Wikipedia notes congestion and capacity limits at peak hours. Terminal 2 expansion work began in mid-2026.

gettingThere.rideshare: You can take an Uber to the airport; drop-offs at departures are allowed. Uber pickups at the airport are still prohibited, which only affects arrivals. Uber puts the average trip from San José del Cabo at about 21 minutes and 12 km, with an average UberX fare of about MX$255 over the past month. Private transfers and shared shuttles have the federal plates needed to work at the airport, so the Cabo Sun suggests pre-booking one.
gettingThere.driving: The airport is about 8 miles from San José del Cabo and about a 23-mile drive from Cabo San Lucas. Mexico News Daily put the drive from Cabo San Lucas on Federal Highway 1 at about 40 minutes; the airport toll road is faster and costs up to 113 pesos. The Cabo Sun says most transfers from Cabo San Lucas use the toll road. The underpass at the former Fonatur roundabout, whose construction had slowed airport traffic, opened on May 25, 2026.

construction2026: Terminal 2 is being expanded. Heavy construction began around mid-2026, and the airport stays open throughout. Expect temporary walls, rerouted walkways, changing signs and longer walks to gates (The Cabo Sun, March 2026).
The work adds three gates, new jet bridges and nearly 20 self-service check-in kiosks. Terminal 2 will grow by about 22,000 square meters.
Domestic flights are due to move from Terminal 1 into Terminal 2 by late 2027. Terminal 1 will then close for a time. Mexico News Daily says the full upgrade should be done by 2029.
SJD.bagDrop: Delta: check in at least 1 hour before international departures; Los Cabos is not on its list of airports with earlier cutoffs. American, United, Alaska and Southwest: check-in closes 60 minutes before international departures (AP, May 2025). JetBlue: check in and check bags at least 60 minutes before international departures. Southwest's ticket counter opens three hours before its first departure, and JetBlue's opens 3 hours before departure.
tips: US airlines, including American, Delta, United, Alaska, Southwest and JetBlue, fly from Terminal 2. Terminal 1 is for domestic Mexican flights.
Keep your passport with its entry stamp, or your printed e-gate ticket, until you have left Mexico.
Allow extra time to walk to your gate. Terminal 2 is under construction, and walkways and signs may change.
Uber is fine for getting to the airport. The pickup ban applies only to arrivals.
Bring a card if you fly JetBlue. Its Los Cabos lobby does not accept cash.
Keep your Embrace It QR receipt on your phone. Reports say checks are rare, but they can happen.

faq.q: How early should I get to Los Cabos Airport for a flight to the US?
faq.a: Three hours. Delta, Southwest and JetBlue all advise 3 hours. Check-in and bag drop close 60 minutes before departure on the main US airlines.

faq.q: Which Los Cabos terminal is my flight to the US from?
faq.a: Terminal 2. American, Delta, United, Alaska, Southwest, JetBlue, Frontier and Sun Country all fly from there. Terminal 1 handles domestic Mexican flights.

faq.q: Do I go through immigration when leaving Mexico?
faq.a: There is no separate exit check. Your airline checks your passport. Keep your passport with its entry stamp, or your e-gate ticket, in case you are asked.

faq.q: Can I take an Uber to Los Cabos Airport?
faq.a: Yes. Uber drop-offs at departures are allowed. Uber pickups at the airport are still prohibited.

faq.q: Is Los Cabos Airport under construction?
faq.a: Yes. Terminal 2 is being expanded, with heavy work since mid-2026. The airport stays open, but expect detours and longer walks to gates.

SJU.name: Luis Muñoz Marín International Airport

officialArrivalAdvice.domestic: JetBlue advises arriving 2 hours before departure at San Juan, and Delta's standard US advice is also 2 hours. Southwest suggests 180 minutes at SJU. Flights to the US mainland count as domestic, but every bag first goes through USDA agricultural inspection.
officialArrivalAdvice.international: Delta suggests arriving at least 3 hours before international flights.
