SJU.betweenTerminals: Terminals A and B connect outside security near the ticket counters. After security, covered walkways link all the concourses, including A. Upgraded Points puts the longest gate-to-gate walk at about 0.6 miles, or about 15 minutes.

securityWaits.summary: This research found no official typical wait times for SJU. In TSA's hourly screening counts for Sept 20-26, 2026, the airport was busiest from about 4am to 6am, 8am to noon, and 3pm to 5pm. The main Terminal B checkpoint handled about two-thirds of passengers. The Terminal A checkpoint was busiest around 8am and 1pm and screened no one from 7pm to 3am.
busiestTimes: Sundays and Fridays (busiest days in the TSA sample week)

SJU.precheckNotes: CLEAR's SJU page lists TSA PreCheck lanes at both checkpoints, Terminal A and Terminal B/C. Upgraded Points says the Terminal A PreCheck lanes are open 24 hours, but TSA's counts show no screening at that checkpoint from 7pm to 3am. The Terminal B checkpoint screened passengers around the clock. CLEAR also offers TSA PreCheck enrollment at the airport.
SJU.touchlessId: Southwest's SJU page lists a TSA PreCheck Touchless ID checkpoint. To use it, TSA says you need PreCheck, a valid passport and an opted-in airline profile, and you must carry a physical REAL ID-compliant ID as backup. This research found no list confirming which other airlines offer it at SJU.

gettingThere.rideshare: Uber serves SJU and drops you curbside at the terminal you pick. Tourist taxis charge fixed fares between the airport and the tourist zones: $12 for Isla Verde, $17 for Condado, Ocean Park, Miramar and Santurce, and $21 for Old San Juan and the cruise piers. Extras include $1 per bag, $1 late at night, $2 for groups over five, and a $3 airport fee.
gettingThere.transit: Public buses stop on the upper-level roadway outside Terminals A and B and Concourse E. Routes include D53 (Condado and the Convention Center), E40 (Piñero Avenue) and T5/D53 (Isla Verde and Old San Juan).
gettingThere.driving: The short-term garage is outside Terminal B; Upgraded Points listed $27.55 for the first day in May 2026. A covered bridge with elevators now links the garage to Terminal A. The long-term lot is next to Concourse E, and a cell phone lot offers up to 45 minutes free.

construction2026: Aerostar, the airport operator, hired Burns & McDonnell to design a rehab and expansion of Terminal A. The plan includes a larger, reconfigured TSA checkpoint, new ticketing and check-in areas, and two more gates. No construction dates have been published.
A restroom renovation program of about $7 million is under way (News is my Business, June 2026).
SJU.bagDrop: Every bag going to the mainland must pass USDA inspection before you hand it to the airline, so do that first. JetBlue: at SJU, check in at least 45 minutes before departure, with or without bags; it does not accept bags more than 4 hours before departure. Delta: check bags at least 45 minutes before US departures. American and United: domestic check-in closes 45 minutes before departure. Southwest: be at the counter with checked bags 45 minutes before departure (AP, May 2025).
tips: Go to the USDA inspection station before the airline counter. Inspectors put a sticker on bags that pass. Tell them about any fruit, plants or other farm products.

Most fresh fruits and vegetables, pork products (including chicharrones), plants in soil, cactus and sugarcane cannot go to the mainland. Coconut, pineapple, papaya, avocado, cut flowers and coffee beans are allowed after inspection.
Carry-on bags are inspected too, at a marked agricultural station at the security checkpoint or the gate.
You do not need a passport for a direct flight to the mainland. Adults still need a REAL ID or another TSA-accepted ID.

On a late-night flight from Terminal A, you may need to use the Terminal B checkpoint. In TSA's September 2026 counts, the Terminal A checkpoint screened no one from 7pm to 3am. The concourses connect after security.
JetBlue at Terminal A will not take bags more than 4 hours before departure, and its lobby does not accept cash.

faq.q: How early should I get to San Juan airport (SJU)?
faq.a: JetBlue and Delta advise 2 hours for flights to the mainland; Southwest suggests 3. Allow time for the USDA bag inspection, which comes before check-in. Bag drop closes 45 minutes before departure on JetBlue, Delta, American, United and Southwest.

faq.q: Do I need a passport to fly from San Juan to the US mainland?
faq.a: No, not for US citizens on a direct flight. CBP says you need a passport if the trip also includes a foreign country. You still need a REAL ID-compliant license or another TSA-accepted ID.

faq.q: What is the USDA inspection at San Juan airport?
faq.a: USDA inspects all passenger bags going to the mainland before departure. Checked bags are inspected before you hand them to the airline, and carry-ons at the checkpoint or gate. Failing to declare items can bring fines of $100 to $1,000 per violation.

faq.q: Which SJU terminal is my airline in?
faq.a: JetBlue, Avelo and Tradewind use Terminal A. American, Delta, United, Southwest and Sun Country check in at Terminal B, and Frontier flies from Concourse C. Terminals B, C and D share one checkpoint.

faq.q: Does SJU have TSA PreCheck and CLEAR?
faq.a: Yes. CLEAR lists CLEAR and TSA PreCheck lanes at both the Terminal A and Terminal B/C checkpoints. Southwest lists a PreCheck Touchless ID checkpoint.

SLC.name: Salt Lake City International Airport

officialArrivalAdvice.domestic: Arrive 2 hours prior to boarding for a domestic flight
officialArrivalAdvice.international: Arrive 3 hours prior to departure for an international flight

terminals.name: Main Terminal (Concourses A and B)

checkpoints.notes: Listed as open 3:30am-1:00am; the same SLC page gives regular PreCheck hours at this checkpoint as 3:30am-10:00pm. Hours subject to change. Onsite PreCheck enrollment is available in the CLEAR lane.
checkpoints.name: Main TSA checkpoint, Level 2

checkpoints.notes: Open 6:00am-5:00pm; serves international arrivals with connections and departing passengers.
checkpoints.name: International checkpoint, ground level (International Arrivals area)

notes: Single terminal with two long concourses (A and B) reached after security; Concourse B is reached by the Mid-Concourse Tunnel or the Central Tunnel (opened fall 2024).

Official walking times from the post-security terminal (not using moving walks): about 9.5 min to the west end of Concourse A, 7 min to the Central Tunnel end of Concourse B, 8.5 min to the east end of Concourse A, and about 14 min to either far end of Concourse B (21 min if you stand on the moving walks).

Ten Concourse B-east gates opened in October 2025 for Delta and Southwest; four more opened July 14, 2026, and the final seven Phase 4 gates (serving United plus two common-use gates) open October 27, 2026.
Departures drop-off is on the elevated roadway to Level 3; stay right on Terminal Drive.

SLC.betweenTerminals: One terminal; Concourses A and B are connected after security by the Central Tunnel and Mid-Concourse Tunnel (walk with moving walkways).

securityWaits.summary: SLC has identified peak departure times when higher volumes of passengers depart; the airport homepage shows a live security wait estimate.

SLC.precheckNotes: PreCheck is at the main Level 2 checkpoint; SLC lists regular PreCheck hours there as 3:30am-10:00pm, so late-night travelers may not have a PreCheck lane. TSA PreCheck enrollment is offered in the CLEAR lane.
SLC.touchlessId: TSA lists Touchless ID at 65 airports and tells travelers to check with their airline. Delta lists SLC as a participating airport with dedicated Touchless ID bag drop. A March 2026 third-party list shows Alaska, American, Delta, Southwest and United participating at SLC.

gettingThere.rideshare: Rideshare (TNC) pickup is at signed curbside zones on the ground level outside the terminal (B-Lane). General passenger drop-off is the elevated roadway to Level 3.
gettingThere.transit: UTA TRAX Green Line: the Airport station is on the ground level on the east side of the terminal (exit door 1A and go east). One-way fare $2.50.
gettingThere.driving: Stay right on Terminal Drive for the Level 3 departures drop-off. Reserve parking in advance for the garage, Lot E and long-term/economy parking. 13-foot height limit in front of the terminal. Free Park and Wait lot for drivers picking up.

construction2026: Phase 4 (final phase) of The New SLC: the last seven Concourse B-east gates and six concessions open October 27, 2026; some paving and ancillary work may extend into early 2027.
Terminal Drive exit lanes were repaved in phases May 11-27, 2026, with two lanes kept open.
SLC.bagDrop: Delta: domestic bags must be checked at least 45 minutes before departure (30 minutes if no checked bags); bags not accepted more than 6 hours before departure; be at the gate 15 minutes before departure.
tips: Budget walking time after security: the far ends of Concourse B are about 3,000 feet from the checkpoint, roughly 14 minutes at a steady walk.
The Central Tunnel (opened 2024) cuts the walk to the middle of Concourse B to about 7 minutes versus 15 minutes via the older Mid-Concourse Tunnel.
SLC lists PreCheck hours at the main checkpoint as 3:30am-10:00pm; late-evening flyers may face standard screening.
Reserve parking ahead: SLC urges advance reservations for the garage, Lot E and economy parking during busy periods.
TRAX Green Line stops right outside the east side of the terminal (door 1A) if you want to skip parking.

faq.q: How early should I get to Salt Lake City airport?
faq.a: SLC recommends arriving 2 hours before boarding for domestic flights and 3 hours before international departures. Add time for the walk: the farthest Concourse B gates are about 14 minutes on foot from security.

faq.q: How long is the walk to the gates at SLC?
faq.a: According to the airport's walking-time chart, it takes about 7 to 14 minutes (not using moving walks) from the post-security terminal to Concourse A or B gates, and up to about 21 minutes if you stand on the moving walkways to the far end of Concourse B.

faq.q: Does SLC have TSA PreCheck and CLEAR?
faq.a: Yes. The main Level 2 checkpoint has PreCheck (regular hours 3:30am-10:00pm per the airport) and a CLEAR lane, where you can also enroll in PreCheck.

SMF.name: Sacramento International Airport

officialArrivalAdvice.domestic: SMF says to check with your airline, and gives a rule of thumb of 2.5 hours before a domestic flight. You may be denied check-in if you arrive less than 45 minutes before your flight.
officialArrivalAdvice.international: SMF's rule of thumb is 3 hours before an international flight

terminals.name: Terminal A

checkpoints.notes: On level 2 of Terminal A. SMF says checkpoints open at 4am daily and close at 12:30am, depending on flight schedules. CLEAR's site lists CLEAR in front of the checkpoint entrance, 4am-10pm Sunday-Friday and 4am-5pm Saturday. CLEAR's page also lists PreCheck here, but gives two different sets of hours.
checkpoints.name: Terminal A checkpoint

notes: Ticket counters are on the ground level
Terminal A is a separate building from Terminal B and is not connected after security

terminals.name: Terminal B (Concourse B)

checkpoints.notes: Ride the automated people mover from level 3 of Terminal B to Concourse B, then clear security there. SMF says checkpoints open at 4am daily and close at 12:30am, depending on flight schedules. TSA's screening counts call this checkpoint 'Central B'; it handled about two-thirds of SMF's screenings in the week of Sep 13, 2026. CLEAR's site lists CLEAR on the right side of the AirTrain entrance, 4am-8pm. CLEAR's page also lists PreCheck here, but gives two different sets of hours.
checkpoints.name: Terminal B checkpoint (Concourse B)

notes: Ticket counters are on level 2. Airport shuttles stop at the east entrance of the ground (baggage claim) level.
A new walkway between Terminal B and Concourse B is under construction and is expected to open in the first quarter of 2027

SMF.betweenTerminals: Terminals A and B are separate buildings and are not connected after security. Walking takes about 10 minutes through the parking garage (sky bridges from Terminal A level 2 and Terminal B level 3) and is the fastest way. Free shuttles also run between the terminals 24 hours a day; SMF's FAQ says to take the Daily Lot shuttle, which leaves every 10 minutes from the ground transportation curbs. You must clear security again in the other terminal.

securityWaits.summary: SMF does not publish typical peak times. In TSA's hourly screening counts for Sep 13-19, 2026, SMF was busiest from 4am to 7am, peaking 5-6am. There was a second rise from about 9am to noon, peaking 11am-noon. Traffic was much lighter after 7pm. Friday, Thursday, Sunday and Monday were the busiest days that week; Saturday and Tuesday were the quietest.
busiestTimes: Fridays, Thursdays, Sundays and Mondays (TSA counts, week of Sep 13, 2026)

SMF.precheckNotes: CLEAR's SMF page lists TSA PreCheck at both Terminal A and Terminal B, but gives two different sets of hours, so check before you go. SMF says every airline also runs a priority lane at both checkpoints, with its own rules for who can use it.
SMF.touchlessId: Southwest lists SMF among its TSA PreCheck Touchless ID airports. You need a Rapid Rewards account, PreCheck with a valid KTN, a valid passport, and a mobile boarding pass, and you must be 18 or older. This research did not confirm which other airlines offer it at SMF.

gettingThere.rideshare: Uber, Lyft and Wingz operate at SMF. Pickup is at the ground transportation curb, in designated areas shown on SMF's maps. The curb is only for active loading and unloading; vehicles that wait or are left unattended may be ticketed or towed. Drivers waiting to pick up can use the free waiting area.
gettingThere.transit: SacRT Route 142 runs between downtown Sacramento and Terminals A and B. SacRT lists it as hourly, about 5:15am-10:33pm daily, for $2.50. SMF says it runs every 20-30 minutes when combined with Yolobus Routes 42A and 42B, which also serve Davis and Woodland.
gettingThere.driving: Parking is first-come, first-served, with no reservations. Current daily maximums: Garage 1 $21 (sky bridges to both terminals), Daily Lot $14 (shuttle every 15-20 minutes) and Economy lots $12 (shuttle every 25-30 minutes). SMF says to allow up to 60 minutes from the Economy lots to the terminal. Lots can fill and close without notice. Booths no longer take cash; pay cash at pay-on-foot kiosks. When Garage 2 opens (expected fall 2026), daily rates rise to $28 (garage), $19 (Daily) and $14 (Economy).

construction2026: Garage 2, with about 5,500 spaces west of Terminal B, is expected to open in the fourth quarter of 2026. Parking rates go up when it opens.
SMF lists construction of a new Terminal A exit road as starting in the second quarter of 2026, with opening expected in the fourth quarter of 2027. SMF has not published lane closures for it.
Concourse B expansion (6 more gates) is scheduled to start construction in the fourth quarter of 2026
A pedestrian walkway between Terminal B and Concourse B is under construction and is expected to open in the first quarter of 2027
SMF.bagDrop: Southwest: check bags at least 45 minutes before a domestic flight's scheduled departure (60 minutes for international), and check in at least 30 minutes before a domestic flight. Delta: bags 45 minutes before domestic departure, check-in 30 minutes without bags. United and American: check in and check bags 45 minutes before most domestic flights. Alaska: check in at least 50 minutes before a domestic flight (AP, May 2025). SMF warns you may be denied check-in less than 45 minutes before departure.
tips: Check your terminal before you leave. Southwest, Alaska, Frontier, JetBlue, Aeromexico and Volaris use Terminal B; American, Delta, United and Air Canada use Terminal A. The terminals are not connected after security.
In Terminal B, security is on Concourse B, after the people mover ride from level 3. Allow a few extra minutes for the train.
Security opens at 4am, and 4-7am was the busiest stretch in TSA's counts for mid-September 2026. Arrive early for first-wave flights.
Parking in the Economy lots? SMF says to allow up to 60 minutes to reach the terminal, and lots can fill and close without notice.
Parking rates rise when Garage 2 opens, expected in late 2026; the Economy lots go from $12 to $14 a day

faq.q: How early should I get to Sacramento airport (SMF)?
faq.a: SMF says to check with your airline. Its rule of thumb is 2.5 hours before a domestic flight and 3 hours before an international flight. Mornings, especially 4-7am, are the busiest at security.

faq.q: Which terminal is Southwest at SMF?
faq.a: Terminal B. Check in on level 2, then take the people mover from level 3 to Concourse B, where the security checkpoint is.

faq.q: Are SMF's Terminal A and Terminal B connected?
faq.a: No. They are separate buildings. Walking through the parking garage takes about 10 minutes, or take the Daily Lot shuttle, every 10 minutes. You must go through security again in the other terminal.

faq.q: What time does security open at SMF?
faq.a: SMF says TSA checkpoints open at 4am daily and close at 12:30am, depending on flight schedules.

faq.q: Does SMF have TSA PreCheck and CLEAR?
faq.a: Yes. CLEAR lists lanes at both terminals: Terminal A 4am-10pm Sunday-Friday and 4am-5pm Saturday, and Terminal B 4am-8pm. CLEAR's page also lists PreCheck at both terminals.

SNA.name: John Wayne Airport, Orange County

officialArrivalAdvice.domestic: Arrive 1.5 to 2 hours before a domestic flight. JWA says early mornings may need extra time because of heavy travel volume.
officialArrivalAdvice.international: Arrive 3 hours before an international flight

terminals.name: Terminal A (Thomas F. Riley Terminal)

checkpoints.notes: TSA's screening counts list it as CKPT A. JWA does not publish checkpoint hours. Any gate can be reached from any checkpoint.
checkpoints.name: Terminal A checkpoint

notes: Closest parking: structures A1 and A2. Baggage claim 1 and 2.

terminals.name: Terminal B (Thomas F. Riley Terminal)

checkpoints.notes: TSA's screening counts list it as CKPT B. The only CLEAR lane at SNA is here; CLEAR's site lists CLEAR and a PreCheck lane at 5am-7pm. Any gate can be reached from any checkpoint.
checkpoints.name: Terminal B checkpoint

notes: Closest parking: structures B2 and C. Baggage claim 3 and 4.

terminals.name: Terminal C (Thomas F. Riley Terminal)

checkpoints.notes: TSA's screening counts list it as CKPT C. JWA does not publish checkpoint hours. Any gate can be reached from any checkpoint.
checkpoints.name: Terminal C checkpoint

notes: Skycap curbside check-in for Southwest is at the main entrance to Terminal C. JWA says curbside check-in for other airlines is out of service until further notice.
Closest parking: structures B2 and C. Baggage claim 5 and 6.

SNA.betweenTerminals: Terminals A, B and C are parts of one building, the Thomas F. Riley Terminal. JWA says any gate can be reached from any security checkpoint. JSX flies from Jay's Air Center, not the main terminal.

securityWaits.summary: JWA says early mornings may need extra time because of heavy travel volume. Under the airport's curfew, airlines may not schedule departures before 6:45am Monday-Saturday or 7:45am Sunday, and no scheduled commercial departures are allowed from 10pm to 7am (8am Sunday). In TSA's hourly screening counts for Sep 13-19, 2026, SNA was busiest from 5am to 7am, peaking 6-7am. There was a second rise from about 9am to noon, peaking 10-11am. Traffic was much lighter after 6pm. Thursday, Monday, Friday and Sunday were the busiest days that week; Saturday and Tuesday were the quietest.
busiestTimes: Thursdays, Mondays, Fridays and Sundays (TSA counts, week of Sep 13, 2026)

SNA.precheckNotes: JWA's TSA PreCheck page explains the program but does not say which checkpoints have PreCheck lanes. CLEAR's site lists a PreCheck lane at the Terminal B checkpoint, 5am-7pm. This research could not confirm PreCheck lanes or hours at the Terminal A and C checkpoints. JWA is not a Global Entry enrollment center.
SNA.touchlessId: Southwest lists SNA among its TSA PreCheck Touchless ID airports. You need a Rapid Rewards account, PreCheck with a valid KTN, a valid passport, and a mobile boarding pass, and you must be 18 or older. This research did not confirm which other airlines offer it at SNA.

gettingThere.rideshare: Lyft, Uber and Wingz drop off at the Departures (upper) Level curb. Pickup is on the top levels of parking structures A2 and B2, and on the upper level of the Terminal C structure next to ticketing. No waiting is allowed at either curb; the white curb is only for loading and unloading.
gettingThere.transit: Transit options are limited. OCTA Route 76 runs between the airport and Huntington Beach, 6am-6pm on weekdays, stopping at Terminal A Pillar 2 on the Arrival (lower) Level. The nearest train stations (Irvine, Santa Ana and Tustin) are about 10 miles away. Shared-ride shuttles need a 24-hour advance reservation.
gettingThere.driving: Use I-405, SR-55 or SR-73. Parking structure entrances are on the Departure (upper) Level only. Rates (since Jan 1, 2025): terminal structures A1, A2, B2 and C $4/hour, $30/day; Main Street lot (1512 Main St, Irvine) $3/hour, $20/day, with a free shuttle every 15 minutes, 4:30am-midnight; curbside valet $50/day, 5am-11pm. JWA says the terminal structures fill quickly, so allow extra time.

construction2026: Electrical work on the lower roadway near Terminal C is scheduled from October 2025 to August 2028
The cell phone waiting lot has limited space while a construction trailer is staged there. JWA says it does not expect delays from its Capital Improvement Program.
SNA.bagDrop: Southwest: check bags at least 45 minutes before a domestic flight's scheduled departure (60 minutes for international), and check in at least 30 minutes before a domestic flight. American and United: check in and check bags 45 minutes before most domestic flights. Delta: bags 45 minutes before domestic departure, check-in 30 minutes without bags. Alaska: check in at least 50 minutes before a domestic flight (AP, May 2025).
tips: Check your terminal: Southwest, Allegiant and Frontier use Terminal C; United and Alaska use Terminal B; American, Delta, Air Canada, Breeze and WestJet use Terminal A
All three checkpoints lead to every gate, but CLEAR is only at the Terminal B checkpoint, 5am-7pm
Early mornings are the crunch. Flights cannot be scheduled before 6:45am (7:45am Sunday), and TSA counts peaked 6-7am in mid-September 2026.
The terminal parking structures fill quickly. Allow extra time, or use the Main Street lot and its 15-minute shuttle.
Flying Southwest with bags? Skycap curbside check-in is at the main entrance to Terminal C.

faq.q: How early should I get to John Wayne Airport (SNA)?
faq.a: JWA says 1.5 to 2 hours before a domestic flight and 3 hours before an international flight. Allow extra time early in the morning, when security is busiest.

faq.q: Which terminal is Southwest at SNA?
faq.a: Terminal C. Southwest has skycap curbside check-in at the main entrance to Terminal C.

faq.q: Are SNA's terminals connected after security?
faq.a: Yes. Terminals A, B and C are one building, and any gate can be reached from any security checkpoint.

faq.q: Does SNA have TSA PreCheck and CLEAR?
faq.a: Yes. CLEAR is at the Terminal B checkpoint, and CLEAR's site lists CLEAR and a PreCheck lane there from 5am to 7pm. JWA does not list PreCheck hours for Terminals A and C.

faq.q: Where do Uber and Lyft drop off and pick up at SNA?
faq.a: Drop-off is at the Departures (upper) Level curb. Pickup is on the top levels of parking structures A2 and B2, and on the upper level of the Terminal C structure.

STL.name: St. Louis Lambert International Airport

officialArrivalAdvice.domestic: Arrive 2 hours before a domestic flight (TSA guidance quoted on STL's FAQ page), and allow extra time for driving, parking and drop-off
officialArrivalAdvice.international: Arrive 3 hours before an international flight (TSA guidance quoted on STL's FAQ page)

terminals.name: Terminal 1 (Concourses A and C)

checkpoints.notes: Serves the A gates: Delta (A2-A10), United (A14-A21), Air Canada (A17) and charter departures. STL lists hours of 3:30am-7:00pm, set by TSA and subject to change. CLEAR's site lists CLEAR at Checkpoint A, about 4am to 5:30-6pm depending on the day.
checkpoints.name: T1, A Gates checkpoint

checkpoints.notes: Serves the C gates: American (C6-C24), Alaska (C15), Frontier (C19, C23) and Southern Airways Express (C1, C3). STL lists hours of 3:30am-10:00pm. CLEAR's site lists CLEAR at Checkpoint C, 4am-5:30pm Sunday-Friday and 4am-4pm Saturday.
checkpoints.name: T1, C Gates checkpoint

notes: Concourses B and D are closed; Terminal 1 uses Concourses A and C
Delta's ticket counter is at Door 4, with curbside check-in at Departures Drive, Entry 4. Delta counter hours: 4am-7pm Sunday-Friday, 4am-6pm Saturday.
This research could not confirm whether Concourses A and C are connected after security, so use the checkpoint for your gate
The MetroLink station at Terminal 1 is closed from Oct 12, 2026 until about mid-December 2026 for airport construction

terminals.name: Terminal 2 (Concourse E)

checkpoints.notes: Serves the E/F gates: Southwest (E4-E40), British Airways and Lufthansa (E29). STL lists hours of 3:30am-10:00pm. TSA screening counts report two screening points here, T2-E and T2-F. CLEAR's site lists CLEAR at Checkpoint E (4am-8pm Sunday-Friday, 4am-6pm Saturday) and a PreCheck CLEAR lane at Checkpoint F (4am-7pm Sunday-Friday, 4am-5pm Saturday).
checkpoints.name: T2, E/F Gates checkpoint

notes: Southwest, STL's dominant carrier, uses Terminal 2
Southwest curbside check-in is at Departures Drive, Entry 1: 4am-noon Sunday-Friday and 4am-10am Saturday
British Airways' ticket counter is at Door 3
Gate E29 also handles international arrivals, including Frontier and charter flights

STL.betweenTerminals: The two terminals are not connected and you cannot walk between them. A free Terminal Shuttle runs 24/7 between Terminal 1 Exit 12 and Terminal 2 Door 10, about 10 minutes, with pickups every 8-15 minutes. Connecting between terminals means going through TSA screening again.

securityWaits.summary: STL shows a live estimated wait on its security page, based on MyTSA (which reports a historical maximum within a range). It publishes no typical peak times. In TSA's hourly screening counts for Sep 13-19, 2026, STL was busiest from 4am to 9am, peaking 7-8am. There was a smaller midday rise around 11am-2pm, and traffic was much lighter after 6pm. Sunday, Friday, Thursday and Monday were the busiest days that week; Tuesday and Saturday were the quietest.
busiestTimes: Sundays, Thursdays, Fridays and Mondays (TSA counts, week of Sep 13, 2026)

STL.precheckNotes: STL lists TSA PreCheck lanes at the Concourse A and Concourse C checkpoints in Terminal 1 and the Concourse E checkpoint in Terminal 2. The PreCheck enrollment center that was in Terminal 1 near Entry 1 has closed; CLEAR enrollment pods outside the checkpoints can help with PreCheck enrollment.
STL.touchlessId: A Newsweek report from early 2026 listed STL among airports scheduled to get TSA PreCheck Touchless ID in spring 2026. This research could not confirm that it is live at STL or which airlines offer it there.

gettingThere.rideshare: Uber and Lyft pickup is at Terminal 1 Door 6 (Departure level) and Terminal 2 Door 12 (Arrivals level). STL does not list separate rideshare drop-off spots; follow signs to your terminal's Departures Drive. Vehicles may not wait in the Arrivals areas; use the free T1 or T2 cell phone lots.
gettingThere.transit: MetroLink's Red Line stops at both terminals. The Terminal 1 station is closed from Oct 12, 2026 until about mid-December 2026. Until it reopens, ride to Terminal 2 and take the free shuttle from Exit 10 to Terminal 1; Metro says to allow a few extra minutes. Buy fares in advance at station machines or in the Transit app.
gettingThere.driving: From westbound I-70 or I-170, take Exit 238A (Lambert International Blvd). From eastbound I-70, take Exit 235C (Cypress Road). The terminals are about a mile apart, so follow signs for your terminal. Garage rates since July 1, 2026: Terminal 1 $31/day, Terminal 2 $33/day. Lot B is $14/day and Lot C $12-15/day, with shuttles every 8-15 minutes, 24/7. Lot E, east of Terminal 2, is reservation-only ($27/day plus a $10 reservation fee). STL suggests allowing 30 extra minutes when parking in a shuttle lot.

construction2026: The Terminal 1 MetroLink station is closed for airport construction from Oct 12, 2026 until about mid-December 2026; a free shuttle links it to the Terminal 2 station

A new single terminal is still in design (30% done in early 2026; groundbreaking possibly in 2027). Reported plans close Concourse A in August 2027 and move its airlines to Concourses C and D, so nothing changes for departures in 2026.
STL.bagDrop: Southwest: check bags at least 45 minutes before a domestic flight's scheduled departure (60 minutes for international), and check in at least 30 minutes before a domestic flight. Delta: bags 45 minutes before domestic departure, 30 minutes without bags. American and United: check in and check bags 45 minutes before domestic departure (AP, May 2025).
tips: Check which terminal your airline uses before you leave. The terminals are more than a mile apart, and you cannot walk between them.
Flying Southwest? Go to Terminal 2. Delta, United and Air Canada use the A-gates checkpoint in Terminal 1; American, Alaska and Frontier use the C-gates checkpoint.
The T1 A-gates checkpoint is listed as open only until 7pm, while the C-gates and Terminal 2 checkpoints are listed until 10pm. If you fly late from the A gates, check flystl.com for current hours.
Taking MetroLink to Terminal 1 before mid-December 2026? Get off at Terminal 2 and take the free shuttle from Exit 10, and allow a few extra minutes.
Lot E now takes reservations only. Without a booking, use another lot and allow 30 extra minutes for the shuttle.
Southwest curbside check-in at Entry 1 closes at noon on most days (10am on Saturday), so later flyers check bags inside

faq.q: How early should I get to St. Louis airport (STL)?
faq.a: STL quotes TSA's advice: arrive 2 hours before a domestic flight and 3 hours before an international flight. Mornings are busiest at security, especially 7-8am, so allow extra time then and for parking or drop-off.

faq.q: Which terminal is Southwest at STL?
faq.a: Terminal 2, Concourse E. Southwest curbside check-in is at Departures Drive, Entry 1, open 4am-noon Sunday-Friday and 4am-10am Saturday.

faq.q: Are STL's Terminal 1 and Terminal 2 connected?
faq.a: No. There is no walking route between them. A free 24/7 shuttle runs between Terminal 1 Exit 12 and Terminal 2 Door 10, about 10 minutes, every 8-15 minutes. Connecting passengers must go through security again.

faq.q: Can I take MetroLink to STL airport?
faq.a: Yes. The Red Line stops at both terminals. The Terminal 1 station is closed from Oct 12 until about mid-December 2026, so ride to Terminal 2 and take the free shuttle from Exit 10 to Terminal 1.

faq.q: Does STL have TSA PreCheck and CLEAR?
faq.a: Yes. STL lists PreCheck lanes at the Concourse A, C and E checkpoints. CLEAR lists lanes at Terminal 1 Checkpoints A and C and Terminal 2 Checkpoints E and F, generally from 4am to late afternoon or early evening.

TPA.name: Tampa International Airport

officialArrivalAdvice.domestic: TPA recommends arriving 2 hours before domestic flights (TPA newsroom, March 2026)
officialArrivalAdvice.international: TPA recommends arriving 3 hours before international flights (TPA newsroom, March 2026)

terminals.name: Airside A

checkpoints.notes: Opens at 4am per TPA (March 2026). Expanded to seven lanes in 2025, five with CT scanners. CLEAR+ lanes are planned but were not confirmed open.

United and JetBlue check in on the Blue Side; Breeze and Sun Country on the Red Side

checkpoints.notes: Opens at 3:30am per TPA (March 2026). CLEAR+ lanes are planned but were not confirmed open.
checkpoints.name: Airside C checkpoint

notes: Gates C30-C45; reached by shuttle from the Main Terminal
Southwest, Alaska and Avelo check in on the Red Side

terminals.name: Airside E

checkpoints.notes: Opens at 3:30am per TPA (March 2026). Expanded from six to seven lanes in March 2025, reached through a passageway off the Airside E shuttle lobby. CLEAR+ lanes are planned but were not confirmed open.
checkpoints.name: Airside E checkpoint

notes: Gates E62-E75
Delta checks in on the Blue Side; Air Canada and Frontier on the Red Side

checkpoints.notes: Opens at 3:15am per TPA (March 2026), the earliest of the four. CLEAR+ lanes are planned but were not confirmed open.

American, Virgin Atlantic, Aeromexico, Avianca, Cayman, Copa, Havana Air and Porter check in on the Blue Side; British Airways, Discover, Edelweiss and WestJet on the Red Side

TPA.betweenTerminals: Check-in and bag drop are in the Main Terminal, which has a Red Side and a Blue Side by airline. Each of the four airsides is reached by its own automated shuttle and has its own TSA checkpoint. To change airsides you ride back to the Main Terminal and clear security again at the other airside.

securityWaits.summary: TPA says TSA lines are often under 10 minutes and rarely over 30-40 minutes even at peak times. The busiest hours across all airsides are typically 5-7am. Ticket counter and bag check lines can be longer than security in busy periods. Live wait-time monitors were only at the Airside A shuttle lobby as of March 2026.

TPA.precheckNotes: A Kayak airport guide says all four airside checkpoints have TSA PreCheck lanes. TPA's own hours for PreCheck lanes could not be verified.
TPA.touchlessId: A March 2026 list of TSA PreCheck Touchless ID airports shows TPA for Alaska, American, Delta, Southwest and United. You opt in through your airline profile.

gettingThere.rideshare: Uber drops you at the curb for your airline. Rideshare riders can choose the Red Express Curbside as a pickup or drop-off point, per TPA. Pick the Red or Blue side that matches your airline.
gettingThere.transit: HART and PSTA buses stop next to the SkyConnect station at the Rental Car Center; take SkyConnect from the Main Terminal. HART Route 30 runs to downtown Tampa. PSTA's new 727 Airport Express runs from downtown St. Petersburg via the Howard Frankland Bridge express lanes, about 5am-11pm daily, $2.25 one way; Bay News 9 reported it launched by early October 2026.
gettingThere.driving: Follow signs to the Red or Blue side for your airline. Express Curbsides on both sides let travelers with no checked bags and an electronic boarding pass skip the ticketing level. Short Term, Long Term and Economy garages are getting new ticket and payment machines with tap-to-pay and plate readers (due to finish October 2026). If you leave within 60 minutes, the plate reader opens the exit arm. A free cell phone lot is off George J. Bean Parkway.

construction2026: Airside D (16 gates, Delta as anchor tenant) is under construction northwest of the Main Terminal and is scheduled to open in 2029. Overnight closures on George J. Bean Parkway have been needed for shuttle guideway work, with more expected.
A multi-year checked baggage system rebuild is underway (TPA, September 2026). Construction walls block some Red Bag Claim carousels on the first floor.
CLEAR+ lanes and eGates are planned for all four airside checkpoints, expected fall 2026. The contract took effect October 1, but no opening was confirmed.
TPA.bagDrop: Southwest: bags checked less than 45 minutes before a domestic departure may not be accepted (60 minutes for international); bags are accepted no earlier than 4 hours ahead. Delta: check bags at least 45 minutes before domestic departure, no more than 6 hours ahead. American: check-in and bag deadline is 45 minutes before domestic departure.
tips: Know your airside and your side. Your airline sets both the Red or Blue check-in side and the airside (A, C, E or F) you take the shuttle to.
Security is at each airside, not in the Main Terminal. Switching airsides means screening again.
With no checked bag and a mobile boarding pass, use the Red or Blue Express Curbside and go straight up to the shuttles.
Early mornings (5-7am) are the busiest time. Airside A checkpoint opens at 4am; C and E at 3:30am; F at 3:15am.
TPA says bag check and ticket counter lines can run longer than security at busy times, so add time if you are checking a bag.

faq.q: How early should I get to Tampa airport?
faq.a: TPA recommends 2 hours before domestic flights and 3 hours before international flights. Security is usually under 10 minutes, but bag check lines can be long at peak times.

faq.q: Do I need to go through security again to change airsides at TPA?
faq.a: Yes. Each airside has its own checkpoint. You ride the shuttle back to the Main Terminal, then take the shuttle to the other airside and clear security there.

faq.q: Does Tampa airport have CLEAR?
faq.a: Not yet confirmed. TPA approved CLEAR+ lanes and eGates for all four airsides, expected in fall 2026, but this research found no confirmed opening date.

faq.q: Which side is Southwest at TPA?
faq.a: Southwest checks in on the Red Side of the Main Terminal and flies from Airside C.

YVR.name: Vancouver International Airport
YVR.passportControl: Canada has no exit passport control. The CBSA gets your exit record from the airline's passenger manifest, and you do not need to do anything. At YVR you first go through Canadian security at CATSA's E - United States checkpoint, then through US preclearance, where US CBP officers clear you for immigration and customs before you board. CBP lists the facility on Level 3 of the International Terminal, open 4:30 am to midnight. You land in the US as a domestic passenger and skip CBP and TSA lines there; CBP lists YVR as a Global Entry and Mobile Passport Control location.

officialArrivalAdvice.international: U.S. & International: Arrive 2 hours 30 minutes (150 minutes) before departure. Check-in cut-off closes 1 hour 15 minutes (75 minutes) before departure for flights departing Calgary, Edmonton, Toronto, and Vancouver.

terminals.name: International Terminal - US departures (Pier E)

checkpoints.notes: CATSA security for US flights, before US preclearance. CATSA lists CT scanners here, and YVR said in June 2026 that CT installation at US Departures was under way. On a CT lane, small liquids and laptops can stay in your bag; where there is no CT sign, take them out.
checkpoints.name: E - United States

checkpoints.notes: International Terminal, Level 3. Open 4:30 am to midnight. Global Entry and Mobile Passport Control are available.
checkpoints.name: U.S. Preclearance

notes: US flights use the Pier E gates, E71-E88 and E90-E96
Gates E90-E96 are in a smaller satellite building reached by a ground-level walkway
Gates E71-E78 can switch to international use as D71-D78, so check the screens

YVR.betweenTerminals: YVR's main terminal has domestic piers A to C, the international Pier D and the US Pier E. US flights board at Pier E, after Canadian security and US preclearance.

securityWaits.summary: CATSA posts live wait times for YVR's checkpoints, including E - United States for US flights, refreshed every 2 minutes from boarding-pass scans. The figures leave out check-in, bag drop, US customs processing and the walk to the gate. This research found no published busiest times for US departures.

gettingThere.rideshare: Uber drops you at the curb of the departures area for the terminal you choose; if you do not know it, you can enter your airline instead. US preclearance is in the International Terminal.
gettingThere.transit: The Canada Line runs from Waterfront Station downtown to YVR-Airport Station in about 25 minutes. The $6.50 YVR Airport AddFare applies only to trips that start at YVR-Airport, Sea Island Centre or Templeton stations, so it is not charged on the way to the airport. You can pay the adult fare by tapping a contactless credit or debit card or a mobile wallet.
gettingThere.driving: Dinsmore Bridge onto Sea Island closes overnight, Sunday to Friday from 10 pm to 6 am, through December 31, 2026. Traffic detours via the No. 2 Rd. Bridge, which adds about six minutes. Outside those hours the bridge is open with a 30 km/h limit.

construction2026: YVR said in December 2025 that it would extend CT screening to every checkpoint in 2026, including US departures. In June 2026 it said installation at US Departures was under way.
Dinsmore Bridge closes overnight, Sunday to Friday from 10 pm to 6 am, through December 31, 2026. Use the No. 2 Rd. Bridge and allow about six extra minutes.
YVR.bagDrop: Air Canada: check-in and bag drop open 3 hours and close 60 minutes before US flights; be at the gate 30 minutes before departure, and the gate closes 15 minutes before. Delta and WestJet: check-in closes 75 minutes before departure at Vancouver; WestJet suggests dropping bags 90 minutes before. American and Alaska: AP reported 60-minute cutoffs for international flights. United: AP reported a 60-minute international cutoff and did not list Vancouver among its exceptions.
tips: Plan on 2.5 to 3 hours. WestJet asks for 2.5 hours on US flights, and Delta suggests 3 hours for departures outside the US.
Know your cutoff. Delta and WestJet close check-in 75 minutes before US flights at Vancouver; Air Canada closes check-in and bag drop at 60 minutes.
Fill in the Mobile Passport Control app before you reach preclearance. Global Entry also works at YVR.
Pack liquids in containers of 100 ml or less in one clear 1 L bag. At the US checkpoint, look for a CT sign; without one, take out liquids and laptops.
US preclearance opens at 4:30 am and closes at midnight.
Driving in late at night? Dinsmore Bridge is closed overnight through December 31, 2026, so allow a few extra minutes for the No. 2 Rd. Bridge detour.

faq.q: How early should I get to Vancouver airport for a flight to the US?
faq.a: Plan on 2.5 to 3 hours. WestJet says 2.5 hours for US flights, and Delta suggests 3 hours for departures outside the US. Delta and WestJet close check-in 75 minutes before departure at Vancouver; Air Canada closes at 60 minutes.

faq.q: Do I clear US customs in Vancouver?
faq.a: Yes. US CBP officers clear you for US immigration and customs at YVR before you board. You land in the US as a domestic passenger and skip CBP and TSA lines.

faq.q: What hours is US preclearance open at YVR?
faq.a: CBP lists 4:30 am to midnight. The facility is on Level 3 of the International Terminal.

faq.q: Can I leave liquids and laptops in my bag at YVR security?
faq.a: Only on lanes marked for CT screening. CATSA lists CT at YVR's US checkpoint, and YVR said installation there was under way in June 2026. Elsewhere, take out liquids (100 ml or less, in one 1 L bag) and laptops.

faq.q: Is there Canadian passport control when leaving Vancouver?
faq.a: No. Canada collects exit records from airline passenger manifests. The passport check before your US flight is done by US officers at preclearance.

YYZ.name: Toronto Pearson International Airport
YYZ.passportControl: Canada has no exit passport control. The CBSA gets your exit record from the airline's passenger manifest, and you do not need to do anything. US preclearance is in both Terminal 1 and Terminal 3: after check-in you go through CATSA security, then into the US CBP hall, where US officers clear you for immigration and customs before you board. CBP processing runs 3:30 am to 9:00 pm, and you land in the US as a domestic passenger, skipping CBP and TSA lines there. NEXUS holders have a priority line, Global Entry members use the NEXUS kiosks, and CBP lists Pearson as a Mobile Passport Control site.

officialArrivalAdvice.international: Flying out of Toronto Pearson (YYZ) to the U.S. or another international destination? If your flight departs before 9 am, please consider arriving at the airport no later than 3 hours prior to your scheduled departure.

terminals.name: Terminal 1

checkpoints.notes: CATSA security for US flights, before the US customs hall. Pearson says screening starts at 3:00 am; Air Canada gives 3:15 am. Pearson lists dedicated lines for Trusted Travellers (NEXUS, Global Entry), families and special assistance, and American Express cardholders. CATSA does not list CT scanners at this checkpoint, so take out liquids and laptops.
checkpoints.name: T1 - Transborder

checkpoints.notes: Open 3:30 am to 9:00 pm. NEXUS holders, and passengers in wheelchairs or with mobility issues, can use a priority line. Global Entry members use the NEXUS kiosks. Mobile Passport Control is accepted.
checkpoints.name: U.S. Customs and Border Protection (Terminal 1)

notes: Air Canada and United fly to the US from Terminal 1
US gates are in Concourse F
The UP Express airport station is in Terminal 1

terminals.name: Terminal 3

checkpoints.notes: CATSA security for US flights, before the US customs hall. Pearson says screening starts at 3:00 am. CATSA does not list CT scanners at this checkpoint, so take out liquids and laptops.
checkpoints.name: T3 - Transborder

checkpoints.notes: Open 3:30 am to 9:00 pm. NEXUS holders, and passengers in wheelchairs or with mobility issues, can use a priority line. Global Entry members use the NEXUS kiosks. Mobile Passport Control is accepted.
checkpoints.name: U.S. Customs and Border Protection (Terminal 3)

notes: All US airlines except United fly from Terminal 3
US gates are in Concourse A
From the UP Express, take the free Terminal Link train to Terminal 3

YYZ.betweenTerminals: Terminals 1 and 3 are linked by the free Terminal Link train, which runs 24 hours. The ride between stations takes 2 to 8 minutes, and the wait is up to 4 or 8 minutes depending on the time of day. In Terminal 1 the station is on parking garage Level 5; in Terminal 3 it is off the pedestrian bridge to the Sheraton Gateway Hotel.

securityWaits.summary: CATSA posts live wait times for Pearson's T1 - Transborder and T3 - Transborder checkpoints, refreshed every 2 minutes from boarding-pass scans. CATSA's figures leave out check-in, bag drop, US customs and the walk to the gate. Pearson's own wait-time dashboard shows a United States time that combines CATSA security and US CBP processing, plus airline check-in waits. Air Canada uses a queue system for US flights leaving before 9 am and asks those passengers to arrive 3 hours early.

gettingThere.rideshare: Uber, Lyft and Hopp are licensed at Pearson. Rideshare cars, like any car, may stop only briefly at the Departures curb; waiting is not allowed, and Pearson says the curb is running at limited capacity. Tell the driver your terminal: Terminal 1 for Air Canada and United, Terminal 3 for the other US airlines.
gettingThere.transit: UP Express runs from Union Station to Pearson in about 28 minutes, stopping at Bloor, Weston and Mount Dennis. From Union, the first train leaves at 4:55 am on weekdays and 6:00 am on weekends and holidays; the last leaves at 1:00 am. An adult one-way fare is $12.35. Tap PRESTO or a contactless credit or debit card, or buy a ticket online or from a machine. The airport station is in Terminal 1; for Terminal 3, change to the free Terminal Link train.
gettingThere.driving: You may stop briefly at the Departures curb of either terminal, but waiting is not allowed. Parking on the roads leading to the terminals brings a $50 fine. Express Pass gives a free short stop in the Terminal 1 and 3 garages (Pearson's pages say 18 or 20 minutes); book it online. Vehicles must be under 4.5 m to use the terminal curbs.

construction2026: Pearson LIFT, a decade-long rebuilding program, started on May 11, 2026. Its first $3-billion phase covers airfield upgrades and 30 km of baggage systems.

In July 2026 Pearson awarded a C$1.5-billion Terminal 1 and Terminal 3 revitalization covering check-in, security, customs and immigration areas, and gates. It will be built in phases while the terminals stay open. No dates for work in passenger areas have been published.
Metrolinx says planned construction is under way across the UP Express network, sometimes overnight and on weekends. Check UP Express service alerts before you travel.
YYZ.bagDrop: Air Canada: check-in and bag drop open 3 hours and close 60 minutes before US flights; be at the gate 30 minutes before departure, and the gate closes 15 minutes before. Delta and WestJet: check-in closes 75 minutes before departure at Toronto; WestJet suggests dropping bags 90 minutes before. United: AP reported in May 2025 a 90-minute check-in cutoff at Toronto. American and Alaska: AP reported 60-minute cutoffs for international flights. This research could not open Porter's check-in page.
tips: Plan on 3 hours. Air Canada asks for 3 hours on US flights before 9 am, and Pearson's general guide for international flights is 3 to 4 hours.
Check your terminal before you leave. Air Canada and United use Terminal 1; Alaska, American, Delta, Flair, Porter, Sun Country and WestJet use Terminal 3.
Check Pearson's wait-time dashboard. Its United States figure includes both CATSA security and US customs.
Fill in the Mobile Passport Control app before you reach the US customs hall.
NEXUS and Global Entry members get a dedicated line at security and at US customs. Global Entry members use the NEXUS kiosks.
Pack liquids in containers of 100 ml or less in one clear 1 L bag. CATSA does not list CT scanners at Pearson's transborder checkpoints, so expect to take out liquids and laptops.

faq.q: How early should I get to Toronto Pearson for a flight to the US?
faq.a: Plan on 3 hours. Air Canada asks for 3 hours on US flights leaving before 9 am, and Pearson's general guide for international flights is 3 to 4 hours. Check-in closes 60 minutes before departure on Air Canada, 75 minutes on Delta and WestJet, and 90 minutes on United, according to AP.

faq.q: Which Pearson terminal do US flights leave from?
faq.a: It depends on the airline. Air Canada and United use Terminal 1. Alaska, American, Delta, Flair, Porter, Sun Country and WestJet use Terminal 3. Both terminals have their own US customs hall.

faq.q: Do I go through US customs at Toronto Pearson?
faq.a: Yes. US CBP officers clear you for US immigration and customs at Pearson before you board. You land in the US as a domestic passenger and skip CBP and TSA lines.

faq.q: What time does US customs open at Pearson?
faq.a: CBP processing runs from 3:30 am to 9:00 pm in both Terminal 1 and Terminal 3. Pearson says CATSA security for US flights starts at 3:00 am.

faq.q: Can I use Global Entry at Toronto Pearson?
faq.a: Yes. Global Entry members use the NEXUS kiosks at US customs, and NEXUS holders have a dedicated line at security and US customs. Mobile Passport Control also works at Pearson.
